AutomationAddTagsDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for add_tags action. Adds pre-existing tags to the triggering record. PREREQUISITES: Tags must exist - GET /settings/tags?module={api_name} to list, POST to create first. MANDATORY: tags (array 1-10, each {id, name}). OPTIONAL: over_write (bool, default false - true replaces ALL existing tags), module ({api_name, id}). CONSTRAINTS: Not allowed with convert on Leads (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). over_write=true + remove_tags in same rule = INVALID_DATA. Unsupported: Visits, Users, LinkingModules (NOT_ALLOWED).

over_write.description: Whether to overwrite all existing tags on the record with the specified tags (true) or append to existing tags (false). Default is false. When set to true, any RemoveTags action in the same workflow rule becomes invalid and returns INVALID_DATA ('Remove tag not supported with Overwrite Add Tag').

tags.description: List of tags to add to the record. All tags must pre-exist in the org - fetch available tags from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. To create new tags: POST /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If the list is empty after parsing, the API returns FAILURE ('Empty Tag'). If the tag count exceeds the edition limit, the API returns FAILURE ('Invalid Tag Count').

items.description: Represents a tag reference, conforming to the AutomationTagRef schema, that identifies a pre-existing org tag to be added to the record. Both id and name are mandatory fields on each entry; the referenced tag must already exist in the org before the action executes.

module.description: Target module for the tag action. Must match the workflow rule's trigger module. Supported modules: Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Deals, Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, Events, Calls, Solutions, Products, Vendors, Price_Books, Quotes, Sales_Orders, Purchase_Orders, Invoices, and custom modules. Unsupported modules (Visits, Users, LinkingModules) return NOT_ALLOWED.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this add tags action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

AutomationAssignOwnerDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for assign_owner action. Assigns/reassigns record owner via user, role, group, profile, assignment_rule, merge_field, or criteria. MANDATORY: module ({api_name, id} - must match trigger module), assign_to (array 1-5 entries). OPTIONAL: notify (bool), related_records ([{api_name, id}] - Tasks/Calls/Events), apply_assignment_threshold (bool), user_availability_based_on, lookup_field (for cross-module). EXAMPLE: {"module": {"api_name": "Leads", "id": "111111000000000175"}, "assign_to": [{"type": "user", "resource": {"id": "111111000000050001", "name": "John"}}], "notify": true}

module.description: Target module for the ownership assignment. Must match the workflow rule's trigger module for direct assignments, or the lookup field's related module for cross-module assignments. At least api_name or id must be provided; if both are given and they do not match, the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

assign_to.description: Specifies how the new owner is determined. Each entry defines an assignment method - a specific user, role, group, assignment rule, profile, merge field, or criteria-based filter. For round-robin assignment across multiple users, provide multiple entries of type=user. For criteria-based assignment, provide a single entry of type=criteria with filter conditions.

items.description: Represents a single owner-assignment entry that determines how the new record owner is resolved. Each entry is one of three variants: AutomationAssignToResourceEntry (assigns ownership to a specific user, role, group, assignment rule, or profile), AutomationAssignToMergeFieldEntry (resolves the owner at runtime from a user-type lookup field on the trigger record), or AutomationAssignToCriteriaEntry (determines the owner by evaluating filter criteria at runtime).

related_records.description: Related modules whose open record ownership should also be transferred when the parent record is reassigned. Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules. Additional modules depend on the parent module: Accounts can also include Contacts and Deals; Contacts can also include Deals. Null when no related modules are selected for ownership transfer.

notify.description: Whether to send an email notification to the new owner when the record is reassigned. When true, the newly assigned owner receives an email informing them of the ownership change.

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) when assigning ownership. When true, the system checks whether the new owner has reached their record limit before applying the assignment. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

user_availability_based_on.description: Restricts assignment to users who are currently available. When set to ["online_status"], only users logged in to the Zoho CRM web interface are eligible for assignment. If the selected user is offline, the assignment is skipped or deferred. Null means no availability check is applied.

items.description: Availability criterion. Currently only "online_status" is supported - restricts to users currently logged in to Zoho CRM web interface. Example: "online_status".

lookup_field.description: The lookup field linking the trigger module to the target module. Required only for cross-module assign owner actions (where the action's module differs from the workflow rule's trigger module). For same-module assignments, this field is omitted and the action operates directly on the triggering record.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this assign owner action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST or PUT requests.

AutomationAssignOwnerResource.description: PURPOSE: Resource reference for assign_to entry. MANDATORY: id (string). OPTIONAL: name, type. Obtain from GET /settings/users (user), /settings/roles (role), /settings/user_groups (group), /settings/automation/assignment_rules (assignment_rule), /settings/profiles (profile). If both id and name given, must match (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING).

id.description: Unique identifier of the target entity. Obtain from the corresponding API: GET /settings/users (for user), GET /settings/roles (for role), GET /settings/user_groups (for group), GET /settings/automation/assignment_rules (for assignment_rule), or GET /settings/profiles (for profile).

name.description: Display name of the target entity. Optional in POST/PUT requests (server resolves from id); always present in GET responses.

type.description: Type of the target entity. Present in GET responses; not required in POST/PUT requests.

AutomationAssignToCriteriaEntry.description: PURPOSE: assign_to entry for criteria-based ownership. Evaluates filter criteria against the triggering record at execution time. MANDATORY: type (const 'criteria'), details.criteria (filter condition - simple or grouped with AND/OR). Criteria fields must reference valid trigger module fields - GET /settings/fields?module={api_name}.

type.description: Assignment method indicating criteria-based evaluation.

details.description: Contains the filter criteria to evaluate against the triggering record.

criteria.description: Filter criteria defining when this assignment applies. Can be a simple condition (field + comparator + value) or a grouped condition (group_operator + group array). The field references in criteria must be valid fields of the trigger module - fetch available fields from GET /settings/fields?module={module_api_name}. For example: {"field": {"api_name": "Department"}, "comparator": "equal", "value": "Engineering"} assigns ownership when the record's Department is Engineering.

resource.description: Always null for criteria-based assignments. The owner is determined by the criteria evaluation logic.

allow_agent_user.description: Whether to allow assignment to an agent user or not. When true, the record can be assigned to an agent user also. When false, agent users are excluded from assignment. Applicable only for types: role, group, profile, merge_field, criteria. Not supported for types user and assignment_rule.

AutomationAssignToMergeFieldEntry.description: PURPOSE: assign_to entry for merge-field-based ownership. Resolves to a user at execution time from a user-type field. MANDATORY: type (const 'merge_field'), details.api_name (merge field token e.g., '${!Leads.Created_By}'). Field must be data_type=ownerlookup or userlookup. GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} to discover.

type.description: Assignment method indicating merge field resolution.

details.description: Contains the merge field reference that resolves to a user at execution time.

api_name.description: Merge field token referencing a user-type field. Must use the format ${!Module.User_Field} ,${!Module.Lookup_Field_API_Name.User_Field} where Field is a user-type field (data_type=ownerlookup or userlookup) from the trigger module. Fetch valid fields from GET /settings/fields?module={module_api_name}. Common user-type fields: Owner, Created_By, Modified_By. Examples: ${!Leads.Created_By}, ${!Deals.Owner}, ${!Contacts.Account_Manager}.

resource.description: Always null for merge field assignments. The owner is resolved dynamically from the merge field at execution time.

allow_agent_user.description: Whether to allow assignment to an agent user or not. When true, the record can be assigned to an agent user also. When false, agent users are excluded from assignment. Applicable only for types: role, group, profile, merge_field, criteria. Not supported for types user and assignment_rule.

AutomationAssignToResourceEntry.description: PURPOSE: assign_to entry for resource-based ownership. MANDATORY: type (user|role|group|assignment_rule|profile), resource ({id, name}). For type=profile: associated_to must be 'team_profile'. For round-robin: use multiple entries of type=user.

type.description: Assignment method. Determines what kind of entity receives ownership. Values: "user" - assign to a specific CRM user (GET /settings/users), for round-robin include multiple assign_to entries of type=user; "role" - assign to a user holding the specified role (GET /settings/roles), system picks an eligible user at execution time; "group" - assign to a member of the specified user group (GET /settings/user_groups); "assignment_rule" - assign using a pre-configured assignment rule (GET /settings/automation/assignment_rules), the rule's criteria and round-robin logic determine the final owner; "profile" - assign to a user matching the specified profile (GET /settings/profiles), must include associated_to=team_profile.

resource.description: Identifies the target user, role, group, assignment rule, or profile by ID and/or name. At least one of id or name must be provided; if both are given and they do not match, the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

allow_agent_user.description: Whether to allow assignment to an agent user or not. When true, the record can be assigned to an agent user also. When false, agent users are excluded from assignment. Applicable only for types: role, group, profile, merge_field, criteria. Not supported for types user and assignment_rule.

associated_to.description: Association context for profile-based assignment. Must be "team_profile" when type=profile. Not applicable for other assignment types; if provided for a non-profile type, the API returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Example: "team_profile".

details.description: Always null for resource-based assignments. Present in GET responses for schema consistency with other assign_to types.

AutomationChatNotificationDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for chat notification actions (slack/cliq/cisco/google_chat/microsoft_teams_notifications). Sends a message to a channel, user, or field-based recipient. Limit: 1 per type per rule. MANDATORY: message (string, supports ${Module.Field} merge fields), notify_to (object with type: 'user'|'channel'|'fields'). For user/channel: provide id + name. For fields: provide module + notify_fields.fields array. EXAMPLE: {"message": "New deal ${Deals.Deal_Name}", "notify_to": {"type": "channel", "id": "C0123", "name": "#sales"}}

message.description: REQUIRED. Notification message body. Supports merge fields in ${Module.Field} format (e.g., "New deal ${Deals.Deal_Name} created by ${Deals.Owner}!").

notify_to.description: REQUIRED. Notification target - a channel, user, or field-based recipient.

type.description: Target type. 'user' - send to a specific chat user. 'channel' - send to a chat channel. 'fields' - send to users resolved from CRM field values.

id.description: Required for user/channel types. The integration-specific user or channel ID.

name.description: Required for user/channel types. Display name of the user or channel (e.g., '#sales-alerts').

module.description: Required for type='fields'. The CRM module to resolve field values from. Use GET /settings/modules to discover api_name and id.

id.description: Module ID.

api_name.description: Module API name.

notify_fields.description: Required for type='fields'. Field references to resolve notification recipients.

fields.description: Array of field references. Each must have api_name and optionally id. If both given, cross-validated for consistency (AMBIGUITY_DUE_TO if mismatch).

items.description: A field reference with api_name and optional id.

id.description: Field ID.

api_name.description: Field API name. Use GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} to discover.

items.description: A static field reference with api_name and optional id.

id.description: Static field ID.

api_name.description: Static field API name.

id.description: Read-only. Unique identifier for the action, returned in GET responses.

AutomationCircuitsDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for circuits action. Executes a Zoho Circuits workflow. Limit: 1/rule. MANDATORY: circuit_id (string). EXAMPLE: {"circuit_id": "7389640000001234"}

id.description: Read-only. Unique identifier for the action.

AutomationConvertChangeOwner.description: PURPOSE: Owner assignment during convert action. MANDATORY: id (user ID from GET /users). OPTIONAL: name, related_modules ([{api_name, id}] - which converted modules get new owner), apply_assignment_threshold (bool). For Leads: related_modules can include Events, Calls, Tasks, Contacts, Deals.

id.description: Unique user ID of the new owner. Obtain from GET /users. Must be an active user with permissions on the target modules.

name.description: Full name of the new owner. Optional - present in GET responses for display purposes.

related_modules.description: List of target modules whose records should receive the new owner during conversion. Reuses the same related-record concept as assign_owner. For Leads conversion: Events, Calls, Tasks, Contacts, Deals are valid. For Quotes/SalesOrders conversion: only Events, Calls, Tasks are valid.

items.description: Represents a related module reference, conforming to the AutomationRelatedRecord schema, that identifies a child module whose records should also receive the new owner assignment during the conversion operation. At least one of api_name or id is required to identify the child module.

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the new owner for each converted module. When true, the system checks whether the new owner has reached their record limit before assigning ownership.

AutomationConvertDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for convert action. Converts records - Leads to Contacts+Accounts+Deals, Quotes to SalesOrders/Invoices, SalesOrders to Invoices. PREREQUISITES: criteria_details.criteria MUST be non-null (NOT_ALLOWED otherwise). Module MUST be Leads/Quotes/Sales_Orders. MANDATORY (Leads): add_to_existing_contact (bool), add_to_existing_account (bool). MANDATORY (Quotes/Sales_Orders): convert_to ({api_name, id}). OPTIONAL: change_owner, carry_tags (ARRAY [{api_name, id}] NOT boolean), field_mappings (max 25), move_attachment_to, create_deal (Leads only), contact_role (with create_deal). CONSTRAINTS: No add_tags/remove_tags with convert on Leads. No scheduled actions with convert.

add_to_existing_contact.description: MANDATORY for Leads conversion (omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND). Whether to link the converted record to an existing Contact instead of creating a new one. Only applicable for Leads module. When true, if a matching Contact exists (based on duplicate-check criteria), the Lead is merged into it rather than creating a new Contact. Not applicable for Quotes or Sales_Orders conversions.

add_to_existing_account.description: MANDATORY for Leads conversion (omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND). Whether to link the converted record to an existing Account instead of creating a new one. Only applicable for Leads module. When true, if a matching Account exists (based on Company name), the Lead is linked to it rather than creating a new Account. Not applicable for Quotes or Sales_Orders conversions.

move_attachment_to.description: Target module to which attachments from the source record should be moved during conversion. For Leads: typically Contacts or Accounts. For Quotes/SalesOrders: the target conversion module. Provide api_name and/or id.

carry_tags.description: List of target modules that should inherit tags from the source record during conversion. For Leads: may include Contacts, Accounts, Deals. Each entry identifies a module by api_name and/or id.

items.description: Represents a module reference, conforming to the AutomationModuleRef schema, that identifies a target module whose records should inherit tags from the source record during conversion. At least one of api_name or id is required to identify the module; valid values are obtainable from GET /settings/modules.

field_mappings.description: List of field-value pairs to populate in the converted record(s). Each entry maps a target field to a value using one of the supported types: static, merge_field, or execution_time. For Leads conversion, field mappings can target Contacts, Accounts, and Deals modules. Fetch available fields from GET /settings/fields?module={target_module_api_name}.

items.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping entry for the converted record, conforming to the AutomationFieldMappings schema. Each entry identifies the target field and specifies the value resolution strategy: static for literal values, merge_field for runtime token substitution, or execution_time for dynamically resolved values.

create_deal.description: Whether to create a Deal record as part of Leads conversion. Only applicable when the trigger module is Leads. When true, the Deal module field mappings in field_mappings are used to populate the new Deal.

change_owner.description: New owner assignment for the converted records. Specifies the user (by id) who should own the converted records, which modules should receive the new owner (via related_modules), and whether to enforce assignment thresholds. When omitted, the source record's owner is retained.

contact_role.description: Unique ID of the Contact Role to assign when a Deal is created during Leads conversion. Only applicable when create_deal=true. Obtain valid Contact Role IDs from GET /Contacts/roles.

convert_to.description: MANDATORY for Quotes and Sales_Orders conversion (omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND). Identifies the target module for conversion as an object with api_name and id. For Quotes: convert_to can be {api_name: 'SalesOrders', id: '<module_id>'} or {api_name: 'Invoices', id: '<module_id>'}. For Sales_Orders: convert_to must be {api_name: 'Invoices', id: '<module_id>'}. Obtain the module id from GET /settings/modules. Not applicable for Leads conversion (Leads always convert to Contacts+Accounts, optionally +Deals).

api_name.description: API name of the target module. For Quotes: 'SalesOrders' or 'Invoices'. For Sales_Orders: 'Invoices'.

id.description: Unique 19-digit module ID of the target module. Obtain from GET /settings/modules. Always use the full 19-digit ID as returned by the API; truncated IDs cause INVALID_DATA.

portal_user_type.description: Portal user type to assign during Leads conversion. Only applicable when the org has portals configured and the converted Contact should be provisioned as a portal user. The id and name must match an existing portal user type - validated against the org's portal metadata (CrmClientPortalFilterUtil). Not applicable for Quotes or Sales_Orders conversions.

id.description: Unique identifier of the portal user type. Must match an existing portal user type in the org's portal configuration.

name.description: Display name of the portal user type.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules on the record owner during conversion. Present in GET responses.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this convert action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

AutomationCreateConnectedRecordDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for create_connected_record action. Same as create_record but module must be a connected-record child of the rule's module. Requires ManageAutomation or ManageConnectedWorkflow permission. Not for Notes, Rebuy, Competitor Mentions. Limit: 1/rule. MANDATORY: module ({api_name, id} of child), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include all mandatory fields). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool).

module.description: REQUIRED. Target child module for connected record creation. Must be a valid connected-record child module of the rule's module. Use GET /settings/modules to discover api_name and id.

api_name.description: Module API name.

id.description: Module ID.

layout.description: Represents a layout reference, conforming to the AutomationLayoutRef schema, that determines which layout is applied when creating the connected record. The id field is mandatory and governs which fields are available and required for the target module; valid layout identifiers are obtainable from GET /settings/layouts?module={api_name}.

field_mappings.description: REQUIRED. Field mapping array (1-25 entries). Use GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} to discover field api_name and id. All mandatory fields for the target module/layout must be included.

items.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping entry for the new connected record, conforming to the AutomationFieldMappings schema. Each entry identifies a target field via its api_name and id, and specifies the value resolution strategy: static for literal values, merge_field for runtime token substitution, execution_time for dynamically resolved values, or composite for compound values.

id.description: Read-only. Unique identifier for the action.

AutomationCreatedByResponse.description: Represents the CRM user who created the webhook.

name.description: Represents the display name of the user who created the webhook.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the user who created the webhook. Refer to the [Get Users](users.yaml#$.paths./users.get) resource for valid values.

AutomationEmailCreateRecordDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for create_record_email action. Creates a record via email for Leads or Contacts only. Limit: 1/rule. MANDATORY: module ({api_name: 'Leads'|'Contacts'}), field_mappings (exactly 1 entry with field + value for owner assignment). value.type: 'user'|'role'|'group'|'country'. Errors: no_data if empty, too_many_records if >1.

module.description: REQUIRED. Target module - only 'Leads' or 'Contacts' allowed.

api_name.description: Module API name. Must be 'Leads' or 'Contacts'.

field_mappings.description: REQUIRED. Exactly 1 field mapping entry. More than 1 returns too_many_records, none returns no_data.

items.description: A field-to-value mapping entry for email-based record creation.

field.description: Field reference. Use GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} to discover.

api_name.description: Field API name.

id.description: Field ID.

value.description: Owner assignment details.

type.description: Owner assignment type.

resource.description: Assignment target reference.

id.description: Resource ID.
Read-only. Unique identifier for the action.

AutomationFunctionActionResult.description: Represents the result of processing an automation function action, including a status code, message, and associated details.

code.description: The status code indicating the outcome of the automation function action. Possible values: **SUCCESS** - The automation function action was processed successfully. Example: "SUCCESS".

message.description: The message describing the result of the operation.

status.description: The overall status of the operation. Possible values: **success** - The operation completed successfully. Example: "success".

AutomationFunctionArgument.description: Represents name, type and value that defines a single argument passed to an automation function.

name.description: Represents the name of the automation function argument.

type.description: The type of the automation function argument. Possible values: * **static** - The argument uses a fixed, literal value. * **merge_field** - The argument uses a dynamic value merged from a CRM field.

value.description: Represents the value assigned to the automation function argument.

AutomationFunctionBulkRemovalResponse.description: The response returned after removing one or more automation functions in bulk, containing per-item results for each function in the request.

functions.description: The list of individual removal results, one entry per automation function included in the bulk request.

items.description: The removal result for a single automation function, indicating whether the function was successfully removed.

allOf.description: Ensures at least one success result is present in the response.
Ensures at least one invalid data error result is present in the response.

AutomationFunctionCreationResponse.description: Indicates the response returned after submitting automation function definitions, containing per-item results in a **functions** array.

functions.description: The list of per-item results from the automation function creation operation.

AutomationFunctionDefinitionInputV2.description: Represents an automation function definition, including its feature type, associated module, linked function, name, language, description, and arguments.

feature_type.description: The CRM automation feature type with which the function is associated. Possible values: **workflow** - A Workflow Rule automation feature. **approval_process** - An Approval Process automation feature. **blueprint** - A Blueprint automation feature. **blueprint_transition** - A Blueprint transition automation feature. **blueprint_state** - A Blueprint state automation feature. **review_process** - A review process automation feature. **orchestration** - An orchestration automation feature. **assignment_rules** - An Assignment Rule automation feature. **kiosk** - A kiosk automation feature. **pathfinder** - A pathfinder automation feature. **connected_workflows** - A connected workflows automation feature. **commandcenter_service** - A Command Center service automation feature. **cadences** - A Cadences automation feature.

module.description: Module of the function (Required)

name.description: The name of the automation function.

description.description: The description of the automation function.

language.description: Represents the programming language of the automation function. Possible values: **deluge** - Deluge scripting language. **python** - Python (legacy). **java** - Java (legacy). **node_js** - Node.js (legacy). **python_3_12** - Python 3.12. **java17** - Java 17. **nodejs_22** - Node.js 22. **nodejs** - Node.js. **golang** - Go programming language.

arguments.description: Represents the list of arguments configured for the automation function.

AutomationFunctionDeleteInvalidDataError.description: Error result returned when an invalid function ID is specified during bulk deletion.

code.description: The error code identifying the type of error. Possible values: **INVALID_DATA** - The request contains an invalid function ID. Example: "INVALID_DATA".

message.description: The error message describing the issue.

status.description: Represents the status of the response. Possible values: **error** - Indicates that the request resulted in an error. Example: "error".

AutomationFunctionDeletionResponse.description: The response returned after deleting a single automation function, containing the result of the deletion operation.

functions.description: The list of deletion results for the specified automation functions.

AutomationFunctionDetail.description: Represents the details of an automation function, including its metadata, module context, script reference, language, lock status, ownership, and configured arguments.

created_time.description: The timestamp when the automation function was created.

editable.description: Indicates whether the automation function can be edited. Possible values: * **true** - The automation function can be edited. * **false** - The automation function cannot be edited.

related_module.description: The CRM module associated with the automation function, if applicable.

oneOf.description: Indicates no related module is associated with this automation function.

deletable.description: Indicates whether the automation function can be deleted. Possible values: * **true** - The automation function can be deleted. * **false** - The automation function cannot be deleted."

description.description: A brief description of the automation function's purpose.

language.description: The programming language used in the automation function script. Possible values: * **deluge** - Deluge scripting language. * **python** - Python language. * **java** - Java language. **node_js** - Node.js runtime. * **python_3_12** - Python 3.12 runtime. * **java17** - Java 17 runtime. * **nodejs_22** - Node.js 22 runtime. * **nodejs** - Node.js runtime. * **GOlang** - Go programming language.

source.description: The source or origin from which the automation function was created.

feature_type.description: The feature type classification of the automation function. Possible values: * **workflow** * **approval_process** * **blueprint** * **blueprint_transition** * **blueprint_state** * **review_process** * **orchestration** * **assignment_rules** * **kiosk** * **pathfinder** * **connected_workflows** * **commandcenter_service** * **cadences**

modified_time.description: The timestamp when the automation function was last modified.

associated.description: Indicates whether the automation function is currently associated with a workflow or action. Possible values: * **true** - The automation function is associated with a workflow or action. * **false** - The automation function is not associated with any workflow or action.

name.description: Represents the display name of the automation function.

arguments.description: Represents the list of arguments configured for the automation function.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the automation function.

AutomationFunctionLinkInputV2.description: Represents an automation function link input, containing the identifier of a custom function to associate within an automation definition.

id.description: The unique identifier of the custom function to associate with the automation definition.

AutomationFunctionListResponse.description: Represents the response for an automation functions list request, including the list of functions and pagination information.

functions.description: Represents the list of automation functions returned in the response.

AutomationFunctionLockStatus.description: The lock status of an automation function, indicating whether editing is currently restricted.

locked.description: Indicates whether the automation function is currently locked from editing. Possible values: * **true** - The automation function is locked and cannot be edited. * **false** - The automation function is unlocked and available for editing.

AutomationFunctionModificationItemV2.description: Represents an automation function modification request, including the feature type, target module, arguments, and the function ID to update.

feature_type.description: The automation feature type associated with the function. Possible values: * **workflow** * **approval_process** * **blueprint** * **blueprint_transition** * **blueprint_state** * **review_process** * **orchestration** * **assignment_rules** * **kiosk** * **pathfinder** * **connected_workflows** * **commandcenter_service** * **cadences**

arguments.description: Represents the list of arguments configured for the automation function.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the automation function to update.

module.description: Module Datas

AutomationFunctionModificationResponse.description: Represents the response returned after submitting automation function modifications, containing per-item results for each submitted function.

functions.description: Represents the list of per-item results for each automation function modification submitted in the request.

AutomationFunctionModuleChangeInputV2.description: Represents the module selector used to identify a CRM module by its API name or ID when modifying an automation function.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the module.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the module.

AutomationFunctionModuleInfo.description: Module metadata associated with the automation function, including singular and plural labels, API name, internal name, and identifier.

singular_label.description: Represents the singular display label of the module.

plural_label.description: Represents the plural display label of the module.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the module associated with the automation function.

moduleName.description: Represents the internal name of the module.

id.description: The unique identifier of the module associated with the automation function.

AutomationFunctionOperationDetails.description: Operation details for a processed automation function, including the resulting resource identifier.

id.description: The unique identifier of the automation function that was processed.

AutomationFunctionQueryResponse.description: Represents the response containing automation function records returned for the requested query.

functions.description: The list of automation function detail records matching the query.

AutomationFunctionReference.description: Reference to the underlying function by API name and identifier.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the automation function.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the automation function.

AutomationFunctionsAssociatedModuleRefer.description: A reference to a CRM module associated with an automation function, identified by its API name and unique ID.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the associated CRM module.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the associated CRM module.

AutomationHostUnavailable.description: PURPOSE: Fallback when meeting host or caller is unavailable. Exactly ONE must be specified: assign_record_owner_as_host (bool) OR assign_task ({id}). Both = INVALID_DATA. Neither = EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING.

assign_record_owner_as_host.description: When true, the record owner is automatically assigned as the host/caller if the originally designated host is unavailable. Mutually exclusive with assign_task.

assign_task.description: A follow-up task to create when the host is unavailable. Mutually exclusive with assign_record_owner_as_host. The task must be pre-configured in the CRM.

name.description: Name of the follow-up task.

id.description: Unique ID of the pre-configured task.

AutomationLockStatusResponse.description: Represents the lock status of the webhook. Locked webhooks cannot be edited or deleted.

locked.description: Indicates whether the webhook is currently locked. Locked webhooks cannot be edited or deleted. Possible values: **true** - The webhook is locked. **false** - The webhook is not locked.

message.description: Represents the reason the webhook is locked. Returns null when the webhook is not locked.

AutomationLookupFieldRef.description: Identifies a lookup field that links the workflow rule's trigger module to the target module of a cross-module action. For example, if the trigger module is Leads and the assign owner action targets Contacts, the lookup_field identifies which lookup field on Leads points to Contacts (e.g., Lookup_2_cont).

api_name.description: API name of the lookup field (e.g., Lookup_1_same, Lookup_2_cont).

id.description: Unique field ID of the lookup field.

AutomationMeetingDuration.description: PURPOSE: Meeting duration for add_meeting. MANDATORY unless All_Day=true. REQUIRED: unit (integer - quantity), period (string - 'hours' or 'minutes'). Must be a JSON object (not int/string - INVALID_DATA). Omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND. If All_Day=true and provided, returns INVALID_DATA (field1/field2 conflict). EXAMPLE: {"unit": 1, "period": "hours"}

period.description: The time unit for the duration. "hours" - duration in hours (e.g., unit=1, period=hours means a 1-hour meeting). "minutes" - duration in minutes (e.g., unit=30, period=minutes means a 30-minute meeting).

AutomationModifiedByResponse.description: Represents the CRM user who last modified the webhook.

name.description: Represents the display name of the user who last modified the webhook.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the user who last modified the webhook. Refer to the [Get Users](users.yaml#$.paths./users.get) resource for valid values.

AutomationModuleDetailsResponse.description: Represents the CRM module reference identifying the parent module associated with a webhook.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the CRM module (for example, Leads, Contacts, Deals).

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the CRM module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

AutomationRelatedRecord.description: Identifies a related module whose open records' ownership should be transferred alongside the parent record. Used by assign_owner actions, field_updates (Owner field), and convert actions (change_owner.related_modules). Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules and actions. Contacts is available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts, and for convert when converting Leads. Deals is available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts or Contacts, and for convert when converting Leads (requires create_deal=true).

api_name.description: API name of the related module. Events, Calls, Tasks - open activity records, available for all modules and actions (assign_owner, convert). Contacts - available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts, and for convert when converting Leads. Deals - available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts or Contacts, and for convert when converting Leads (requires create_deal=true).

id.description: Unique identifier of the related module. This is the module ID corresponding to the api_name.

AutomationRemoveTagsDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for remove_tags action. Removes tags from the triggering record. PREREQUISITES: Tags must exist - GET /settings/tags?module={api_name} to list. MANDATORY: tags (array 1-10, each {id, name}). OPTIONAL: module ({api_name, id}). CONSTRAINTS: Not allowed with convert on Leads (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). If same rule has add_tags with over_write=true, this returns INVALID_DATA. Unsupported: Visits, Users, LinkingModules (NOT_ALLOWED). Note: over_write field is type-checked but its value is ignored for remove_tags.

tags.description: List of tags to remove from the record. All tags must pre-exist in the org - fetch available tags from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If the list is empty after parsing, the API returns FAILURE ('Empty Tag'). If the tag count exceeds the edition limit, the API returns FAILURE ('Invalid Tag Count').

items.description: Represents a tag reference, conforming to the AutomationTagRef schema, that identifies a pre-existing org tag to be removed from the record. Both id and name are mandatory fields on each entry; the referenced tag must already exist in the org before the action executes.

module.description: Target module for the tag action. Must match the workflow rule's trigger module. Supported modules: Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Deals, Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, Events, Calls, Solutions, Products, Vendors, Price_Books, Quotes, Sales_Orders, Purchase_Orders, Invoices, and custom modules. Unsupported modules (Visits, Users, LinkingModules) return NOT_ALLOWED.

over_write.description: Present in GET responses. Its value is ignored for remove_tags actions.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this remove tags action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST or PUT requests.

AutomationSocialDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for social actions (Facebook/Twitter). Available only with fb_*/tw_* triggers. Limit: 1 per type per rule. content is REQUIRED for comment_to_post, reply_to_comment, reply_to_message, reply_to_tweet. NOT required for like_to_comment, retweet. Supports ${Module.Field} merge fields. EXAMPLE: {"content": "Thanks ${Leads.Full_Name}!"}

content.description: Message content. Supports merge fields in ${Module.Field} format. REQUIRED for: comment_to_post, reply_to_comment, reply_to_message, reply_to_tweet. NOT required for: like_to_comment, retweet (details can be empty).

id.description: Read-only. Unique identifier for the action.

AutomationTagRef.description: PURPOSE: Tag reference for add_tags/remove_tags. Tags must pre-exist - GET /settings/tags?module={api_name} to list, POST to create. MANDATORY: id, name. Both must resolve to same tag (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING if mismatch). Non-existent = INVALID_DATA. Limits: 100 tags/module, 10 tags/record, name max 25 chars.

id.description: Unique identifier of the tag. Obtain from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If provided alone, the tag is resolved by ID. If both id and name are provided, they must resolve to the same tag.

name.description: Name of the tag. Obtain from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If provided alone, the tag is resolved by name. Must match an existing tag - providing a non-existent name returns INVALID_DATA. Max 25 characters, cannot contain <, >, commas, or emojis.

color_code.description: Hex color code of the tag (e.g., '#879BFC'). Optional in requests; present in GET responses. Allowed values: #F17574, #F48435, #E7A826, #A8C026, #63C57E, #1DB9B4, #57B1FD, #879BFC, #D297EE, #FD87BD, #969696, #658BA8, #B88562.

AutomationUsageDataEntry.description: Represents a single daily usage data point capturing the execution count for an automation action. When the group_by parameter includes resource, the embedded resource object identifies the individual email notification or webhook. When group_by is date only, the resource object is omitted and the count reflects total executions across all actions for that day. The type field indicates the automation feature responsible for the executions, such as workflow_rules, approval_process, or Blueprint.

date.description: Represents the date of this usage data point in YYYY-MM-DD format. All dates are evaluated in the organization's time zone.

resource.description: Reference to the specific automation action (email notification or webhook) that generated the usage count. Only present when group_by includes 'resource'.

count.description: Represents the number of times the automation action was executed on this date. When the group_by parameter is set to 'date' only, this value reflects the total across all actions.

type.description: Represents the automation feature type associated with the reported executions. Values correspond to the filter types supported by the type query parameter, such as workflow_rules, approval_process, Blueprint, email_notifications, webhooks, and kiosks.

AutomationUsagePaginationInfo.description: Represents pagination metadata returned with automation usage report responses. Includes a max_limit value that reflects the edition-specific daily execution cap for the relevant action type, derived from the organization's feature limits.

per_page.description: Represents the number of records returned in each page of the result set.

count.description: Represents the number of records included in the current page of results.

page.description: Represents the one-based index of the current page within the paginated result set.

more_records.description: Indicates whether additional pages of results are available beyond the current page. Possible values: true - More records exist beyond the current page. false - The current page contains the last records.

max_limit.description: Represents the edition-specific daily execution cap for the automation action type. For email notifications, this reflects the WORKFLOWALERT day limit; for webhooks, it reflects the WFWEBHOOK day limit. Lower-tier editions carry smaller caps.

AutomationUsageReportResponse.description: Represents a successful response from an automation usage report endpoint. Contains an array of daily usage data points alongside pagination metadata that includes the edition-specific daily execution cap. When no usage exists for the queried period, the endpoint returns an empty data array rather than null, and the response resolves with HTTP 200.

data_usage.description: Contains the collection of usage data points for the queried period. Each entry represents the execution count for a specific automation action on a given date. Returns an empty array when no usage exists for the queried period.

info.description: Pagination metadata including the edition-specific daily execution cap.

AutomationUsageResource.description: Represents a reference to the specific automation action that generated usage. The identifier and name are resolved from the action's configuration record; for deleted actions, the name falls back to the corresponding automation audit log entry. When the include_inner_details parameter includes resource.layout_id and the action is associated with a wizard layout, a layout_id field is included in the representation.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the automation action, such as an email notification ID or a webhook ID.

name.description: Represents the display name of the automation action. Falls back to the name recorded in the automation audit log when the action has been deleted.

layout_id.description: Represents the identifier of the wizard layout associated with the automation action. Present only when the include_inner_details query parameter is set to resource.layout_id and the action is linked to a wizard layout.

AutomationWebhooksResponse.description: Represents the full webhook object returned by the list and get-by-ID operations, including all configuration fields, audit metadata, and status indicators.

created_time.description: Represents the ISO 8601 timestamp of when the webhook was created.

headers.description: Headers let you send extra information along with the webhook request. For example, API keys, authentication tokens, or custom values that the external application needs.

lock_status.description: Lock status of the webhook. Locked webhooks cannot be edited or deleted.

editable.description: Indicates whether the current user can edit this webhook. Returns false for marketplace and extension-created webhooks. Possible values: **true** - The webhook can be edited. **false** - The webhook cannot be edited.

module.description: The parent CRM module that this webhook monitors for trigger events.

related_module.description: The child or dependent CRM module linked to this webhook's parent module. Null when no related module is configured.

url_parameters.description: URL parameters for GET/DELETE webhook HTTP methods. Null when http_method is POST or PUT.

deletable.description: Indicates whether the current user can delete this webhook. Returns false for marketplace and extension-created webhooks. Possible values: **true** - The webhook can be deleted. **false** - The webhook cannot be deleted.

description.description: Represents the optional user-provided description of the webhook purpose. Returns null when no description has been set.

source.description: Represents the origin of the webhook. Returns null for legacy webhooks. Possible values: **user** - Created by a CRM user. **crm** - Created by the CRM system. **extension** - Created by a Marketplace extension.

body.description: Define the data that Zoho CRM sends in the body of the webhook request. This is applicable only for POST and PUT HTTP methods

created_by.description: The CRM user who created this webhook.

url.description: Represents the destination URL that Zoho CRM sends the webhook request to when triggered.

feature_type.description: Represents the automation feature type this webhook belongs to. Possible values: **workflow** - Workflow Rule. **approval_process** - Approval Process. **blueprint** - Blueprint. **kiosk** - Kiosk feature. **commandcenter_service** - CommandCenter service.

http_method.description: Represents the HTTP method used when the webhook fires. Possible values: **GET** - Sends a GET request to the webhook URL. **POST** - Sends a POST request to the webhook URL. **PUT** - Sends a PUT request to the webhook URL. **DELETE** - Sends a DELETE request to the webhook URL.

modified_time.description: Represents the ISO 8601 timestamp of when the webhook was last modified.

associated.description: Indicates whether this webhook is currently associated with at least one active Workflow Rule, Approval Process, or Blueprint. Possible values: **true** - The webhook is associated with at least one automation rule. **false** - The webhook is not associated with any automation rule.

name.description: Represents the display name of the webhook.

modified_by.description: The CRM user who last modified this webhook.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the webhook.

date_time_format.description: Date and time formatting configuration for this webhook's payloads. Null when no date/datetime merge-fields are used.

authentication.description: Specify authentication details for the webhook endpoint. (Required)

AutomationZohoFlowDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for flow action. Triggers a Zoho Flow custom action. Limit: 1/rule. Fetch values from `getCustomActions` (filter service_type='zoho_flow', component_type='workflow'): use response `id` as custom_action_id, `action_name` as custom_action_name. MANDATORY: custom_action_id (string), custom_action_name (string). EXAMPLE: {"custom_action_id": "4839491000001566002", "custom_action_name": "Sync to ERP"}

custom_action_id.description: REQUIRED. Zoho Flow custom action ID. Value = `id` from `getCustomActions` response.

custom_action_name.description: REQUIRED. Display name of the Zoho Flow action. Value = `action_name` from `getCustomActions` response.

id.description: Read-only. Unique identifier for the action.

AvailableTimingsNested.description: Represents a single availability time window for the service, defined by a start time (From) and an end time (To).

From.description: Specify the start of the availability time window in HH:MM (24-hour) format.

To.description: Specify the end of the availability time window in HH:MM (24-hour) format.

BaseFormNested.description: Represents the base webform in an AB test, including its traffic allocation, performance metrics, and embed code formats.

embed_code.description: Represents the embeddable script code for the webform.

leading.description: Indicates whether the base form is currently leading in the AB test based on performance metrics. Possible values: **true** - The base form is leading. **false** - The base form is not leading.

active.description: Indicates whether the base webform is currently active. Possible values: **true** - The webform is active and accepting submissions. **false** - The webform is inactive.

iframe_code.description: Represents the iframe embed code for displaying the webform.

code_formats.description: Represents the list of embed code formats available for this webform.

items.description: Represents an available embed code format for the webform. Possible values: **source** - The raw HTML source code. **embed** - The embeddable script tag. **iframe** - The iframe embed code.

winner.description: Indicates whether the base webform has been declared the winner of the AB test. Possible values: **true** - The base webform is the declared winner. **false** - The base webform has not been declared the winner.

old_traffic.description: Represents the previous traffic allocation percentage for the base webform before the most recent update. Returns null when no previous allocation exists.

name.description: Represents the name of the base webform.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the base webform.

no_of_submission.description: Represents the total number of form submissions received by the base webform during the AB test.

winner_confidence.description: Represents the statistical confidence level for declaring the base webform as the winner. Returns null when the confidence has not been calculated.

source_code.description: Represents the full HTML source code of the base webform.

no_of_visits.description: Represents the total number of visitor sessions on the base webform during the AB test.

traffic.description: Represents the percentage of visitor traffic allocated to the base webform.

BaseFormNestedPost.description: Represents the base webform configuration to include when creating an AB test, including the form ID and traffic allocation.

id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the base webform to include in the AB test.

traffic.description: Specify the percentage of visitor traffic to allocate to the base webform.

api_name.description: Field: api_name

id.description: Field: id

BccEmailNested.description: Represents a BCC recipient entry for a mail merge email, containing the address type and email value.

type.description: Represents the type of the address. Possible values: **email** - Indicates that the value is an email address. Example: "email".

value.description: Represents the email address to include in the BCC list for the mail merge email.

BetweenFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the range filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the range filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description: Represents the range comparison operator applied to the criterion, indicating whether the field value falls within or outside the specified bounds. Possible values: between - Matches records where the field value falls within the specified range. not_between - Matches records where the field value falls outside the specified range.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

type.description: Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference. Possible values: value - The value is a direct literal. merge_field - The value is a merge field reference. pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder. field - The value references another field.

BetweenFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the between and not_between comparators. The value is an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the range filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the range filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description: Represents the range comparison operator returned for the criterion, indicating whether the field value falls within or outside the specified bounds. Possible values: between - Matches records where the field value falls within the specified range. not_between - Matches records where the field value falls outside the specified range.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field was evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

type.description: Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference. Possible values: value - The value is a direct literal. merge_field - The value is a merge field reference. pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder. field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the between filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

BlueprintActionsDataNested.description: Represents the object that contains the field values required for the transition. Keys are field API names. Values can be: (a) primitive field values (string, number, Boolean, or null), (b) arrays for subform during fields or multi-record fields (for example, **Tag**, **Subform_1**) where each element is a key-value map, or (c) an associated module object whose properties include the associated module's field values and nested subform arrays (for example, **data.Sales_Order** with nested **Ordered_Items**).

CheckLists.description: Represents the array of checklist items for the transition. Each item contains question-answer pairs.

oneOf.description: Sub-form during field or multi-record field - dynamic key is the sub-form/field API name; value is an array of records, each being a key-value map of field API names to their values.

Associated module object used inside data when a blueprint during field references an associated module record. Keys are field API names of the associated module (primitive values) and/or sub-form API names mapped to arrays of sub-form records (e.g. Sales_Order.Ordered_Items).
String field value for a regular blueprint during field.
Numeric field value for a regular blueprint during field.
Boolean field value for a regular blueprint during field.
Null field value for a regular blueprint during field.

BlueprintActionsGETBlueprintNested.description: Represents the Blueprint details of a record, including the transitions currently available in its active Blueprint process.

transitions.description: List of transitions currently available for the record in its active Blueprint process. Each transition includes its ID, name, criteria match details, and the fields required to execute it.

BlueprintActionsGETDataNested.description: Represents the values of the during fields for a transition. Keys are field API names and values are the field values. For subform during fields, the key is the subform API name and the value is either an array of subform records or an associated module object containing the subform array, such as data.Sales_Order.Ordered_Items.

BlueprintActivationSettings.description: Activation settings for a blueprint, including an array of state remaps (map_states) and a flag indicating whether to move existing records (move_records).

map_states.description: The current version will have active records associated with it, so when the draft is set to be activated, remap data is required, which contains the mapping of the picklist ID of the existing state and the replacing state.

move_records.description: The current version will have active records associated with it, so when the draft is set to be activated, remap data is required (Required).

BlueprintActivationSuccessResponse.description: Response returned upon successful activation of a blueprint. Includes a blueprints array with per-blueprint result details.

blueprints.description: Field: blueprints

BlueprintCloneResponse.description: Represents the response of a Blueprint clone request, containing the clone result for each requested Blueprint.

blueprints.description: Represents the list of clone results. Each object reports the outcome of the clone request for one Blueprint.

BlueprintCloneResultDetails.description: Represents additional details about the clone outcome, including the ID of the cloned Blueprint and the fields that were not copied in the entry criteria, before-transition criteria, or during-transition criteria.

uncopied_before_criteria_fields.description: Represents the fields in the before-transition criteria that were not copied to the cloned Blueprint.

id.description: Represents the ID of the cloned Blueprint.

uncopied_entry_criteria_fields.description: Represents the fields in the Blueprint entry criteria that were not copied to the cloned Blueprint.

uncopied_during_transition_fields.description: Represents the fields in the during-transition criteria that were not copied to the cloned Blueprint.

BlueprintCloneResultEntry.description: Represents the result of a single Blueprint clone operation, including the status, code, message, and details of the outcome.

code.description: Represents the code that indicates the outcome of the clone request for the Blueprint.

message.description: Represents the message that describes the outcome of the clone request for the Blueprint.

status.description: Indicates whether the clone request for the Blueprint was successful.

BlueprintCloneSettings.description: Represents the settings for cloning a Blueprint, including the module, name, clone type, layout and pipeline references, selected field, and state mappings.

layout.description: Specify the layout data of the cloned blueprint (Required)

pipeline.description: Specify the pipeline data of the cloned blueprint

map_states.description: Specify the mapping of states from the existing Blueprint to the cloned Blueprint.

field.description: Specify the field data of the cloned blueprint (Required)

module.description: Represents the API name of the module to which the cloned Blueprint belongs.

name.description: Represents the name of the cloned Blueprint.

type.description: Represents the type of clone to create for the Blueprint, such as a standalone or dependent clone.

BlueprintConnectionSpec.description: Represents the details of a connection between two states in the Blueprint chart.

from.description: Details of the source of the connection (Required)

to.description: Details of target of the connection (Required)

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the connection between two states in the Blueprint chart.

transition.description: Details of the transition mapped with the connection (Required)

BlueprintDeactivationItem.description: Defines per-blueprint options used during the deactivation operation. The exit_records flag indicates whether any record currently in the blueprint should be exited when the blueprint is deactivated.

exit_records.description: Indicates whether the record in the particular blueprint should be exited after the blueprint is deactivated.

BlueprintDeactivationResponse.description: Successful response for a blueprint deactivation request. Returns a blueprints array containing one Blueprint Deactivation Result Item per processed blueprint.

blueprints.description: Field: blueprints

BlueprintDeactivationResultItem.description: Represents the outcome for a single blueprint deactivation. Includes status, code, and message, with details providing structured information about the result.

status.description: Field: status

code.description: Field: code

message.description: Field: message

details.description: Details of the actions

comparator.description: Represents the comparator used to evaluate the criteria field against its configured value.

field.description: Contains field details of criteria

value.description: Represents the value configured for the criteria field used to evaluate the Blueprint entry condition.

webhooks.description: Represents the list of operation results, containing a mix of success and error entries for each webhook deletion attempt.

ButtonAttributesNested1.description: Represents a button attribute entry associated with the webform's form attribute configuration.

name.description: Represents the internal name identifier of the button attribute configuration within the webform.

CadenceDescription.description: Represents the description text of a Cadence.

CadenceEnrollmentType.description: Represents the enrollment type of a Cadence, indicating how records are enrolled.

CadenceID.description: Represents the unique identifier of a Cadence.

CadenceName.description: Represents the name of a Cadence.

CadencesAutomationFieldAttributes.description: Identifies the target CRM field to which a mapping value is applied within an automation rule. The api_name and ID properties must both be supplied and must refer to the same field; a mismatch between the two causes an AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING error. Available fields for a given module can be discovered via GET /settings/fields?module={api_name}.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the target field in the destination module — for example, Subject, Due_Date, or Owner — used to identify the field receiving the mapped value within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, and convert.

id.description: Represents the numeric identifier of the target CRM field. Used in conjunction with the field's API name, both of which must resolve to the same field for a mapping to be valid.

CadencesAutomationFieldMappings.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping used within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call. Each mapping identifies a target field via api_name or ID, declares a type discriminator that determines value interpretation, and supplies a value whose shape varies by type: static supplies a literal value, merge_field supplies a runtime-resolved token string, execution_time supplies a date or datetime offset object, and composite supplies structured participant data for the Events Participants field. The field_mappings array must include all fields the target module requires; omitting any produces a REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND error.

CadencesAutomationLayoutRef.description: PURPOSE: Layout reference for create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call actions. MANDATORY: id (string). Determines field availability and validation rules. GET /settings/layouts?module={api_name} to discover.

id.description: Unique layout ID. Required. Obtain from GET /settings/layouts?module={module_api_name}.

name.description: Display name of the layout. Optional in requests; present in GET responses.

display_label.description: Human-readable label of the layout. Present in GET responses.

CadencesAutomationModuleRef.description: PURPOSE: Module reference used across non-associate actions. At least one of api_name or id required (EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING if neither). If both given, must match (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). GET /settings/modules to discover. Always use full 19-digit module ID.

api_name.description: API name of the module (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Vendors).

id.description: Unique module ID (19-digit format). Always use the full ID as returned by GET /settings/modules - truncated or shortened IDs return INVALID_DATA ('the tabId given seems to be invalid'). Optional in requests if api_name is provided; always present in responses.

CadencesAutomationScheduleCallDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for schedule_call action. Creates a Call record when workflow fires. PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module=Calls for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name: 'Calls', id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include Subject, Call_Type). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool). KEY FIELDS: Subject, Call_Type ('Outbound'|'Inbound'|'Missed'), Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At.

module.description: Target module for the call. Must be the Calls module. Provide either api_name ("Calls") or the Calls module id.

layout.description: Layout to use when creating the Call record. Determines which fields are available and their validation rules. Fetch valid layouts from GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls. The layout.id is required.

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new Call. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Subject"}, "type": "static", "value": "Follow-up"}. Must include all mandatory fields from GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls. Call_Type is system-mandatory (values: "Outbound", "Inbound", "Missed") - omitting returns REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. Common fields: Subject, Call_Type, Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist fields; NOT for DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Phone} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Call_Start_Time and Remind_At; sign required for datetime; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes.

items.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping entry for the new Call record, conforming to the AutomationFieldMappings schema. Each entry identifies a target Call field and specifies the value resolution strategy: static for literal values, merge_field for runtime token substitution, or execution_time for dynamically resolved DateTime and ALARM fields.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the Call record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this schedule call action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

CadencesCompositeFieldMapping.description: Represents a composite-type field mapping used exclusively for the Participants field in the Events module via the add_meeting action. The value carries a structured object that encodes participant data and is not applicable to any other field or automation action type.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Serves as the polymorphic discriminator that identifies this field mapping as a composite mapping; the value must be set to "composite" to select this schema variant.

value.description: Holds the structured composite object that encodes participant data for the Events module Participants field; the shape of this object varies according to the participant type configuration defined for the automation rule.

CadencesCreatedTime.description: Represents the creation date and time of the Cadence, in ISO 8601 format.

CadencesCustomViewInfo.description: Represents the identifier and name of a Custom View.

name.description: Represents the name of the Custom View.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the Custom View.

CadencesDetailsNested.description: Represents the nested details of a Cadence operation result, including follow-up actions and resource identifiers.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the resource associated with the operation.

follow_ups.description: Represents the list of follow-up actions involved in the operation.

items.description: Represents a follow-up action, including its identifier and associated action details.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the follow-up item.

action.description: Represents the action associated with the follow-up item.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the follow-up action.

type.description: Represents the type of the follow-up action.

draft_cadence.description: Represents the draft version of the Cadence associated with the operation.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the draft Cadence.

CadencesExecutionDetailsNested.description: Represents the details of a successful per-record operation result, including the record ID and the associated Cadences.

cadences.description: Specify the list of Cadences associated with the operation result.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the record.

CadencesExecutionTimeFieldMapping.description: Represents an execution_time-type field mapping that computes a date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime by applying a signed offset to a trigger field or the current time. The value carries an ExecutionTimeValue object specifying the period, unit, trigger_field, and optional time or notify_type properties. A plus sign places the result after the trigger; a minus sign places it before. ALARM fields always require minus. Workflow task actions support only days and business_days as period values.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping variant as an execution-time offset. The value is always "execution_time" for this schema and acts as the polymorphic discriminator across the AutomationFieldMappings union.

value.description: Execution-time object specifying how to compute the date/datetime offset from a reference field.

CadencesExecutionTimeValue.description: Represents the offset configuration used by an execution_time mapping to compute a final date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime. Contains period (the time unit granularity), unit (the numeric magnitude expressed as a string integer), and trigger_field (a merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}). Date fields use period, unit, and trigger_field with an implied positive direction. Datetime fields additionally accept sign to control direction. ALARM fields additionally accept time and notify_type, and always require a minus sign. Workflow task actions restrict period to days or business_days.

period.description: The calendar or time unit applied to the offset. Possible values: **days** — counts all calendar days including weekends and holidays; supported by every action type. **business_days** — excludes weekends and requires the organisation's business-day setting to be enabled; supported by all action types. **hours** — available only for create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call. **minutes** — available only for create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call. workflow_tasks accept only **days** or **business_days**.

unit.description: The number of period units to offset from the trigger date, supplied as a non-negative integer string (for example, "1", "30"). Passing "0" produces a same-day result, such as scheduling a Remind_At on the same day as the due date.

sign.description: The direction of the offset relative to the trigger date. Possible values: **plus** — places the computed value after the trigger (for example, a due date two days after record creation). **minus** — places the computed value before the trigger (for example, a reminder one day before the due date). For datetime fields (data_type=datetime) a value is expected; omitting it returns a DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error. For date-only fields (data_type=date) the value defaults to **plus** when absent. When targeting Remind_At (data_type=ALARM), **minus** is the only applicable direction.

trigger_field.description: The reference date or datetime field from which the offset is measured. Accepts a merge-field token that resolves to a Date or DateTime field on the parent module (for example, "${!Leads.Modified_Time}", "${!Tasks.Due_Date}"), or the reserved constant "${CURRENTTIME}" to use the automation execution timestamp. When computing a Remind_At (ALARM) value, "${!Tasks.Due_Date}" is the typical anchor.

time.description: The time-of-day component of the computed value, expressed in 24-hour HH:mm format (for example, "13:00", "01:30"). Applies when the target field carries data type datetime or ALARM (as reported by GET /settings/fields). Supplying this property for a date-only field (data_type=date) produces a validation error.

notify_type.description: The notification channel used to deliver the reminder. Applies exclusively when the target field carries data type ALARM (i.e., Remind_At); date and datetime fields do not use this property. Possible values: **popup** — triggers an in-app notification. **email** — sends a message to the task owner. **emailandpopup** — delivers both simultaneously.
