CadencesItemNested.description: Represents a single Cadence operation result, including the result code, message, status, and details.

code.description: Represents the result code for the individual Cadence record operation.

message.description: Represents the result message for the individual Cadence record operation.

status.description: Represents the result status for the individual Cadence record operation.

CadencesMergeFieldMapping.description: Represents a merge_field-type mapping whose value is resolved at execution time by substituting token references with live field data. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Applies to text-based fields such as Subject, Description, and custom text fields. Targeting owner or lookup fields with this type produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error; those fields require a static mapping using an object with a numeric identifier and an optional name. Multiple tokens may be chained with surrounding text for multi-line fields, while single-value fields such as email or URL accept exactly one token.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping strategy for this field assignment. The value must be `merge_field`, which instructs the automation engine to resolve the field value dynamically from a merge field token at execution time rather than from a static literal.

value.description: A string containing one or more ${!...} merge-field tokens resolved at runtime.

allow_agent_user.description: Controls whether agent users are eligible for record assignment. Possible values: **true** — agent users are included in the assignment pool alongside standard users. **false** — agent users are excluded from assignment. Applies to mapping types role, group, profile, merge_field, and criteria. Does not apply to user or assignment_rule types.

CadencesMergeFieldStringValue.description: Represents the string value carried by a merge_field mapping, containing one or more runtime-resolved token references. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), lookup traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Tokens may be combined with surrounding text for multi-line field targets. Fields that hold a single typed value such as email or URL accept exactly one token.

CadencesNested.description: Represents a Cadence in the operation result, including its unique ID and name.

name.description: Represents the name of the Cadence.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the Cadence.

CadencesRecordsCountSuccess.description: Represents the record count data for a Cadence, including the Cadence identifier and the number of enrolled records.

count.description: Represents the number of records currently enrolled in the Cadence.

cadences.description: Represents the identifier and name details of the Cadence.

CadencesStaticArrayValue.description: Represents an array of string values used as the static value for multiselectpicklist fields, where each element corresponds to an available picklist option. Valid option labels are retrievable from the GET /settings/fields endpoint filtered by data_type=multiselectpicklist.

items.description: A single picklist option string to include in the multi-select field value. Each entry corresponds to one selectable option as defined for the target field in Zoho CRM.

CadencesStaticFieldMapping.description: Represents a static-type mapping that assigns a literal value directly to the target field at execution time. The value shape varies by field data type: a plain string for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields (numeric values expressed as strings); an array of strings for multiselectpicklist fields; and an object containing ID and name for ownerlookup fields. Date, datetime, and ALARM fields do not support this type — use execution_time instead, as static on those fields produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. Fields marked unique in the module settings also require merge_field rather than static for create_record actions.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping strategy for this field assignment. The value must be `static`, which instructs the automation engine to assign a fixed, literal value to the target field at execution time rather than resolving it dynamically.

value.description: The literal value assigned to the target field at automation execution time. The expected shape is determined by the target field data_type, discoverable via GET /settings/fields?module={module}. For most field types, supply a string (for example, "High", "Not Started", "1234"). For multi-select picklist fields (data_type: multiselectpicklist), supply an array of option strings. For fields that reference an entity such as an owner or layout (data_type: ownerlookup), supply an object with at minimum the entity ID.

CadencesStaticObjectValue.description: Represents an object value used as the static value for ownerlookup and layout fields, containing an ID that identifies the target user or layout and an optional name that the server resolves from the ID when not supplied. Typically used to assign record ownership by providing the user ID.

id.description: The system identifier of the referenced entity, such as a user or layout record. This value drives entity resolution by the automation engine and must be provided when the target field references an entity.

name.description: The display name of the referenced entity, such as a user full name or a layout label. When omitted from a request payload, the server resolves and populates this property from the supplied ID. The property is present in all GET responses.

CadencesStaticStringValue.description: Represents a plain string value used as the static value for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields. Numeric values are expressed as strings rather than numeric literals. Picklist values must exactly match one of the options defined for the field.

CadencesTaskTypeFollowupActionRequestObj.description: Represents the follow-up step configuration for a task action in a Cadence.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the task action.

type.description: Represents the action type for this follow-up step. Example: "tasks".

CanvasSizeSpec.description: Represents the dimensions of the Blueprint canvas.

width.description: Represents the width of the Blueprint canvas.

height.description: Represents the height of the Blueprint canvas.

value.description: Represents the email address to include in the CC list for the mail merge email.

ChatNotificationActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that sends a chat notification to an integrated chat service, such as Slack or Zoho Cliq, when the workflow rule condition is triggered.

name.description: Represents the display name of the ChatNotification action. This field is required.

type.description: Represents chat service type. Each service has a limit of 1 action per rule.

ChecklistItemEntryAlternate.description: Represents an alternate checklist item used in a during input, including the sequence position, name, and optionality of the item.

sequence.description: Represents the sequence position of the checklist item within the checklist associated with the during field of the transition.

optional.description: Indicates whether the checklist item is optional. Possible values: **true**, **false**.

ChecklistItemsLimitExceededError.description: Represents the validation error returned when the number of checklist items provided for a checklist field in a blueprint transition exceeds the permitted limit. Contains the error code **DEPENDENT_MISMATCH**, the error message, the response status, and field-level error details, including the maximum permitted number of checklist items.

code.description: Represents the error code returned when the checklist item limit is exceeded. Possible values: **DEPENDENT_MISMATCH**. Example: "DEPENDENT_MISMATCH".

details.description: Contains the error details with field-level validation information about the checklist item limit violation.

dependee.description: Contains details of the dependent checklist item associated with the checklist item limit validation error.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the dependee field associated with the checklist item limit validation error.

dependee_value.description: Represents the value of the dependee field associated with the checklist item limit validation error.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path of the dependee field that caused the checklist item limit validation error.

maximum_length.description: Indicates the maximum permitted number of checklist items whose limit was exceeded.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the checklist field whose item limit was exceeded.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path of the field that caused the checklist item limit validation error.

message.description: Represents the error message returned when the checklist item limit is exceeded. Possible values: **You can provide upto 10 checklist items**. Example: "You can provide upto 10 checklist items".

status.description: Indicates the response status of the API call. Possible values: **error**. Example: "error".

ChecklistOptionLengthExceededError.description: Represents the validation error returned when the name of a checklist option in a blueprint transition exceeds the allowed character limit. Contains the error code **INVALID_DATA**, the error message, the response status, and field-level error details, including the maximum number of characters allowed for a checklist option.

code.description: Represents the error code returned when the checklist option length is exceeded. Possible values: **INVALID_DATA**. Example: "INVALID_DATA".

details.description: Contains the error details with field-level validation information for the checklist option length error.

maximum_length.description: Indicates the maximum number of characters allowed for a checklist option.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field that caused the checklist option length validation error.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path of the checklist option that exceeded the allowed character length.

message.description: Represents the error message returned when a checklist option exceeds the allowed character limit. Possible values: **You can provide upto 140 checklists option character limit**. Example: "You can provide upto 140 checklists option character limit".

status.description: Indicates the response status of the API call. Possible values: **error**. Example: "error".

ChecklistTitleLengthExceededError.description: Represents the validation error returned when a checklist title in a blueprint transition exceeds the maximum allowed length. Contains the error code **INVALID_DATA**, the error message, the response status, and field-level error details, including the maximum number of characters allowed for the checklist title.

code.description: Represents the error code returned when the checklist title exceeds the allowed length. Possible values: **INVALID_DATA**. Example: "INVALID_DATA".

details.description: Contains the error details with field-level validation information for the checklist title that exceeded the allowed length.

maximum_length.description: Indicates the maximum number of characters allowed for the checklist title.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field that failed validation.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path of the field in the request that failed validation.

message.description: Represents the error message returned when the checklist title exceeds the allowed length. Possible values: **You can provide upto 30 characters.**. Example: "You can provide upto 30 characters.".

status.description: Indicates the response status of the API call. Possible values: **error**. Example: "error".

ChecklistsNested.description: Represents a checklist item for the transition. Each key is dynamic and takes a checklist question configured for the transition, and its Boolean value stores the answer to that question.

ChildParallelTransitionActionsNotAllowed.description: Represents the error returned when after actions are added to a child parallel transition, which is not allowed. Contains the error code **NOT_ALLOWED**, the error message, the response status, and details identifying the disallowed field in the request.

code.description: Represents the error code returned when the operation is not permitted. Possible values: **NOT_ALLOWED**. Example: "NOT_ALLOWED".

details.description: Contains the error details identifying the field that is not allowed.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the disallowed field.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path of the disallowed field in the request.

message.description: Represents the error message returned when blueprint transition after actions cannot be added to a child parallel transition. Possible values: **Blueprint transition after actions cannot be added to a child parallel transition**. Example: "Blueprint transition after actions cannot be added to a child parallel transition".

status.description: Indicates the response status of the API call. Possible values: **error**. Example: "error".

CloneProfileActionResponse.description: Response of a successful profile clone action.

code.description: Operation result code. Possible values: `SUCCESS`. Example: "SUCCESS".

details.description: Represents the additional details returned with the clone operation result.

CodeFileNonDelugeCompilationErrors.description: Represents the error response returned when a non-Deluge function's code fails to compile during a publish attempt. Contains the error code **COMPILATION_ERROR**, along with details that include the file, line, and message for each compilation error.

code.description: Represents the error code for the response. Possible values: **COMPILATION_ERROR** - Indicates the function's code failed to compile. Example: "COMPILATION_ERROR".

details.description: Represents the error details for the compilation failure, including the list of individual errors found in the code.

errors.description: The list of compilation errors found in the function code.

items.description: Represents a single compilation error entry, containing the file path, line number, and error message.

file.description: Relative file path within the code package where the error occurred.

line.description: Line number in the source file where the error occurred.

message.description: The description of the compilation error.

The error message returned when a function publish operation fails due to compilation errors. Possible values: **function publish failed due to compilation errors** - Indicates that the function could not be published because the code contains compilation errors. Example: "function publish failed due to compilation errors".

status.description: The status of the response when a compilation error occurs. Possible values: **error** - Indicates that the operation failed due to a compilation error. Example: "error".

CommonSourceDetail.description: Represents the details of the common sources of a transition.

state.description: State details of the common source

CommonSourceStateDetail.description: Represents the state details of a common source.

name.description: Represents the name of the common source state.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the common source state.

ComparatorValueMismatch.description: Error schema returned when the comparator value itself does not satisfy the dependency validation rules imposed by the dependee field. Carries error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and includes details identifying the criterion field with the invalid comparator value, its dependee field (api_name, json_path), and the criterion field own api_name and json_path.

code.description: Error code identifying the comparator dependency mismatch condition. Possible values: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Example: "DEPENDENT_MISMATCH".

details.description: Object containing diagnostic detail about the dependency mismatch, including the criterion field with the invalid comparator value (api_name, json_path) and the dependee field that imposed the violated validation rule (dependee.api_name, dependee.json_path).

dependee.description: Identifies the dependee field whose value determines the validation rules applied to the comparator of the criterion field in error. Contains the API name and JSON path of the dependee field.

api_name.description: API name of the dependee field whose value imposed the violated validation rule on the criterion field comparator.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the dependee field within the request body.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field whose comparator value does not satisfy the dependency rule imposed by the dependee field.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field with the invalid comparator value within the request body.

message.description: Descriptive message providing details about the comparator value mismatch error.

status.description: Status of the response indicating the outcome of the request. Possible values: error. Example: "error".

name.description: Represents the name of the component type.

standalone_component.description: Indicates whether the component can be used as a standalone component. Possible values: **true** - The component can be used as a standalone component. **false** - The component cannot be used as a standalone component.

standalone_component.description: Indicates whether the component can be used as a standalone component. Possible values: **true** - The component can be used as a standalone component. **false** - The component cannot be used as a standalone component.

ConditionNested.description: Represents the condition that determines when an AB test ends, including the condition type, period, unit, and remaining time.

visitors.description: Represents the target number of visitor sessions required to complete the AB test when the condition type is **visits**.

unit.description: Represents the numeric value of the test condition, such as the number of days, weeks, months, or visitor sessions.

period.description: Represents the time period unit used for a duration-based test condition. Possible values: **days** - The duration is measured in days. **weeks** - The duration is measured in weeks. **months** - The duration is measured in months.

from.description: Represents the start date and time of the AB test when the condition type is **range**.

to.description: Represents the end date and time of the AB test when the condition type is **range**.

type.description: Represents the type of condition used to determine when the AB test ends. Possible values: **duration** - The test runs for a fixed period. **range** - The test runs between a start and end date. **visits** - The test ends after a target number of visitor sessions.

remaining.description: Represents the number of days or visits remaining before the AB test condition is met.

ConditionsNestedSchema.description: Represents a single condition within a workflow rule that defines which records are evaluated and what actions are executed when the criteria are met.

sequence_number.description: Represents the execution order of this condition within the workflow rule, starting from one. Must be unique across all conditions in the rule.

instant_actions.description: Actions to execute immediately when the condition is met. At least one of instant_actions or scheduled_actions must be present - returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND if both are absent.

scheduled_actions.description: Actions to execute after a configured delay. Scheduled actions require both the trigger and the action type to support scheduling.

criteria_details.description: Record matching criteria for this condition. When provided, criteria_details must be a JSON object and cannot be null. To match all records, pass an object with criteria set to null, but do not set criteria_details itself to null. This field is required for certain trigger types, such as related module triggers like Notes on Leads. The convert action type requires criteria_details.criteria to be a non-null filter object. Omit criteria_details entirely or pass criteria as null to match all records when the trigger does not require specific criteria and no convert action is present.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the condition. Auto-generated on creation. Required on PUT to identify which condition to update.

_delete.description: Indicates that this condition should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

ContactRoleSuccessSchema.description: Represents the result of a successful contact role operation.

code.description: Represents the status code of the operation. **Possible values:** - **SUCCESS** - The contact role operation completed successfully. Example: "SUCCESS".

details.description: Represents the details of the contact role for the create or update operation.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the contact role.

message.description: Represents the message describing the result of the operation.

status.description: Represents the overall status of the operation. **Possible values:** - **success** - The contact role operation completed successfully. Example: "success".

ConversionRequest.description: Configuration for converting a single lead

overwrite.description: Determines whether to overwrite the Account Name in a Contact when converting a Lead. For example, If a Contact is already linked to an Account but the Lead’s Company name is different, enabling this option will update the Contact’s Account to match the Lead’s Company. **Possible values:** false (default) : Keeps the existing Account Name in the Contact unchanged. true : Updates the Contact’s associated Account Name if it differs from the Company name in the Lead.

notify_lead_owner.description: If true, sends email notification to the Lead owner about the conversion. Default is false.

notify_new_entity_owner.description: If true, notifies the owner(s) of newly created Contact, Account, or Deal records. Default is false.

add_to_existing_record.description: When true, associates the Lead with an existing Account or Contact instead of creating duplicates.

assign_to.description: Assigns a record owner for the new Contact and Account after lead conversion. It ensures that the converted lead is assigned to a specific user in Zoho CRM. Use the [Users API](users.yaml#$.paths./users/bulk.get) to retrieve valid User IDs.

id.description: Zoho CRM user ID (int64 as string)

carry_over_tags.description: Configuration for carrying over tags from the Lead to converted records

Contacts.description: Tag carryover settings for Contact records.

Accounts.description: Tag carryover settings for Account records

Deals.description: Tag carryover settings for Deal records

ConversionScheduled.description: Lead conversion scheduled for background processing

code.description: Status code indicating conversion was scheduled Example: "SCHEDULED".

message.description: Message that summarizes the scheduling result for the lead conversion request.

status.description: Overall status Example: "success".

details.description: Job details

job_id.description: Unique job identifier

data.description: Array containing the scheduled job information

code.description: Status code indicating successful conversion Example: "SUCCESS".

message.description: Message that summarizes the outcome of the lead conversion request.

status.description: Overall status of the conversion operation Example: "success".

details.description: Details of created records including their IDs and names.

oneOf.description: No Deal was created during conversion

Deals.description: Deal record information, or null if no Deal was created

oneOf.description: No Account was created during conversion

Accounts.description: Account record information, or null if no Account was created

data.description: Array of conversion results

ConvertActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that converts a record to another module type, such as converting a lead to a contact, account, and deal.

name.description: Represents the display name of the Convert action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a Convert action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Configuration for converting records. This action is only available when the trigger module is Leads, Quotes, or Sales_Orders. The convert action requires non-null criteria in the condition; null criteria will result in a dependent field missing error. For Leads conversion, the following fields are mandatory: add_to_existing_contact, add_to_existing_account, apply_restriction, and change_owner which is an object containing the apply_assignment_threshold flag. Key optional fields include create_deal for creating a deal, carry_tags which is an array of module references and not a boolean, field_mappings with a maximum of 25 entries, move_attachment_to for specifying a target module, contact_role which is applicable only when create_deal is true, and convert_to which is used for Quotes and SalesOrders conversions. Example configuration for a Leads conversion without creating a deal.

related_details.description: Optional. For convert, related_details is not typically used. Applicable sub-fields: best_time (for email_notifications only), followup_details (for tasks only), lookup_field (for field_updates only).

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the Convert action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

ConvertMappingModule.description: Represents the convert mapping configuration that defines how record field values are transferred across modules during a record conversion operation.

oneOf.description: Represents the lead conversion mapping configuration, specifying how fields from the Leads module are mapped to corresponding fields in the Contacts, Deals, and Accounts modules.
Represents the Quotes module conversion mapping configuration, specifying how fields from a Quote are mapped to corresponding fields in the Invoices and Sales_Orders modules.
Represents the Sales Order conversion mapping configuration, specifying how fields from a Sales Order are mapped to corresponding fields in the Invoices module.
Represents a null or empty convert mapping object indicating that no field conversion mapping is configured for this field.

ConvertMappingTargetModule.description: Represents the target layout configuration for a module involved in a record conversion operation, identifying the layout by its API name and display label.

display_label.description: Represents the label of the target module's layout as it appears in the CRM interface during record conversion.

name.description: Represents the unique API name that programmatically identifies the target layout within the conversion mapping configuration.

id.description: Unique identifier of the target layout.

ConvertMappingTargetModuleWithFields.description: Represents the target layout configuration for a module involved in a record conversion, including field-level mapping details that define how source field values are transferred.

display_label.description: Represents the label of the target module's layout as it appears in the CRM interface during record conversion. This variant is accompanied by field-level mapping details.

name.description: Represents the unique API name that programmatically identifies the target layout within the conversion mapping configuration. This variant is accompanied by field-level mapping details.

id.description: Unique identifier of the target layout.

fields.description: Contains the collection of field configurations belonging to the target module's layout that participate in the record conversion process, each describing how a specific field is handled during the transfer of data.

items.description: Represents a single field entry within the target module's layout, capturing the field's label and any constraints that apply when transferring record data during conversion.

api_name.description: API name of the field in the target module.

field_label.description: Represents the name of the field as it appears in the CRM interface within the target module's layout during record conversion.

id.description: Unique identifier of the field.

required.description: Indicates whether the field must be populated for the record conversion to proceed successfully. Possible values: `true` — the field is mandatory and a value must be provided before conversion can complete; `false` — the field is optional and may be left unpopulated during conversion.

CoqlApiName.description: API name of the resource. It will start with alphabets and can contain alphanumeric characters and underscores.

CoqlFieldSchema.description: Represents a CRM field configuration in the Zoho CRM organization, including its metadata, display properties, and operational settings.

oneOf.description: Represents the associated module details for the field, such as a subform module.

associated_module.description: Represents the module associated with this field, such as a subform module.

webhook.description: Indicates whether webhook notifications are enabled for changes to this field. Possible values: **true** - Webhook notifications are enabled for this field. **false** - Webhook notifications are not enabled for this field.

operation_type.description: Represents the set of operation types permitted for this field across different contexts.

web_update.description: Indicates whether the field can be updated via the web interface. Possible values: **true** - The field can be updated via the web interface. **false** - The field cannot be updated via the web interface.

api_create.description: Indicates whether the field can be set during record creation via the API. Possible values: **true** - The field can be set when creating records via the API. **false** - The field cannot be set during API record creation.

web_create.description: Indicates whether the field can be set during record creation via the web interface. Possible values: **true** - The field can be set when creating records via the web interface. **false** - The field cannot be set during web record creation.

api_update.description: Indicates whether the field can be updated via the API. Possible values: **true** - The field can be updated via the API. **false** - The field cannot be updated via the API.

colour_code_enabled_by_system.description: Indicates whether a color code is enabled by the system for this field. Possible values: **true** - A color code is enabled by the system. **false** - No color code is enabled by the system.

field_label.description: Represents the display label of the field as shown in the Zoho CRM interface.

oneOf.description: Represents the tooltip configuration for the field, including icon name and display text.

name.description: Represents the icon name used for the tooltip.

value.description: Represents the tooltip text displayed to users when they hover over the field.

tooltip.description: Represents the tooltip configuration for the field, if a tooltip is configured to provide additional guidance to users.

oneOf.description: Represents the additional display format properties for the field.

split.description: Represents the split configuration value for a phone-type field.

radio_display_type.description: Represents the display type for a radio button field.

display_format_properties.description: Represents the additional display format properties for the field, applicable when the field has specific rendering requirements.

type.description: Represents the field type classification.

field_read_only.description: Indicates whether the field is configured as read-only. Possible values: **true** - The field is read-only and cannot be modified. **false** - The field can be modified.

oneOf.description: Represents the list of property names that can be customized for this field.

items.description: Represents a customizable property name for the field.

customizable_properties.description: Represents the list of properties for this field that can be customized by the organization.

display_label.description: Represents the display label shown to users for this field.

read_only.description: Indicates whether the field is read-only in the current context. Possible values: **true** - The field is read-only. **false** - The field is editable.

oneOf.description: Represents the association details for a lookup-type field, including the related and lookup field configurations.

related_field.description: Represents the related field linked to this association.

lookup_field.description: Represents the configuration of the lookup field in this association.

association_details.description: Represents the association configuration for lookup-type fields, including the related field and lookup field details.

oneOf.description: Represents the multi-module lookup configuration, including display label, API name, and associated modules.

display_label.description: Represents the display label of the multi-module lookup field.

modules.description: Represents the list of modules that this multi-module lookup field can reference.

items.description: Represents a module entry available for selection in the multi-module lookup.

module_name.description: Represents the API name of the module available in the multi-module lookup.

multi_module_lookup.description: Represents the multi-module lookup configuration for the field, applicable when the field can reference records from multiple modules.

oneOf.description: Represents the creation timestamp of the field, in ISO 8601 date-time format.

created_time.description: Represents the creation timestamp of the field, in ISO 8601 format.

filterable.description: Indicates whether the field can be used as a filter criterion. Possible values: **true** - The field supports filtering. **false** - The field does not support filtering.

visible.description: Indicates whether the field is visible to users in the Zoho CRM interface. Possible values: **true** - The field is visible. **false** - The field is hidden.

view_type.description: Represents the view type configuration for the field, indicating which form views support this field.

view.description: Indicates whether the field is visible in the detail view. Possible values: **true** - The field is visible in the detail view. **false** - The field is not visible in the detail view.

edit.description: Indicates whether the field is available in the edit form. Possible values: **true** - The field is available in the edit form. **false** - The field is not available in the edit form.

quick_create.description: Indicates whether the field is available in the quick-create form. Possible values: **true** - The field is available in the quick-create form. **false** - The field is not available in the quick-create form.

create.description: Indicates whether the field is available in the create form. Possible values: **true** - The field is available in the create form. **false** - The field is not available in the create form.

separator.description: Indicates whether the field acts as a visual separator in the layout. Possible values: **true** - The field is a separator. **false** - The field is a regular field.

searchable.description: Indicates whether the field can be used in search queries. Possible values: **true** - The field is searchable. **false** - The field is not searchable.

history_tracking_enabled.description: Indicates whether history tracking is enabled for this field. Possible values: **true** - History tracking is enabled. **false** - History tracking is not enabled.

oneOf.description: Represents the external field configuration, including visibility and type.

show.description: Indicates whether the external field is visible. Possible values: **true** - The external field is visible. **false** - The external field is hidden.

type.description: Represents the type of external field association, such as **org** for organization-level fields.

external.description: Represents the external field configuration, applicable when the field is associated with an external system.

oneOf.description: Represents the parent field configuration, including API name, display name, and ID.

name.description: Represents the display name of the parent field.

parent_field.description: Represents the parent field configuration, applicable when this field is a sub-field within a parent field such as an address.

unique.description: Represents the uniqueness constraint configuration for the field.

case_sensitive.description: Indicates whether the uniqueness check for this field is case-sensitive. Possible values: **true** - The uniqueness check is case-sensitive. **false** - The uniqueness check is case-insensitive.

enable_colour_code.description: Indicates whether color coding is enabled for this field. Possible values: **true** - Color coding is enabled for the field. **false** - Color coding is not enabled for the field.

oneOf.description: Represents the list of child field entries within an address field configuration.

items.description: Represents a child field entry within an address field configuration.

sequence_number.description: Represents the display sequence of the child field within the address field.

field.description: Represents the configuration details of the child field.

name.description: Represents the name of the child field.

child_fields.description: Represents the list of child fields associated with this field, applicable for address-type fields.

oneOf.description: Represents the list of picklist options configured for the field.

items.description: Represents a picklist option for the field.

display_value.description: Represents the display label shown to users for this picklist option.

sequence_number.description: Represents the display order of the picklist option in the list.

reference_value.description: Represents the reference value used internally for this picklist option.

colour_code.description: Represents the color code associated with this picklist option.

actual_value.description: Represents the actual stored value of the picklist option.

type.description: Represents the type classification of this picklist option.

pick_list_values.description: Represents the list of available picklist option values for the field, if the field is of a picklist type.

system_mandatory.description: Indicates whether the field is marked as mandatory by the system. Possible values: **true** - The field is system-mandatory and cannot be set as optional. **false** - The field is not system-mandatory.

oneOf.description: Represents the privacy settings for the field.

restricted.description: Indicates whether access to the private field is restricted. Possible values: **true** - Access to the field is restricted. **false** - Access to the field is not restricted.

type.description: Represents the privacy level of the field, such as **High**.

export.description: Indicates whether the private field can be included in data exports. Possible values: **true** - The field can be exported. **false** - The field is restricted from exports.

private.description: Represents the privacy configuration for the field, if the field is marked as private.

virtual_field.description: Indicates whether the field is a virtual field that is computed and not stored directly. Possible values: **true** - The field is virtual. **false** - The field is a stored field.

json_type.description: Represents the JSON data type used to represent the field value.

oneOf.description: Represents the encryption settings for the field, including mode and status.

mode.description: Represents the encryption mode applied to this field.

oneOf.description: Represents the encryption case configuration applied to this field.

encrypt_case.description: Represents the encryption case configuration applied to this field.

status.description: Represents the current encryption status of the field.

crypt.description: Represents the encryption configuration for the field, if data encryption is enabled.

oneOf.description: Represents the allowed numeric range configuration for the field.

from.description: Represents the minimum allowed value for the field.

to.description: Represents the maximum allowed value for the field.

range.description: Represents the allowed value range for the field, applicable when the field enforces a numeric range.

sort_order.description: Sort order configuration for fetched records. order_by_name is always required. When order_by_name is 'not_sort', order_by_field must not be present. Otherwise, order_by_field is required and its 'id' key must be provided

CreateRecordActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that creates a new record in a specified CRM module when the workflow rule condition is triggered.

name.description: Represents the display name of the CreateRecord action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a CreateRecord action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Configuration for the create_record action. Requires a module, a layout, and one to twenty-five field mappings that supply values for the new record fields, using a static value, a merge field, an execution-time offset, or a composite value. All fields marked mandatory by the layout must be included. Optionally restricts creation to prevent duplicate records.

related_details.description: Optional. For create_record, related_details is not typically used. Applicable sub-fields: best_time (for email_notifications only), followup_details (for tasks only), lookup_field (for field_updates only).

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the CreateRecord action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

DecisionCreateDetails.description: Represents the details configuration object for a kiosk decision state. Contains the path definitions, filter conditions, and criteria groupings that determine the branching logic.

path_details.description: Represents the list of decision paths the kiosk can follow. Each path includes filter conditions that are evaluated to determine the routing; the default fallback path may have null filter conditions.

DecisionCriteriaGrouping.description: Represents a single condition grouping evaluated as part of a kiosk decision state. Defines the data source type, evaluation value, and optional criteria details for one logical condition.

sequence_number.description: The source for the criteria evaluation . Possible values: current_record - Criteria evaluated against the current record. get_record - Criteria evaluated based on whether the Get Records response contains data or not. kiosk_fields - Criteria evaluated against the screen fields or action fields from Kiosk. loop_record - Evaluates a field from a loop record.

type.description: Represents the data source used for condition evaluation. Possible values:current_record - Evaluates a field from the current CRM record. Possible values: get_record - Evaluates a field from a get_record result. kiosk_fields - Evaluates a kiosk screen field. data_hub - Evaluates a data hub field. created_record - Evaluates a field from a record created earlier in the kiosk. loop_record - Evaluates a field from a loop record.

resource.description: The resource object identifies the specific data resource that should be used when evaluating the condition. This object is primarily used when the condition type refers to external data sources such as records retrieved using a GetRecord configuration or records created earlier in the kiosk execution. The resource object ensures that the decision condition references the correct record source.

value.description: Indicates whether the evaluated field must contain data. Possible values: ${NOTEMPTY} - The field must have a value. ${EMPTY} - The field must be empty.

criteria.description: The actual comparison logic for this criteria grouping. Supports both simple field-value comparisons (via SimpleFilterCriterionRequest) and nested grouped conditions (via GroupedFilterCriterionRequest). Defined in Criterion.json. Note: The only possible types for the 'value' will be 'value' and 'field' (If you want to compare with any field in the Kiosk itself, you should send the type as 'field' and the format will be <kiosk_api_name>.<screen_field_api_name> in case referring to Kiosk's screen field. Example: 'criteria': {'field': { 'api_name': 'Screen_2_Single_Line_2', 'id': '2296900000013105115', 'field_label': 'Single Line 2', 'data_type': 'text'}, 'comparator': 'equal', 'value': { 'api_name': 'Bug2.Screen_2_Single_Line_2', 'id': '2296900000013105115' },'type': 'field' }. If the type is just 'value', then a simple string is used for comparison. Strictly follow this pattern for Kiosk's criteria overriding any discrepancies in Criterion.json.

DecisionFilterConditions.description: Represents the filter conditions that determine whether a decision path is taken. Contains a logical pattern and a list of criteria groupings that must be evaluated.

pattern.description: Represents the logical expression that combines multiple criteria groupings. Each number references a criteria grouping's sequence number, and logical operators such as **and** and **or** determine how conditions are combined. For example, (1and2) requires both grouping 1 and grouping 2 to be satisfied.

criteria_groupings.description: Represents the list of conditions evaluated as part of the decision state. Each grouping defines one logical condition, and its position is referenced by the pattern field.

DecisionPathDetails.description: Represents a single decision path within a kiosk decision state. Each path includes a name, a default flag, and filter conditions that determine whether the path is taken.

name.description: Represents the display name of the decision path, used to identify the branch during configuration.

default.description: Indicates whether this path is the default fallback path. When set to **true**, the filter_conditions may be null, and the kiosk follows this path if no other path's conditions are satisfied. Possible values: true - This path is the default fallback. false - This path requires filter conditions to be met. values:\\ntrue - This path is the default fallback.\\nfalse - This path requires filter conditions to be met."

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the decision path, generated by the system and used when referencing or updating the path configuration.

filter_conditions.description: Represents the conditions that must be satisfied for this decision path to be taken. For the default fallback path, this value may be null. For all other paths, the object must include a pattern and criteria_groupings.

oneOf.description: Represents the null variant of filter_conditions, permitted only when the path is the default fallback path.

allOf.description: Represents the constraint block that requires filter_conditions to be a valid object for all non-default decision paths.

DecisionResource.description: Represents the data resource used when evaluating a decision condition. Contains the identifier and name of the get_record or created-record configuration referenced by the condition.

name.description: Represents the display name of the referenced resource used in the decision condition.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the resource — a get_record or created-record configuration — used when evaluating the decision condition.

Example: "The module or layout of this transition is different from the blueprint".

status.description: Represents the status of the response. Possible values: error - Indicates that the request could not be completed due to an error. Example: "error".

oneOf.description: Represents the variant of DependentMismatchDetails in which the expected data type for the dependent field is conveyed through expected_data_type.

expected_data_type.description: Represents the data type expected for the dependent field given the parent field's current value.

DependentMismatchPipelineStateError.description: Represents the error returned when the given state does not belong to the specified pipeline.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path of the dependee field.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the invalid field.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path of the invalid field.

message.description: Represents the error message returned when the given state option does not belong to the specified pipeline. Example: "The given state option does not belong to the specified pipeline".

status.description: Represents the status of the response. Possible values: error - Indicates that the request could not be completed due to an error. Example: "error".

dependency_error.description: Contains additional context about the error.

DirectRecipientEmails.description: Represents a recipient configuration that uses explicit email addresses to specify notification targets. Provide one or more addresses in the details.emails array.

type.description: Represents the recipient type for this configuration. Possible values: emails - Indicates that recipients are specified using explicit email addresses. Example: "emails".

details.description: Represents the details object containing the email addresses for this recipient.

emails.description: Represents the list of explicit email addresses to notify for this recipient.

resource.description: Represents the resource reference for this recipient type. Not applicable for direct email address recipients.

associated_to.description: Represents the associated resource for this recipient type. Not applicable for direct email address recipients.

DirectRecipientGroup.description: Represents a recipient resolved from a CRM user group, used when all members of a group should receive an email notification. Group IDs can be retrieved from the GET /settings/groups endpoint. Not supported in the recipients.to field when bulk_email is true.

type.description: Represents the recipient type for this group recipient. Possible values: group - Indicates that the recipient is resolved from a CRM user group. Example: "group".

resource.description: Group resource (name/id) from Zoho CRM Groups API.

details.description: Represents additional recipient details. Not applicable for group recipients.

associated_to.description: Represents the associated record for this recipient. Not applicable for group recipients.

DirectRecipientMergeField.description: Represents a recipient resolved dynamically from a merge field, where the recipient address depends on the triggering record and is resolved at runtime. Merge field recipients fall into two categories: INTERNAL — fields resolving to CRM users, such as ${!Module.Owner} or ${!Module.Created_By}, for which from_address must not be provided and defaults to the first registered email address; and EXTERNAL — fields resolving to email-type fields (ui_type=25), such as ${!Module.Email} or ${!Module.Lookup.Email}, for which from_address is required. Use module and field metadata APIs to retrieve valid field API names.

type.description: Represents the recipient type for this entry. Possible values: merge_field - Indicates that the recipient address is resolved dynamically from a record field at runtime. Example: "merge_field".

details.description: Represents the merge-field details used to resolve the recipient address at runtime, including the field API name and an optional identifier.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the merge field used to resolve the recipient address. Sample references: ${!{module_API_name}.{field_API_name}} for direct fields, or ${!{module_API_name}.{lookup_APIname}.{field_API_name}} for lookup fields.

id.description: Represents the identifier of the merge field used to resolve the recipient.

resource.description: Represents the resource associated with the recipient. Not applicable for merge_field recipients; this field is always null.

associated_to.description: Represents the associated entity for the recipient. Not applicable for merge_field recipients; this field is always null.

DirectRecipientProfile.description: Represents a notification recipient resolved by a CRM profile, used to notify all users sharing a specific profile or permission level. Refer to the GET /settings/profiles endpoint to retrieve valid profile IDs. For private (team) modules, set the `associated_to` field to `team_module`.

type.description: Represents the recipient type for this notification recipient definition. Possible values: profile - The recipient is resolved by a CRM profile, notifying all users who share that profile. Example: "profile".

resource.description: Profile resource (name/id) from Zoho CRM Profiles API.

details.description: Represents additional recipient details. This field is not applicable for profile recipients and is always null.

associated_to.description: Indicates whether the notification module is a private (team) module. Set to `team_module` when the notification targets a private module. Leave null for standard modules. Possible values: team_module - The notification module is a private (team) module. Example: "team_module".

DirectRecipientRole.description: Represents a recipient resolved by a CRM role, used to notify all users assigned to a specific role. The role identifier must be retrieved from the GET /settings/roles endpoint. This recipient type is not supported in the recipients.to field when bulk_email is true.

type.description: Represents the recipient type for this role-based recipient entry. Possible values: role - Identifies the recipient as resolved by a CRM role, sending notifications to all users assigned to that role. Example: "role".

resource.description: Role resource (name/id) from Zoho CRM Roles API.

details.description: Represents additional details about the recipient. Not applicable for role recipients.

associated_to.description: Represents the associated record context for the recipient. Not applicable for role recipients.

DirectRecipientRoleAndSubordinate.description: Represents a recipient resolved from a role and all subordinate roles below it in the hierarchy, used when a notification must reach a manager and everyone reporting under that role. The role ID must be retrieved from the GET /settings/roles endpoint. This recipient type is not supported in recipients.to when bulk_email is true.

type.description: Represents the recipient type for this notification target. Possible values: role_and_subordinate - Resolves the recipient from a role and all subordinate roles below it in the hierarchy. Example: "role_and_subordinate".

resource.description: Role resource (name/id) from Zoho CRM Roles API.

details.description: Represents additional details for the recipient. Not applicable for role_and_subordinate recipients.

associated_to.description: Represents the associated record for this recipient. Not applicable for role_and_subordinate recipients.

DirectRecipientTerritory.description: Represents a recipient resolved from a sales territory in Zoho CRM, used to notify all users assigned to a specific territory. The territory resource ID must be retrieved from the GET /settings/territories endpoint. This recipient type is not supported in the recipients.to field when bulk_email is true.

type.description: Represents the recipient type for this territory-based recipient entry. Possible values: territory - Indicates that the recipient is resolved from a sales territory, notifying all users assigned to that territory. Example: "territory".

resource.description: Territory resource (name/id) from Zoho CRM Territories API.

details.description: Represents additional details for this recipient. Not applicable for territory recipients.

associated_to.description: Indicates the associated record for this recipient. Not applicable for territory recipients.

DirectRecipientTerritoryAndSubterritory.description: Represents a recipient resolved from a Territory and all its child sub-territories, used when notifying an entire territory hierarchy. The territory identifier can be retrieved from the Territories API. This recipient type is not supported in recipients.to when bulk_email is true.

type.description: Represents the recipient type for this entry. Possible values: territory_and_subterritory - Indicates that the recipient is resolved from a Territory and all its child sub-territories. Example: "territory_and_subterritory".

resource.description: Territory resource (name/id) from Zoho CRM Territories API.

details.description: Represents additional details for this recipient. Not applicable for territory_and_subterritory recipients.

associated_to.description: Represents the associated record for this recipient. Not applicable for territory_and_subterritory recipients.

DirectRecipientUser.description: Represents a recipient resolved from a specific CRM user, used when the notification must be sent to a named individual. Retrieve the user ID from the Get Users endpoint. For private modules, set the `associated_to` field to `team_module` to include team-scoped users.

type.description: Represents the recipient type for the notification target. For direct user recipients, this value is always `user`. Possible values: user - The recipient is a specific CRM user identified by their user ID. Example: "user".

resource.description: User resource (name/id) from Zoho CRM Users API.

details.description: Represents additional details for the recipient. Not applicable for user recipients.

associated_to.description: Indicates the scope context for recipient resolution. Set to `team_module` when the notification module is a private module where record visibility is restricted to team members. When set, only team-scoped users and profiles are included. Leave null for standard modules. Possible values: team_module - The notification module is a private (team) module; only team-scoped users and profiles are included as recipients. null - The notification module is a standard module; all applicable users and profiles are included. Example: "team_module".

DirectRecipients.description: Represents a recipient object used in the to, cc, and bcc arrays of an email notification's recipients configuration. Choose the variant based on the intended recipient type: merge_field resolves dynamically from the record (owner, created_by, or lookup email); emails specifies explicit email addresses; user targets a specific CRM user by ID; profile targets all users assigned to a profile; group targets all users in a group; role targets all users with a role; role_and_subordinate targets a role and its reporting hierarchy; territory targets a sales territory; territory_and_subterritory targets a territory and its sub-territory hierarchy. When bulk_email is true, only merge_field, emails, and user types are permitted in the to array — role, group, territory, role_and_subordinate, and territory_and_subterritory types are not allowed.

DisconnectedStateError.description: Represents the error returned when updates to the Blueprint's connections leave some states no longer connected.

code.description: Represents the error code returned when a state is not connected to any other state. Possible values: CANNOT_PROCEED - Indicates that the request cannot proceed because the state has no connections. Example: "CANNOT_PROCEED".

status.description: Represents the status of the response. Possible values: error - Indicates that the request could not be completed due to an error. Example: "error".

DisplayBasedOnFiscalYearUpdate.description: Represents a request to update only the fiscal year display option for an existing standard or custom fiscal year.

display_based_on.description: Specify whether the fiscal year label is based on the start month or the end month of the fiscal period. Possible values: `start_month`, `end_month`.

file_name.description: Represents the file name for the downloaded mail merge document.
