DuringFieldIdDuplicateError.description: Represents the validation error returned when a duplicate during field ID is present in the transition, including the error code, message, status, and details of the field that is already present.

code.description: Represents the error code returned when a duplicate field ID is detected in the during input. Possible values: **DUPLICATE_DATA**. Example: "DUPLICATE_DATA".

details.description: Contains the validation details of the during-input field that is already present in the transition, including the field's API name and JSON path.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the during-input field that is already present in the transition.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSON path of the during-input field that is already present in the transition.

message.description: Contains the error message returned for the validation failure. Possible values: **field already present in during input for the transition**. Example: "field already present in during input for the transition".

status.description: Indicates the response status of the API call. Possible values: **error**. Example: "error".

DuringFieldIdInvalidError.description: Represents the validation error returned when the provided during field ID is invalid, including the error code, message, status, and details of the field whose ID is invalid.

code.description: Represents the error code returned when the given field ID is invalid. Possible values: **INVALID_DATA**. Example: "INVALID_DATA".

details.description: Contains the validation details of the field whose ID is invalid, including the field's API name and JSON path.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field whose ID is invalid.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSON path of the field whose ID is invalid.

message.description: Contains the error message returned for the validation failure. Possible values: **field id given seems to be invalid**. Example: "field id given seems to be invalid".

status.description: Indicates the response status of the API call. Possible values: **error**. Example: "error".

DuringFieldValidationConfig.description: Represents the validation configuration for the during transition fields.

criteria.description: Criteria to validate the field (Required)

validation_message.description: Represents the message displayed to the user when the during-transition field validation fails.

DuringFieldValidationFilter.description: Represents the validation criteria detail for the during field, including the validation message shown when the field value fails validation.

criteria.description: Validation criteria specified for the during field associated with the transition

validation_message.description: Represents the validation message shown in the during field when the field value fails validation.

DuringFieldValidationFilterAlternate.description: Represents an alternate validation configuration for a during input field, combining an optional validation message with a criteria condition.

criteria.description: Validation criteria specified for the during field associated with the transition

validation_message.description: Represents the validation message shown in the during field when the field value fails validation.

DuringInputChecklistItem.description: Represents an item of the checklist associated with the during field of a blueprint transition.

name.description: Represents the name of the checklist item associated with the during field.

sequence.description: Represents the sequence of the checklist item associated with the during field.

optional.description: Indicates whether the checklist item is optional. Possible values: **true**, **false**.

DuringInputConfiguredField.description: Represents a field configured in the during input of a blueprint transition.

optional.description: Indicates whether the configured field is optional. Possible values: **true**, **false**.

field.description: Field data of the field associated in during field

criteria.description: criteria details for validation

validation_filter.description: Validation criteria detail for the during field

name.description: Represents the name of the configured field collected as a during input in the transition.

subform_fields.description: Contains the fields configured in the during input of the transition.

DuringInputConfiguredFieldAlternate.description: Represents the alternate configuration for a during-input sub-field, including the field reference, optional flag, and optional criteria.

optional.description: Indicates whether the field is optional to fill in the during input. Possible values: **true**, **false**.

field.description: Field data of the field associated in during field

name.description: Represents the name of the configured field collected as a during input in the transition.

subform_fields.description: Contains the fields configured in the during input.

DuringInputFieldIdInvalidDataError.description: Represents the validation error returned when the ID of a during-input field is invalid (code: INVALID_DATA).

code.description: Represents the error code returned when a during-input field ID contains invalid data. Possible values: **INVALID_DATA**. Example: "INVALID_DATA".

details.description: Contains the error details with field-level information.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field associated with the error.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path associated with the error.

message.description: Represents the error message returned for a during-input field with invalid data. Possible values: **invalid data**. Example: "invalid data".

status.description: Indicates the response status of the API call. Possible values: **error**. Example: "error".

DuringInputKioskReference.description: Represents the kiosk data associated with the during field of a blueprint transition.

name.description: Indicates the kiosk name associated with the during input field.

id.description: Indicates the kiosk ID associated with the during input field.

DuringInputLayoutReference.description: Represents the related list layout data associated with the during field of a blueprint transition.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the related list layout collected as a during input in the transition.

id.description: Represents the ID of the related list layout collected as a during input in the transition.

DuringInputRelatedListEntry.description: Represents the related list data collected as a during input in the blueprint transition.

layout.description: layout data associated in during field

name.description: Represents the name of the related list collected as a during input in the transition.

id.description: Represents the ID of the related list associated with the blueprint transition.

module.description: Related list module data associated in during field

DuringInputTypeDuplicateError.description: Represents the validation error returned when a during-input type is duplicated within the same transition (code: DUPLICATE_DATA).

code.description: Represents the error code returned when more than one entry of the same during-input type is found in the transition. Possible values: **DUPLICATE_DATA**. Example: "DUPLICATE_DATA".

details.description: Contains the error details with field-level validation information about the duplicate during-input type.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the during input that caused the duplicate-type error.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path of the during input that caused the duplicate-type error.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the duplicate during-input validation failure. Possible values: **Only one type of this during field is allowed to be in the transition**. Example: "Only one type of this during field is allowed to be in the transition".

status.description: Indicates the response status of the request. Possible values: **error**. Example: "error".

DuringInputValidationFilterAlternate.description: Represents the alternate validation rule and message for a during-input field.

criteria.description: Validation criteria specified for the during field associated with the transition

validation_message.description: Represents the validation message to be shown in the during field.

DuringInputsNotAllowedAutomaticError.description: Represents the error returned when during inputs are provided for an automatic transition, which is not allowed (code: NOT_ALLOWED).

code.description: Represents the error code returned when blueprint transition during fields cannot be added to an automatic transition. Possible values: **NOT_ALLOWED**. Example: "NOT_ALLOWED".

details.description: Contains the error details with field-level information.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field associated with the error.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path of the field associated with the error.

message.description: Represents the error message returned. Possible values: **Blueprint transition during fields cannot be added to automatic transition**. Example: "Blueprint transition during fields cannot be added to automatic transition".

status.description: Indicates the response status of the API call. Possible values: **error**. Example: "error".

DuringInputsNotAllowedParallelError.description: Represents the error returned when during inputs are provided for a parallel transition, which is not allowed (error code **NOT_ALLOWED**).

code.description: Represents the error code returned when during inputs are not allowed on a parallel blueprint transition. Possible values: **NOT_ALLOWED**. Example: "NOT_ALLOWED".

details.description: Contains the error details with field-level information.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field associated with the error.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path of the transition property that caused the validation error.

message.description: Represents the error message returned when during-input fields cannot be added to a parent parallel transition. Possible values: **Blueprint transition during fields cannot be added to a parent parallel transition**. Example: "Blueprint transition during fields cannot be added to a parent parallel transition".

status.description: Indicates the response status of the API call. Possible values: **error**. Example: "error".

DuringInputsWidgetAmbiguityError.description: Represents the error returned when during-input fields are configured along with a widget or kiosk, causing an ambiguity during processing (error code **AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING**).

code.description: Represents the error code returned when during-input fields are configured along with a widget or kiosk. Possible values: **AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING**. Example: "AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING".

details.description: Contains the error details with validation information about the widget or kiosk ambiguity.

ambiguity_due_to.description: Contains the list of fields or components that caused the ambiguity during processing.

items.description: Represents a field or component that caused the ambiguity during processing.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field or component that caused the ambiguity.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path of the field or component that caused the ambiguity.

message.description: Represents the error message returned when during-input fields are configured along with a widget or kiosk. Possible values: - **provide proper data** - **Fields are configured along with widget or kiosk**
enum: Fields are configured along with widget or kiosk

status.description: Indicates the response status of the API call. Possible values: **error**. Example: "error".

DuringTransitionFieldList.description: Represents the list of fields configured in the during transition.

validation_filter.description: Details of validation configured for the during transition fields

sequence.description: Represents the position in which the field is displayed within the during transition popup.

optional.description: Indicates whether the field is optional in the during transition popup.

field.description: Details of the field configured in during transition (Required)

type.description: Represents the type of field configured for display in the during transition popup. Possible values: field - Indicates a standard field. related_list - Indicates a related list. info - Indicates an information block. attachment - Indicates an attachment field. tags - Indicates a tags field. notes - Indicates a notes field. checklist - Indicates a checklist field. widget - Indicates a widget field. kiosk - Indicates a kiosk field.

EditableFieldRefAlt3.description: Represents a field permitted for modification, identified by API name and ID.

api_name.description: api name of the field.

id.description: Id of the field.

EmailAddress.description: Object representing an email address and display name.

user_name.description: The display name of the email recipient or sender.

email.description: The actual email address.

EmailCreateRecordActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that creates a record via an email-based trigger, applicable to modules such as Leads or Contacts.

name.description: Represents the display name of the EmailCreateRecord action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a EmailCreateRecord action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Configuration for the create-record-from-email action. Requires the target module, either Leads or Contacts, and exactly one field mapping that assigns the record owner.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the EmailCreateRecord action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

EmailEngagementMetricsSchema.description: Represents email engagement metrics for an email notification action, including sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, and unsent counts.

bulk_mail.description: Represents number of bulk email messages sent.

unopened.description: Represents number of emails not opened by recipients.

sent_percentage.description: Represents percentage of emails successfully sent out of total attempted.

opened.description: Represents number of emails opened by recipients.

delivered.description: Represents number of emails successfully delivered.

unsent.description: Represents number of emails that failed to send.

bounced.description: Represents number of emails that bounced back.

clicked.description: Represents number of emails where recipients clicked a link.

sent.description: Represents total number of emails sent.

EmailMetaNested.description: Represents the email metadata for a webform, including organization email addresses and user lookup email configurations.

orgEmailsArr.description: Contains the list of organization email addresses available for configuring the from-address of webform notification emails.

EmailNotificationActionCreatedTime.description: Represents the date and time when this notification action was created.

EmailNotificationActionId.description: Represents the unique identifier of the email notification action.

EmailNotificationActionInputEntry.description: Represents a request payload entry for an after action of the type **email_notifications**. Only the ID and name of the email notification action are accepted.

name.description: Represents the name of the email notification action associated with the after actions of the transition.

id.description: Represents the ID of the email notification action associated with the after actions of the transition.

type.description: Indicates the type of the after action of the transition to be created. Possible values: **email_notifications**. Example: "email_notifications".

EmailNotificationActionModifiedTime.description: Represents the date and time when this notification action was last modified.

EmailNotificationActionRecipientCount.description: Represents the total number of recipients configured for this email notification action.

EmailNotificationAddressEmails.description: Represents the sender address configuration for an email notification, used when the server assigns the address automatically or when the address resolves to a plain email address.

type.description: Represents the type of sender address for the notification. Possible values: email - The sender address resolves to a plain email address. Example: "email".

details.description: Represents the email details for the sender address associated with the notification.

email.description: Represents the sender email address in the local@domain format.

resource.description: Represents the resource reference for the sender address. This field is not applicable when the address type is email.

EmailNotificationAddressMergeField.description: Represents the address configuration for a merge_field type from or reply-to address in an email notification. Two hardcoded values are always available: ${!Current.User.Email} (the logged-in user's email) and ${!Record.Owner.Email} (the record owner's email). Any user lookup field available in the module can also be used as a from or reply-to address, for example, ${!Deals.Contact_Name.Email}. Use module and field metadata APIs to discover available user lookup fields.

type.description: Represents the address type for this configuration. Possible values: merge_field - Indicates the address is resolved dynamically from a CRM module field or user lookup field. Example: "merge_field".

details.description: Represents the merge field details used to resolve the sender or reply-to address. The api_name property is required for merge_field address types.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the merge field used to resolve the sender or reply-to address. Supported reference formats include ${!{module_API_name}.{field_API_name}} for direct fields and ${!{module_API_name}.{lookup_APIname}.{field_API_name}} for lookup fields.

id.description: Represents the optional identifier for the merge field.

resource.description: Represents the resource field, which is not applicable for merge_field address types and must be set to null.

EmailNotificationAddressNull.description: Represents a null address value, indicating that no sender or reply-to address has been configured for the email notification.

EmailNotificationAddressOrganizationEmai.description: Represents the address configuration for an organization email sender in an email notification. The resource.id must be an organization email ID retrieved from Zoho CRM Organization APIs.

type.description: Represents the address type for the email notification sender configuration. Possible values: organization_email - Indicates that the sender address is an organization email registered in the Zoho CRM organization. Example: "organization_email".

resource.description: Organization email resource. Use resource.id from Zoho CRM Organization APIs.

details.description: Represents additional details for the address configuration. This field is not applicable when the type is organization_email.

EmailNotificationAddressUser.description: Represents the address configuration for a Zoho CRM user recipient in an email notification. The resource.id must be a valid CRM user ID from the Zoho CRM Users APIs.

type.description: Represents the address type for the email notification recipient configuration. Possible values: user - Indicates that the recipient address is resolved from a Zoho CRM user. Example: "user".

resource.description: User resource. Use resource.id from Zoho CRM Users APIs.

details.description: Represents additional address details. This field is not applicable when the type is set to `user` and should be omitted or set to null.

EmailNotificationAssociateActionSchema.description: Represents an associate action that sends a pre-configured email notification when the workflow rule condition is triggered.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the email notification. Required when associating an existing email notification with the rule.

name.description: Represents the display name of the EmailNotificationAssociate action. Returned in GET responses and derived from the associated action configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a EmailNotificationAssociate action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Represents the read-only details of the associated email notification. Returned in GET responses and not required in POST or PUT requests.

module.description: The module this action applies to.

related_details.description: Controls whether the email is sent at the best time for the recipient (powered by Data Intelligence). Null when best_time is not enabled.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

EmailNotificationByIdResponse.description: Represents the response object returned when a specific email notification definition is retrieved by its ID, containing the full configuration details of the matched notification.

email_notifications.description: Represents the list of email notification definitions returned for the specified ID. Contains at most one email notification object with the full configuration details, including template, recipient, and sender settings.

EmailNotificationCreateInput.description: Represents the writable fields for creating an email notification action in Zoho CRM. The module, name, recipients (with at least one entry in the to array), and template fields are required. Optionally configure from_address, reply_to_address, related_module, bulk_email, and feature_type.

name.description: Specify the display name of the email notification action. The following special characters are not allowed: ~`#%^&*()+={}[]|;"<>\.

module.description: Primary CRM module whose records trigger this email notification (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals). Both api_name and id are required. If they mismatch, returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. This value cannot be changed after creation. Use GET /settings/modules to discover available modules.

related_module.description: Related module context for this notification configuration (e.g., Notes as related module for a Leads notification). This value cannot be changed after creation. Pass null when not applicable.

template.description: Email template to be used for this notification action. Both name and id are required. Fetch available templates from the Email Templates API for the configured module. If no template exists yet for that module, create one first via the createEmailTemplate tool and then associate it here. Templates containing Consent or Survey links are not supported for mass emails; do not use a template containing these links when bulk_email is set to true.

recipients.description: Recipients of the email notification. Provide a JSON object with three arrays: to (required, at least one entry), cc (optional), and bcc (optional). CC and BCC are only allowed when bulk_email is true.

from_address.description: Sender (From) address. Supported types: merge_field, user, organization_email. When bulk_email is false, the From address defaults to notifications@zohocrm.com for notifications sent to internal CRM users; from_address must not be specified in this case and doing so returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. When bulk_email is true, the configured From address is used instead of notifications@zohocrm.com, and the From address is required for mass emails.

reply_to_address.description: Reply-to address. Supported types: merge_field, user, organization_email. When all recipients are internal CRM users, reply_to_address must not be specified and doing so returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Required when any recipient resolves to an external email.

bulk_email.description: Indicates whether mass email mode is enabled for this notification. When set to true, CC and BCC recipients are allowed in the recipients object; when omitted or set to false, including CC or BCC recipients returns an AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING error. When true, role, group, territory, role_and_subordinate, and territory_and_subterritory recipient types cannot be specified in the recipients.to array; use individual users or email addresses instead. This value cannot be changed after creation. Possible values: true - Mass email mode is enabled; CC and BCC recipients are permitted. false - Mass email mode is disabled; CC and BCC recipients are not permitted.

feature_type.description: Automation feature this email notification belongs to. Defaults to 'workflow' if omitted. All listed values are supported for creation via API.

EmailNotificationDetail.description: Represents a complete email notification action definition in Zoho CRM, including its configuration fields, email template, recipient details, sender and reply-to address settings, and server-managed metadata such as creation and modification timestamps.

id.description: Unique identifier of the email notification action.

name.description: Represents the display name of the email notification action.

module.description: Primary CRM module where this notification action is configured.

related_module.description: Related module context for this notification configuration; null when not applicable.

template.description: Email template used by this notification action.

recipients.description: Recipient configuration containing to, cc, and bcc collections.

from_address.description: Sender address configuration used to send the notification email.

reply_to_address.description: Reply-to address configuration for recipient replies.

bulk_email.description: Indicates whether the notification is sent as a single mass email with all recipient addresses visible to each other. Possible values: true - The notification is sent as a bulk email, displaying all recipients together. false - The notification is not sent as a bulk email.

feature_type.description: Automation feature where this action is used.

associated.description: Indicates whether this email notification action is currently associated with any automation rule or process. Possible values: true - The action is linked to one or more automation rules or processes. false - The action is not linked to any automation rule or process.

source.description: Represents the source application that created or manages this email notification action, for example, crm.

recipient_count.description: Represents the total number of configured recipients for this email notification action.

editable.description: Indicates whether the current user has permission to edit this email notification action. Possible values: true - The current user can edit this action. false - The current user cannot edit this action.

deletable.description: Indicates whether the current user has permission to delete this email notification action. Possible values: true - The current user can delete this action. false - The current user cannot delete this action.

lock_status.description: Lock state of this action. Locked actions may not be editable or deletable.

created_by.description: User who created this email notification action.

created_time.description: Represents the date and time when this email notification action was created, as generated by the server.

modified_by.description: User who last modified this email notification action.

modified_time.description: Represents the date and time when this email notification action was last modified, as generated by the server.

EmailNotificationFeatureType.description: Represents the automation feature this email notification is associated with. Possible values: workflow - Standard workflow rules. approval_process - Approval workflows. blueprint - Blueprint automation stages. blueprint_transition - Blueprint automation stages (transition level). blueprint_state - Blueprint automation stages (state level). review_process - Review process actions. orchestration - Orchestration flows. assignment_rules - Lead and record assignment rules. kiosk - Kiosk mode actions. pathfinder - Pathfinder actions. connected_workflows - Connected workflow chains. commandcenter_service - CommandCenter service. cadences - Cadence and sequence actions.

EmailNotificationRelatedDetailsSchema.description: Represents the optional related configuration details for email notification actions, including best-time delivery settings.

oneOf.description: Represents the best-time delivery configuration for the email notification action, controlling when the email sends to reach the recipient at the optimal delivery time.

best_time.description: Indicates whether to send the email notification at the best time for the recipient. When set to true, the platform determines the optimal send time.

oneOf.description: Represents a null value indicating best-time delivery is not configured for this email notification action.

EmailNotificationSummary.description: Represents a summary of an email notification action, including its template, sender and reply-to configuration, recipient collections, primary module context, audit metadata, and association status.

template.description: Email template used by this notification (template id and name).

reply_to_address.description: Reply-to configuration used when recipients reply to the notification email.

lock_status.description: Indicates whether this notification action is locked for edit/delete.

editable.description: Indicates whether the current user can edit this notification action. Possible values: true - The current user has permission to edit this notification action. false - The current user does not have permission to edit this notification action.

module.description: Primary module on which this notification action is configured.

related_module.description: Related module context when the automation is configured on related records; null when not applicable.

deletable.description: Indicates whether the current user can delete this notification action. Possible values: true - The current user has permission to delete this notification action. false - The current user does not have permission to delete this notification action.

source.description: Represents the source application from which this notification action is configured, for example, crm.

created_by.description: User who created this notification action.

feature_type.description: Automation feature where this action is used.

bulk_email.description: Indicates whether the notification is sent as a single mass email. Possible values: true - The notification is sent as a mass email, and CC and BCC recipients are allowed. false - The notification is sent as individual emails, and CC and BCC recipients are not included.

recipients.description: Recipient configuration containing to/cc/bcc collections for this notification action.

associated.description: Indicates whether this notification action is currently associated with an automation rule or process. Possible values: true - The notification action is linked to one or more active automation rules or processes. false - The notification action is not linked to any automation rule or process.

name.description: Represents the display name of the email notification action. The special characters ~`#%^&*()+={}[]|;"<>\ are not allowed.

modified_by.description: User who last modified this notification action.

from_address.description: Sender configuration used to send the notification email.

EmailNotificationTypeFollowupActionReque.description: Represents the follow-up step configuration for an email notification action in a Cadence.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the email notification action.

type.description: Represents the action type for this follow-up step. Example: "email_notifications".

EmailNotificationUpdateInput.description: Represents the writable fields for updating an email notification action in Zoho CRM. This is a partial-update schema — any key omitted from the payload retains its current stored value. Only the name, template, recipients, from_address, and reply_to_address fields can be modified. The module, related_module, bulk_email, and feature_type fields are immutable after creation.

name.description: Specify the display name of the email notification action. Special characters ~`#%^&*()+={}[]|;"<>\ are not allowed.

template.description: Email template to be used for this notification action. Both name and id are required. Fetch available templates from the Email Templates API. If no template exists yet for that module, create one first via the createEmailTemplate tool and then associate it here.

recipients.description: Recipients of the email notification. Provide a JSON object with three arrays: to (required, at least one entry), cc (optional), and bcc (optional). CC and BCC are only allowed when bulk_email is true (set during creation).

from_address.description: Sender (From) address. Supported types: merge_field, user, organization_email. When bulk_email is false, the From address defaults to notifications@zohocrm.com for notifications sent to internal CRM users; from_address must not be specified in this case and doing so returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. When bulk_email is true, the configured From address is used instead of notifications@zohocrm.com, and the From address is required for mass emails.

reply_to_address.description: Reply-to address. Supported types: merge_field, user, organization_email. When all recipients are internal CRM users, reply_to_address must not be specified and doing so returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Required when any recipient resolves to an external email.

EmailNotificationsBulkDeleteFailureItem.description: Represents the result of a failed deletion for a single record ID during a bulk delete operation, including the failure code, status, and error message.

code.description: Represents the failure code indicating why the bulk delete operation failed for this record. Possible values: INVALID_DATA - The data provided for the record is invalid. NOT_ALLOWED - The delete operation is not permitted for this record.

message.description: Represents the error message describing why the bulk delete operation failed for this record.

status.description: Represents the status of the bulk delete operation for this record. Possible values: error - Indicates that the delete operation failed for this record. Example: "error".

EmailNotificationsBulkDeleteMixedRespons.description: Represents the partial-success response for a bulk delete request, containing a mix of successful and failed deletion results for the requested email notification IDs.

email_notifications.description: Represents the per-ID deletion results for the bulk delete request.

EmailNotificationsBulkDeleteResultDetail.description: Represents the identifier details for a bulk-delete result item, including the unique ID of the email notification for which the result applies.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the email notification for which this bulk-delete result applies.

EmailNotificationsBulkDeleteSuccessItem.description: Represents the result item returned for a record that was successfully deleted in a bulk delete operation.

code.description: Represents the result code for a successfully deleted record in a bulk delete operation. Possible values: SUCCESS - Indicates that the record was deleted successfully. Example: "SUCCESS".

message.description: Represents the success message returned when a record is deleted successfully in a bulk delete operation.

status.description: Represents the operation status of a bulk delete item. Possible values: success - Indicates that the deletion of the record was completed successfully. Example: "success".

EmailNotificationsBulkDeleteSuccessRespo.description: Represents the response returned when all requested email notification definitions are successfully deleted.

email_notifications.description: Represents the list of deletion result entries for each email notification ID included in the request.

EmailNotificationsCreatedBy.description: Represents the creator of a resource, including their name and unique identifier.

name.description: Represents the name of the user who created the resource.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the user who created the resource.

EmailNotificationsLockStatus.description: Indicates whether a particular component is locked, affecting its editability and usability.

locked.description: Indicates whether the component is locked. Possible values: true - The component is locked and cannot be edited or used. false - The component is not locked and remains editable and usable.

EmailNotificationsModifiedBy.description: Represents the last person who modified a resource, including their name and unique identifier.

name.description: Represents the full name of the user who last modified the resource.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the user who last modified the resource.

EmailNotificationsModuleDetails.description: Represents the CRM module associated with an email notification definition. Both api_name and id are required and must refer to the same module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the CRM module whose records trigger the email notification. For example, Leads, Contacts, or Deals. Both api_name and id must refer to the same module.

count.description: Represents the number of records returned in the current response page.

more_records.description: Indicates whether additional records are available beyond the current page. Possible values: true - More records exist beyond the current page. false - No additional records exist beyond the current page.

cc.description: Carbon copy recipients of the email.

bcc.description: Blind carbon copy recipients of the email.

subject.description: The subject line of the email.

mail_format.description: The format of the email content.

sent.description: Indicates whether the email was sent (true) or received (false) by the CRM user.

EmailRecipients.description: Represents the recipient configuration for an email notification action, including primary, CC, and BCC recipient lists. The to field is mandatory and requires at least one entry. The cc and bcc fields are optional and are supported only when bulk_email is set to true. The to array can contain a maximum of 100 recipients, while the cc and bcc arrays can contain a maximum of 50 recipients each. A module can have one Multi-Select User Lookup field with up to 10 users; users selected through this lookup count toward the applicable recipient limit. For example, if 10 users are selected through the lookup, up to 90 additional recipients can be specified in the to array.

to.description: Represents the primary recipients of the email notification. At least one recipient entry is required.

cc.description: Represents the CC recipients of the email notification. Supported only when bulk_email is set to true.

bcc.description: Represents the BCC recipients of the email notification. Supported only when bulk_email is set to true.

EqualFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description: Represents the equal comparison operator applied to the criterion. Possible values: equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value. Example: "equal".

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description: Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference. Possible values: value - The value is a direct literal. merge_field - The value is a merge field reference. pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder. field - The value references another field.

EqualFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the equal filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description: Represents the equal comparison operator returned for the criterion. Possible values: equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value. Example: "equal".

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values returned for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value returned for the equal comparator. Contains a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description: Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference. Possible values: value - The value is a direct literal. merge_field - The value is a merge field reference. pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder. field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the equal filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

EqualityFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

EqualityFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionResponse or NotEqualFilterCriterionResponse schema based on the comparator value.

EscalationActionDetails.description: Action metadata including the action name, identifier, and the list of recipients to escalate to.

escalate_to.description: The list of escalation targets to which the escalation action is directed.

name.description: The name of the escalation action.

name.description: The name of the action configured for the escalation trigger.

id.description: The unique identifier of the automation action configured for the escalation trigger.

EscalationActionFieldUpdate.description: An escalation action configuration used during update operations, containing the action type and its associated details.

type.description: The type of action configured for the escalation rule. Possible values: **field_updates** - Indicates a field update action. Example: "field_updates".

details.description: The details of the action configured for the escalation rule, including the field **name** and **id** of the target.

name.description: The name of the action configured for the escalation trigger.

id.description: The unique identifier of the automation action configured for the escalation trigger.

EscalationActionFunction.description: An escalation action configuration, containing the action type and its associated details.

type.description: The type of action configured for the escalation. Possible values: **functions** - Indicates the action is a function execution. Example: "functions".

details.description: The details of the action configured for the escalation, including its **name** and **id**.

name.description: The name of the action configured for the escalation trigger.

id.description: The unique identifier of the automation action configured for the escalation trigger.

EscalationActionSLA.description: Represents an escalation action of the SLA type, containing the action type and recipient details for the escalation.

type.description: The type of escalation action configured. Possible values: **sla** - Indicates the action is of the SLA escalation type. Example: "sla".

details.description: Represents the details of the SLA escalation action, including the **name** and **escalate_to** recipients.

name.description: The name of the SLA escalation action.

escalate_to.description: The list of recipients to whom the SLA escalation is directed.

items.description: An escalation target entry, containing the **type** and **id** of the recipient to escalate to.

type.description: The type of recipient to escalate to. Possible values: **user** - A specific CRM user. **role** - A CRM role. **group** - A CRM user group. **team_user** - A member of a team. **profile** - A CRM profile.

id.description: The unique ID of the escalation recipient.

EscalationActionTask.description: An escalation action object used during update operations, containing the action type and associated details.

type.description: The type of escalation action. Possible values: **tasks** - Indicates the action is a task. Example: "tasks".

details.description: The details of a configured action, including its **name** and **id**.

name.description: The name of the action configured for the escalation trigger.

id.description: The unique identifier of the automation action configured for the escalation trigger.

EscalationActionWebhook.description: An escalation action of the webhook type, containing the action type and its associated configuration details.

type.description: The action type for the escalation configuration. Possible values: **webhooks** - Indicates the action is a webhook notification. Example: "webhooks".

details.description: The details of the action configured for the escalation, including the action's **name** and **id**.

name.description: The name of the action configured for the escalation trigger.

id.description: The unique ID of the automation action configured for the escalation trigger.

EscalationAlertTarget.description: Represents the details of the escalation alert target configured in the trigger.

type.description: Represents the type of user that receives the escalation alert. Possible values: user - Indicates that the alert targets a specific user. role - Indicates that the alert targets users with a specific role. group - Indicates that the alert targets a group. team_user - Indicates that the alert targets a team member. profile - Indicates that the alert targets users with a specific profile.

EscalationRecipientReferencebyState.description: A recipient reference scoped to a specific escalation state, including the recipient's unique ID and type.

id.description: The unique identifier of the escalation recipient.

type.description: The recipient type for the escalation target. Possible values: **user** - An individual CRM user. **role** - A CRM role. **group** - A CRM user group. **team_user** - A team user. **profile** - A CRM profile.

EscalationRecipientSelection.description: A recipient selection for an escalation action, containing the recipient type and ID.

type.description: The recipient type for the escalation. Possible values: **user** - An individual CRM user. **role** - A CRM role. **group** - A user group. **team_user** - A team member user. **profile** - A CRM profile.

id.description: The unique identifier of the escalation recipient.

EscalationTrigger.description: An escalation trigger configured with a unique ID, timing parameters, and associated escalation actions.

period.description: The time period associated with the escalation trigger.

execute_type.description: The execution type of the escalation trigger.

id.description: The unique identifier of the escalation trigger.

value.description: The numeric threshold value that triggers the escalation condition.

actions.description: The list of actions associated with the escalation trigger.

EscalationTriggerConfigurationUpdateAlte.description: Alternate trigger configuration for state escalation updates, specifying timing and actions.

period.description: Represents the unit of time for the escalation trigger period. Possible values: **days** - The period is measured in calendar days. **hours** - The period is measured in hours. **minutes** - The period is measured in minutes. **business_days** - The period is measured in business days. **business_hours** - The period is measured in business hours.

execute_type.description: Represents the execution timing that determines when the escalation actions are triggered. Possible values: **before** - Actions are triggered before the specified escalation event. **on** - Actions are triggered at the time of the specified escalation event. **after** - Actions are triggered after the specified escalation event.

value.description: Represents the maximum time duration, in integer units, for which a record can remain in the current state before the escalation is triggered.

actions.description: The list of actions configured to trigger during a state escalation alert for the specified execution type.

ExecuteActionEntry.description: Represents an execute action entry used to process a kiosk state with the provided data context.

data.description: Specify the data context for the Kiosk execution. If not provided, the Kiosk will execute without a record context.

ExecuteActionStatusItem.description: Represents the result of an execute action, including the status code, message, and details of the next executable state.

code.description: Represents the status code returned for the execute action result.

message.description: Represents the message describing the outcome of the execute action.

status.description: Represents the response status indicating whether the execute action succeeded or encountered an error.

ExecuteAfterNested.description: Represents the execution delay configuration for a follow-up action, specifying the period unit and numeric value.

unit.description: Represents the numeric value of the execution delay, expressed in the specified period unit.

period.description: Represents the time unit for the follow-up execution delay. Possible values: minutes - Execution delay in minutes. hours - Execution delay in hours. business_hours - Execution delay in business hours. days - Execution delay in days. business_days - Execution delay in business days. months - Execution delay in months.

ExecuteCurrentRecordRef.description: Represents a reference to the current module record used during kiosk execution, including the record ID.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the current module record referenced during execution.

ExecuteDataContainer.description: Represents the execution data container, holding the current record reference and the execution instance ID.

Current_Record.description: The Current_Record field provides the record context for the Kiosk execution.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the kiosk execution instance.

ExecuteEvery.description: Represents the recurring execution interval for a Cadence, specifying the frequency period and numeric value.

period.description: Represents the frequency interval for recurring Cadence execution. Possible values: immediately - Execute immediately after each enrollment trigger. hours - Execute at the specified number of hours interval. days - Execute at the specified number of days interval. weeks - Execute at the specified number of weeks interval.

unit.description: Represents the numeric value of the execution interval, expressed in the specified period unit.

ExecuteWhenNestedSchema.description: Represents the trigger configuration that defines when the workflow rule fires, including the trigger type and its associated details.

ExecuteWhenT1Simple.description: Represents a simple trigger type (T1) that fires on record creation, editing, deletion, or when specific CRM events occur, with optional repeat and cross-module support.

type.description: Represents the trigger API name that activates the workflow rule. Supported values vary by module; use the getWorkflowConfigurations endpoint to retrieve supported triggers for the target module.

details.description: Represents the optional trigger configuration details, including **repeat** (Boolean) and **trigger_module** (object) for cross-module triggers.

repeat.description: Indicates whether the rule fires every time the trigger condition is met. When false, the rule fires only on the first occurrence.

trigger_module.description: The module that actually triggers the rule. Defaults to the rule's top-level module if omitted. Must be explicitly set when the trigger targets a different module, such as a rule on Leads triggered by a note creation event, which requires the trigger module to reference the Notes module. To discover module API names and identifiers, retrieve the available modules from the system.

ExecuteWhenT2FieldUpdate.description: Represents a field update trigger type that fires when a specified field value on a record changes according to defined criteria.

type.description: Represents the trigger type for field update rules. Availability varies by the target module.

details.description: Represents the field update trigger details, including the criteria that define which field value change activates the rule.

criteria.description: Represents the field value change criteria that activate the trigger. Defines which field is monitored and what change condition fires the rule.

match_all.description: Controls the logic applied across criteria groups. Possible values: true - All criteria groups must match (AND logic). false - Any one criteria group is sufficient (OR logic).

repeat.description: Indicates whether the rule fires every time the field update condition is met. When false, the rule fires only on the first occurrence.

trigger_module.description: The module that actually triggers the rule. Defaults to the rule's top-level module if omitted. Must be explicitly set when the trigger targets a different module - e.g., a rule on Leads triggered by 'note created' requires trigger_module = {api_name: 'Notes', id: '...'}. Use `getModules` to discover module api_name and id values.

ExecuteWhenT3SectionUpdate.description: Represents the trigger type for section update rules. Availability varies by the target module

type.description: Represents the trigger type for section update rules. Use getWorkflowConfigurations to verify the trigger is available for the target module.

details.description: Represents the section update trigger details, including the layout section IDs to monitor.

section_ids.description: Represents the array of layout section IDs to monitor for updates. Each ID must correspond to a valid section ID for the target module.

items.description: Represents the unique ID of a layout section to monitor.

repeat.description: Indicates whether the rule fires every time a section update condition is met. When false, the rule fires only on the first occurrence.

trigger_module.description: Optional. The module that actually triggers the rule. Defaults to the rule's top-level module if omitted. Must be explicitly set when the trigger targets a different module - e.g., a rule on Leads triggered by 'note created' requires trigger_module = {api_name: 'Notes', id: '...'}. Use `getModules` to discover module api_name and id values.

ExecuteWhenT4DateBased.description: Represents the date or datetime field to monitor for triggering the rule. Must reference an existing date or datetime field on the module.

type.description: Represents the trigger type for date or datetime-based rules, which fire relative to a date field value on the record. Example: "date_or_datetime".

details.description: Represents the date-based trigger details, including the target date field, time offset, and recurrence configuration.

field.description: Represents the date or datetime field to monitor for triggering the rule. Use the getFields endpoint to discover available date and datetime fields.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the date or datetime field, such as **Created_Time**, **Modified_Time**, or a custom field API name.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the date or datetime field.

period.description: Represents the time unit for the offset relative to the monitored date field. For example, **days**, **weeks**, or **months**.

unit.description: Represents the offset magnitude relative to the monitored date field value. Negative values indicate before the date; positive values indicate after.

execute_at.description: Represents the exact time of day at which to fire the trigger, in 24-hour HH:mm format. Applicable only to datetime fields.

recur_cycle.description: Represents the recurrence frequency for the date-based trigger. Possible values: once - Fires once. monthly - Fires monthly on the same date. yearly - Fires yearly on the same date.

repeat.description: Indicates whether the trigger fires repeatedly. When true, the trigger fires on each recurrence as configured.

trigger_module.description: Specifies the module that triggers the workflow rule. If omitted, it defaults to the rule's top-level module. Specify this when the trigger targets a different module. For example, a workflow rule on Leads triggered when a note is created requires 'trigger_module': {"api_name": "Notes", 'id': '...'}. Use 'getModules' to retrieve the module API name and ID.

ExecuteWhenT5TimeOffset.description: Represents the trigger type for time-offset rules. Availability varies by the target module.

type.description: Represents the trigger type for time-offset rules. Use getWorkflowConfigurations to verify the trigger is available for the target module.

details.description: Represents the time offset trigger details, including the time unit and magnitude for the offset.

period.description: Represents the time unit for the offset. Possible values: days - Offset in days. hours - Offset in hours.

unit.description: Represents the time offset magnitude. Always a positive integer for time-offset triggers, such as 1 for one day or 3 for three hours.

trigger_module.description: The module that actually triggers the rule. Defaults to the rule's top-level module if omitted. Must be explicitly set when the trigger targets a different module - e.g., a rule on Leads triggered by 'note created' requires trigger_module = {api_name: 'Notes', id: '...'}. Use `getModules` to discover module api_name and id values.

field.description: Represents the field reference returned in GET responses for time-offset triggers, including the trigger field details.

id.description: Represents the field identifier for the time-offset trigger. Returns **-1** when the field is system-determined.

ExecuteWhenT6ScoreUpdate.description: Represents a score update trigger type (T6) that fires when a record score changes due to configured scoring rules.

type.description: Represents the trigger type for scoring rules. Supports score increase and score decrease trigger events.

details.description: Represents the score update trigger details, including the Scoring Rule scope and the applicable scoring rules.

type.description: Represents the trigger type for scoring rules. Supports score increase and score decrease trigger events.

rules.description: Represents the array of Scoring Rule references to monitor. Required when **type** is set to **Selective_Rules**.

items.description: Represents a single Scoring Rule reference. Must include the Scoring Rule ID for POST and PUT requests. The name field is read-only and returned in GET responses.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the Scoring Rule.

name.description: Represents the display name of the Scoring Rule. This field is read-only and returned in GET responses.

repeat.description: Indicates whether the rule fires every time the score condition is met. When false, the rule fires only on the first occurrence.

trigger_module.description: The module that actually triggers the rule. Defaults to the rule's top-level module if omitted. Must be explicitly set when the trigger targets a different module, such as a rule on Leads triggered by a note creation event, which requires the trigger module to reference the Notes module. To discover module API names and identifiers, retrieve the available modules from the system.

ExecuteWhenT7EmailRepliedWithin.description: Represents an email-reply-window trigger type (T7) that fires when a sent email receives a reply within a configured time window.

type.description: Represents the trigger type for email-reply-window rules. Requires a dedicated email module workflow rule. Example: "mail_sent_replied_within".

details.description: Represents the email-reply-window trigger details, including the time unit and magnitude for the reply window.

period.description: Represents the time unit for the reply window. Possible values: days - Window measured in days. hours - Window measured in hours.

unit.description: Represents the reply window magnitude, such as 3 for a window of three days or three hours.

trigger_module.description: The module that actually triggers the rule. Defaults to the rule's top-level module if omitted. Must be explicitly set when the trigger targets a different module - e.g., a rule on Leads triggered by 'note created' requires trigger_module = {api_name: 'Notes', id: '...'}. Use `getModules` to discover module api_name and id values.

transition.description: Contains the transition information for next execution (Required)

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the kiosk transition referenced in the execution record.

FieldComparatorMismatch.description: Error schema returned when the comparator value supplied for a criterion field does not match the valid comparator values determined by its dependee field. Contains the error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and a details object identifying the criterion field, its dependee field, and the list of supported comparator values.

code.description: Error code identifying the type of field comparator mismatch condition. Possible values: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Example: "DEPENDENT_MISMATCH".

details.description: Detailed information about the field comparator mismatch, including the API name and JSON path of the criterion field in error, the dependee field that governs valid comparator values, and the array of supported comparator values.

dependee.description: The dependee field whose value determines which comparator values are valid for the criterion field that raised the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. Contains the API name and JSON path of the dependee field.

api_name.description: API name of the dependee field that determines the valid comparator values for the criterion field in error.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the dependee field within the request body.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the criterion field whose comparator value does not match any of the supported values determined by the dependee field.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the criterion field whose comparator value does not match any of the supported values determined by the dependee field.

items.description: Represents one supported comparator value valid for the criterion field, as determined by the dependee field.

supported_values.description: Contains the comparator values that are valid for the criterion field, as determined by the dependee field.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the comparator mismatch condition for the criterion field.

status.description: Represents the status of the error response. Possible values: error. Example: "error".

FieldComparatorValueMissing.description: Represents the error response returned when a criterion comparator cannot be applied because the comparator value supplied by the dependee field is absent. Carries error code DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING along with details identifying both the field in error and the dependee field whose value is missing.

code.description: Represents the error code that identifies the category of failure for this error response. Possible values: DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING - Indicates that the comparator value required from the dependee criterion field is absent, preventing the comparator from being evaluated. Example: "DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING".

details.description: Contains detailed information about the criterion field that caused the error and the dependee field whose comparator value is missing, including the API name and JSON path for each.

dependee.description: Represents the dependee criterion field — that is, the field whose value determines what the current comparator accepts — and whose missing comparator value triggered this error. Contains the API name and JSON path of that dependee field.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the dependee criterion field whose comparator value is absent and caused the evaluation failure.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path that locates the dependee criterion field within the request body, identifying where the missing comparator value was expected.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field that triggered the DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field in error within the request body.

message.description: Error message describing the DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING condition returned in the response envelope.

status.description: Status of the response. Possible values: error. Example: "error".

FieldCreationResult.description: Represents the result of a single field creation.

code.description: Represents the result code. Example: "SUCCESS".

details.description: Represents the details of the created field.

id.description: Represents the ID of the created field.

message.description: Represents the result message.

status.description: Represents the status of the operation. Example: "success".

FieldDependencyProcessingSummary.description: Represents the summary of field dependency impact for the job, including counts of total evaluated, processed, and failed dependencies.

FieldDetails.description: Identifies the target field to update. Requires both id and api_name; if they refer to different fields, the request fails with AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.
