FieldUpdateActionCreatedTime.description: Date-time when this field update action was created.

FieldUpdateActionId.description: Unique identifier of the field update action.

FieldUpdateActionModifiedTime.description: Date-time when this field update action was last modified.

FieldUpdateActionResult.description: Result object for a field update create, update, or delete operation. Contains the operation outcome code, a human-readable message, the status, and details including the server-generated ID.

code.description: Operation result code. 'SUCCESS' for successful operations. In bulk operations (DELETE 207), individual items may return error codes like 'NOT_ALLOWED' or 'INVALID_DATA'.

message.description: Human-readable message describing the operation outcome.

status.description: Overall status of the operation. 'success' for successful operations, 'error' for failed individual items in bulk operations.

FieldUpdateArrayValue.description: An array of string values used for multi-select picklist fields, where each element represents one selected option.

items.description: Individual option value for the multi-select field.

FieldUpdateAssociateActionSchema.description: Represents an associate action that updates field values using a pre-configured field update action when the workflow rule condition is triggered.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the field update action. Use the Get Field Updates API to retrieve available IDs.

name.description: Represents the display name of the FieldUpdateAssociate action. Returned in GET responses and derived from the referenced action configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a FieldUpdateAssociate action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Represents the read-only details of the associated field update action. Returned in GET responses and not required in POST or PUT requests.

module.description: The module this action applies to.

related_details.description: Specifies the lookup field when the field update targets a related module. Null when the update targets the workflow rule's own module.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

FieldUpdateBooleanValue.description: A boolean value used for checkbox fields, where true marks the field as checked and false marks it as unchecked.

FieldUpdateByIdResponse.description: Response payload for retrieving a single field update action by ID.

field_updates.description: Array containing the matched field update action. Contains one item for a valid ID.

FieldUpdateConfigurationForCreate.description: Defines a single field update action, including the target module, target field, mapping type, and the value to apply. Some properties are conditionally required depending on the target field's type — for example, Owner fields require notify and related_records.

name.description: Name of the field update action. Must be unique within the org. This label is displayed in the automation rule configuration UI.

module.description: The CRM module where this field update should be applied. Specify using the module's unique ID and/or API name (e.g., Deals, Leads, Contacts).

field.description: Target field to be updated. Provide both field.id and field.api_name. If both are present but inconsistent, ambiguity or invalid-data errors can be returned.

value.description: The value to assign to the target field when this action is triggered. The type must match the target field's data type - a mismatch returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Pipeline expects a string value from Pipelines metadata; Layout expects a layout object from Layouts metadata; Owner expects a user object from Users API.

type.description: Create/update mapping type. Only static is accepted for create/update payloads.

feature_type.description: The automation feature this field update is associated with. Defaults to 'workflow' if omitted. All enum values are supported for creation via API.

notify.description: Whether to send an email notification to the new owner when the Owner field is updated. Required when the target field is Owner (omitting returns DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING). Must not be sent when the target field is not Owner (returns NOT_ALLOWED).

update_type.description: Strategy for applying the value. Required for multi-select fields: 'overwrite' replaces all existing values, 'append' adds to them. Omit or pass null for single-value fields.

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules when updating the Owner field. This key is applicable only for Owner updates, and is required only when active owner-assignment thresholds exist for the module. If thresholds are not configured, sending this key can be rejected as not allowed.

dependent_fields.description: Dependent fields that must be set alongside the target field. Required for dependent picklist relationships. Common chains: Pipeline -> Stage, Layout -> Pipeline, and Layout -> Pipeline -> Stage (nested via dependent_fields inside the Pipeline node).

related_records.description: Related modules whose open record ownership should also be transferred when the Owner field is updated. Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules. Additional modules depend on the parent module: Accounts can also include Contacts and Deals; Contacts can also include Deals. Required when the target field is Owner (omitting returns DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING). Must not be sent when the target field is not Owner (returns NOT_ALLOWED). Pass null to skip ownership transfer on related records.

related_module.description: Related module context when the field update is configured on a related module's records (e.g., updating a field on Contacts related to Accounts). Pass null or omit when not applicable.

FieldUpdateConfigurationForList.description: Represents one field update action returned by the list API, including field configuration, update behavior, module context, and audit metadata.

update_type.description: Specifies how the field value should be applied when the target field supports multiple update strategies (e.g., multi-select picklist, Owner). Null when the field type does not support multiple update strategies (e.g., text, single picklist).

lock_status.description: Indicates whether this field update action is locked for edit/delete.

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) should be enforced when updating the field. Only applicable when the target field is an Owner field and the org has assignment thresholds configured. When true, the system checks whether the new owner has reached their record limit before applying the update. Ignored for non-Owner fields.

editable.description: Whether the current user can edit this field update action.

module.description: Primary CRM module on which this field update action is configured.

related_module.description: Related module context when the automation is configured on related records; null when not applicable.

deletable.description: Represents whether the current user can delete this field update action.

source.description: Source application that created or manages this action (e.g., crm).

type.description: Type returned by the API for this field update. Create/update accepts only static; GET responses can include merge_field for pre-existing actions.

created_by.description: User who created this field update action.

notify.description: Whether to send an email notification to the new record owner when the Owner field is updated via this action. Only applicable when the target field is an Owner field. When true, the newly assigned owner receives an email informing them of the ownership change. Ignored for non-Owner fields.

feature_type.description: Automation feature where this field update action is used.

field.description: The target CRM field that this action updates.

dependent_fields.description: Dependent fields that must be set alongside the target field when dependency rules apply. Includes patterns such as Pipeline -> Stage and Layout -> Pipeline -> Stage (nested). Nested dependencies can be represented through dependent_fields within each item. Null when the target field has no dependency rules configured.

associated.description: Whether this action is currently linked to any automation rule, approval process, or blueprint.

related_records.description: List of related modules whose record ownership should also be transferred along with the parent record when the Owner field is updated. Only applicable when the target field is an Owner field. Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules. Additional related modules are available depending on the parent module: Accounts can also include Contacts and Deals; Contacts can also include Deals. Null when the target field is not an Owner field or when no related modules are selected for ownership transfer.

name.description: Display name of the field update action.

modified_by.description: User who last modified this field update action.

value.description: The value configured for the field update. The shape depends on the target field type.

oneOf.description: A plain text value. Used when the target field is a single-value field such as a text field (e.g., Deal_Name), picklist (e.g., Pipeline, Stage), number, date, or similar scalar field types. Example: "PostTest", "Qualification".
An array of selected option values. Used when the target field is a multi-select picklist. Each element represents one selected option. Example: ["Option 1", "Option 2"].

items.description: One selected option value for the multi-select field.

oneOf.description: A structured object value. Used when the target field requires composite data - for example, a Layout field (with id, name, display_label), an Owner/user-lookup field (with id, name), or other lookup-type fields that resolve to a resource with an identifier.
A boolean value. Used when the target field is a checkbox or boolean-type field. true enables/checks the field, false disables/unchecks it.
A numeric value. Used when the target field is a number, currency, decimal, or percentage field type. Example: 100, 25.5.
A null value. Used to clear/empty the target field - equivalent to choosing 'empty value' in the field update configuration.

parent_module.description: Parent module context when the field update is configured on a child module. Null when the field update is on a top-level module.

api_name.description: API name of the parent CRM module.

id.description: Unique identifier of the parent CRM module.

FieldUpdateFeatureType.description: Automation feature where this field update action is used. Supports baseline features plus connected_workflows. No cadence support.

FieldUpdateNullValue.description: Null value - clears/empties the target field, removing any previously set value.

FieldUpdateNumberValue.description: A numeric value used for number, currency, decimal, or percentage fields.

FieldUpdateObject.description: Represents a field operation object used in layout update requests to add, modify, create, or remove a field within a section.

id.description: Unique identifier of an existing field. Required when adding, updating position, or removing an existing field. Omit when creating a new custom field.

field_label.description: Represents the display label shown for the field in the CRM interface. Required when creating a new custom field through a layout update.

data_type.description: Represents the data type of the field. Required when adding a new custom field to the layout. Possible values: `text`, `textarea`, `email`, `phone`, `website`, `integer`, `bigint`, `currency`, `double`, `percent`, `date`, `datetime`, `boolean`, `picklist`, `multiselectpicklist`, `lookup`, `multiselectlookup`, `autonumber`, `fileupload`, `imageupload`, `formula`, `rollup_summary`, `consent_lookup`, `profileimage`, `richtextarea`, `userlookup`, `multiuserlookup`, `event_reminder`.

length.description: Represents the maximum number of characters permitted for this field's value. Applicable to text and textarea field types.

sequence_number.description: Represents the one-based ordinal position of the field within its containing section, controlling the rendering order of fields on record forms.

element_type.description: Represents the element type for special field components in the layout, distinguishing standard data fields from mirror fields. Possible values: `field` — a standard data field. `mirror_field` — a field that mirrors a value from a lookup source.

lookup_field.description: Represents the source lookup field from which a mirror field derives its value, establishing the cross-module field reference for mirror field creation.

id.description: Unique identifier of the source lookup field.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the source lookup field on which this mirror field is based.

_delete.description: Delete configuration for removing the field. Set permanent to false to move to unused section (can be re-added later), true to permanently delete the field and its data.

association_details.description: Association details for Field-Of-Lookup (FOL) mapping. Links this field to a related field in another module through a lookup field.

FieldUpdateOwnerValue.description: An object value used for Owner or Layout fields, identified by id (a user ID for Owner fields or a layout ID for Layout fields), with an optional name for display.

oneOf.description: Represents a null value indicating the field update targets the workflow rule own module with no lookup field required.

FieldUpdateStringValue.description: A string value used for text, single-picklist, date, or Pipeline fields. Picklist and Pipeline values are validated against the field's configured options.

FieldUpdateType.description: The mapping type used when creating or updating the field update action. Only static is accepted; merge_field appears only in GET responses for existing actions. Example: "static".

FieldUpdateTypeResponse.description: Response-only field update type. Create/update supports only static, while GET responses may include merge_field for pre-existing actions.

FieldUpdateUpdateType.description: Specifies how the new value is applied to a multi-select picklist or Owner field: overwrite replaces the existing value, append adds to the existing entries. Omit or set to null for single-value fields.

FromAddress.description: Represents the sender (From) address configuration for an email notification. Supports three types: merge_field, user, and organization_email. from_address is auto-assigned by the API (defaults to notifications@zohocrm.com) when all recipients are internal (resolve to CRM users). Providing from_address when all recipients are internal returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. When bulk_email is true, the configured From address is used instead of notifications@zohocrm.com, and the From address is required for mass emails. from_address is also required when any recipient resolves to an external email address, such as a merge field that resolves to an email-type field (for example, ${!Module.Email} where ui_type=25).

_code.description: Inline function script content as a string. Applicable only for Deluge runtime — Deluge functions are auto-published when this field is set. For non-Deluge runtimes (Java, NodeJS, Python), upload a ZIP code package via the `code` multipart form field instead.

api_name.description: The unique programmatic identifier for the function.

name.description: The display name of the function.

description.description: The description of the function's purpose and behavior.

runtime.description: The execution runtime environment for the function. Possible values: **Deluge 1.0** - Deluge scripting language, version 1.0. **Java 8** - Java language runtime, version 8. **Java 17** - Java language runtime, version 17. **NodeJS 8** - Node.js runtime, version 8. **NodeJS 22** - Node.js runtime, version 22. **Python 3.12** - Python language runtime, version 3.12.

category.description: The trigger category that determines how and when the function executes. Possible values: **Button** - Triggered when a user clicks a button on a record. **Automation** - Triggered by an automated Workflow or rule. **Schedule** - Triggered at a scheduled time. **Related List** - Triggered from a related list on a record. **Standalone** - Executed independently without a specific trigger context. **Signals** - Triggered by a signal event. **Validation Rule** - Triggered as part of a Validation Rule evaluation. **Dynamic** - Triggered dynamically based on runtime conditions.

resource.description: Represents the resource used as the data source when evaluating the condition. This is null when the condition type does not reference an external record.

value.description: Represents whether the evaluated field must contain data.\ nPossible values:\n${NOTEMPTY} - The field must have a value.\n${EMPTY} - The field must be empty.

GETFunctionsNested.description: The complete metadata for a function, including its identification, configuration, runtime details, state, ownership, and associated tags.

return_type.description: The data type the function returns when executed. Possible values: **bool** - Boolean return type. **collection** - Collection return type. **date** - Date return type. **float** - Floating-point number return type. **int** - Integer return type. **list** - List return type. **map** - Map return type. **string** - String return type. **void** - No return value. **null** - Return type is not explicitly set.

created_time.description: The timestamp when the function was created.

has_draft.description: Indicates whether the function has an unpublished draft version that differs from the currently published version. Possible values: **true** - The function has an unpublished draft version. **false** - The function does not have an unpublished draft version.

description.description: The description of the function's purpose and behavior provided by the user. Null if no description has been set.

runtime.description: Represents the execution runtime environment used to run this function. Possible values: **Deluge 1.0** - Deluge scripting runtime version 1.0. **NodeJS 8** - Node.js runtime version 8. **NodeJS 22** - Node.js runtime version 22. **Java 8** - Java runtime version 8. **Java 17** - Java runtime version 17. **Python 3.12** - Python runtime version 3.12.

language.description: Represents the programming language in which this function is written. Possible values: **Deluge** - Zoho's proprietary Deluge scripting language. **Node JS** - JavaScript runtime environment (Node.js). **Java** - Java programming language. **Python** - Python programming language.

source.description: Represents the origin of this function. Possible values: **crm** - The function was created within Zoho CRM. **extension** - The function originates from a Marketplace extension. **private_extension** - The function originates from a private extension.

rest_api_mode.description: Represents the REST API authentication modes enabled for this function.

items.description: Represents an authentication mode identifier for REST API access to this function. Possible values: **Oauth** - OAuth-based authentication is enabled. **ZAPI** - ZAPI key-based authentication is enabled. **None** - No REST API authentication mode is enabled.

modified_time.description: Represents the timestamp of the last modification made to the function.

api_name.description: Represents the unique programmatic identifier for the function, used in API calls and automation references.

name.description: Represents the display name of the function.

arguments.description: List of input arguments accepted by the function. Null if the function takes no arguments.

state.description: Represents the current lifecycle state of the function. Possible values: **active** - The function has a published version. **unpublished** - The function was created but has never been published. **deprecated** - The function is deprecated. **archived** - The function is archived. **inactive** - The function is inactive. **hibernated** - The function is hibernated.

id.description: The numeric identifier of the function.

Tag.description: The list of tags associated with the function.

category.description: The trigger category that determines how and when the function executes. Possible values: **Related List** - The function is triggered from a related list context. **Validation Rule** - The function executes as part of a Validation Rule. **Schedule** - The function runs on a scheduled basis. **Automation** - The function is triggered by an automation event. **Standalone** - The function runs independently without a trigger context. **Signals** - The function is triggered by a Signals event. **Button** - The function executes when a button is clicked. **Dynamic** - The function operates in a dynamic context.

GETScreenBasicField.description: Represents a basic form field returned in a GET response for a screen state. Contains field metadata including API name, data type, UI type, display label, read-only flag, and required flag.

required.description:
Indicates whether a value is required before the screen can proceed.

width.description: Represents the visual width of the screen container.

title.description: Represents the display title shown at the top of the screen.

allow_multiple_upload.description: Indicates whether multiple file uploads are allowed. Null for currency fields.

tooltip.description: Represents the tooltip configuration for the currency field. Null when no tooltip is configured.

false - The user can modify the value.

id.description: Unique identifier of the module.

api_name.description: API name of the module.

KiosksStatesAutomationAddMeetingDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for add_meeting action. Creates an Event record when workflow fires. PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/layouts?module=Events for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module=Events for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name: 'Events', id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include Event_Title, Start_DateTime), meeting_duration ({unit: int, period: 'hours'|'minutes'} - NOT when All_Day=true), host_unavailable ({assign_record_owner_as_host: true} or {assign_task: {id}}). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool).

module.description: Target module for the meeting. Must be the Events module. Provide either api_name ("Events") or the Events module id.

layout.description: Layout to use when creating the Event record. Determines which fields are available and their validation rules. Fetch valid layouts from GET /settings/layouts?module=Events. The layout.id is required.

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new Event. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Event_Title"}, "type": "static", "value": "Meeting"}. Must include all mandatory fields from GET /settings/layouts?module=Events. Common fields: Event_Title, Start_DateTime, All_Day, Participants (composite type), Remind_At. End_DateTime is auto-computed from Start_DateTime + meeting_duration - do NOT provide it. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist fields; NOT for DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Company} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Start_DateTime and Remind_At; sign required for datetime; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes. When All_Day=true, period must be "days" and omit meeting_duration.

items.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping entry for the new Event record, conforming to the AutomationFieldMappings schema. Each entry identifies a target Event field and specifies the value resolution strategy: static for literal values, merge_field for runtime token substitution, or execution_time for dynamically resolved DateTime and ALARM fields.

meeting_duration.description: Duration of the meeting. Specifies a numeric value and time period (e.g., 1 hour, 30 minutes). Required when All_Day is not set to true in field_mappings. If All_Day is true, meeting_duration must not be provided - the API returns INVALID_DATA with field1/field2 conflict details.

host_unavailable.description: Fallback behavior when the designated meeting host is unavailable. Either assign the record owner as host (assign_record_owner_as_host=true) or create a follow-up task (assign_task with a pre-configured task ID). Exactly one option must be specified; providing both returns INVALID_DATA with field1/field2 conflict, providing neither returns EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the Event record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this add meeting action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

KiosksStatesAutomationCreateRecordDetail.description: PURPOSE: Details object for create_record action. Creates a record in a module with field values from static data, merge fields, or execution-time refs. NOT for Tasks/Events/Calls (use tasks, add_meeting, schedule_call). PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/modules for id. GET /settings/layouts?module={api_name} for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name, id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include all mandatory fields). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool). EXAMPLE: {"module": {"api_name": "Contacts", "id": "111111000000000129"}, "layout": {"id": "111111000000000403"}, "field_mappings": [{"field": {"api_name": "Last_Name"}, "type": "merge_field", "value": "${!Leads.Last_Name}"}]}

module.description: Target module in which the new record will be created. Supported modules: Leads, Contacts, Potentials (Deals), Accounts, Products, Cases, custom modules, and team modules. NOT supported: Tasks, Events, Calls - use add_meeting for Events and schedule_call for Calls. Fetch available modules from GET /settings/modules. At least api_name or id must be provided; always use the full 19-digit module ID as returned by the modules API.

layout.description: Layout to use when creating the record. Determines which fields are available and their validation rules. Fetch valid layouts from GET /settings/layouts?module={module_api_name}. The layout.id is required.

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new record. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Last_Name"}, "type": "static", "value": "Test"}. Must include all mandatory fields (system_mandatory=true or api_mandatory=true from GET /settings/layouts?module={module}) - missing ones cause REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist, phone, number fields; NOT for Date/DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH) or unique fields (INVALID_DATA, check unique=true in GET /settings/fields). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Company} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner fields (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Date/DateTime/ALARM fields; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes; sign required for datetime fields.

items.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping entry for the new record, conforming to the AutomationFieldMappings schema. Each entry identifies the target field via a field reference and specifies the value resolution strategy through a type discriminator: static for literal values, merge_field for runtime token substitution, execution_time for dynamically resolved values, or composite for compound values.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this create record action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

KiosksStatesAutomationFieldAttributes.description: Identifies the target CRM field to which a mapping value is applied within an automation rule. The api_name and ID properties must both be supplied and must refer to the same field; a mismatch between the two causes an AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING error. Available fields for a given module can be discovered via GET /settings/fields?module={api_name}.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the target field in the destination module — for example, Subject, Due_Date, or Owner — used to identify the field receiving the mapped value within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, and convert.

id.description: Represents the numeric identifier of the target CRM field. Used in conjunction with the field's API name, both of which must resolve to the same field for a mapping to be valid.

KiosksStatesAutomationFieldMappings.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping used within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call. Each mapping identifies a target field via api_name or ID, declares a type discriminator that determines value interpretation, and supplies a value whose shape varies by type: static supplies a literal value, merge_field supplies a runtime-resolved token string, execution_time supplies a date or datetime offset object, and composite supplies structured participant data for the Events Participants field. The field_mappings array must include all fields the target module requires; omitting any produces a REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND error.

KiosksStatesAutomationLayoutRef.description: PURPOSE: Layout reference for create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call actions. MANDATORY: id (string). Determines field availability and validation rules. GET /settings/layouts?module={api_name} to discover.

id.description: Unique layout ID. Required. Obtain from GET /settings/layouts?module={module_api_name}.

name.description: Display name of the layout. Optional in requests; present in GET responses.

display_label.description: Human-readable label of the layout. Present in GET responses.

KiosksStatesAutomationModuleRef.description: PURPOSE: Module reference used across non-associate actions. At least one of api_name or id required (EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING if neither). If both given, must match (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). GET /settings/modules to discover. Always use full 19-digit module ID.

api_name.description: API name of the module (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Vendors).

id.description: Unique module ID (19-digit format). Always use the full ID as returned by GET /settings/modules - truncated or shortened IDs return INVALID_DATA ('the tabId given seems to be invalid'). Optional in requests if api_name is provided; always present in responses.

KiosksStatesAutomationScheduleCallDetail.description: PURPOSE: Details object for schedule_call action. Creates a Call record when workflow fires. PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module=Calls for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name: 'Calls', id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include Subject, Call_Type). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool). KEY FIELDS: Subject, Call_Type ('Outbound'|'Inbound'|'Missed'), Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At.

module.description: Target module for the call. Must be the Calls module. Provide either api_name ("Calls") or the Calls module id.

layout.description: Layout to use when creating the Call record. Determines which fields are available and their validation rules. Fetch valid layouts from GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls. The layout.id is required.

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new Call. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Subject"}, "type": "static", "value": "Follow-up"}. Must include all mandatory fields from GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls. Call_Type is system-mandatory (values: "Outbound", "Inbound", "Missed") - omitting returns REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. Common fields: Subject, Call_Type, Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist fields; NOT for DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Phone} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Call_Start_Time and Remind_At; sign required for datetime; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes.

items.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping entry for the new Call record, conforming to the AutomationFieldMappings schema. Each entry identifies a target Call field and specifies the value resolution strategy: static for literal values, merge_field for runtime token substitution, or execution_time for dynamically resolved DateTime and ALARM fields.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the Call record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this schedule call action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

KiosksStatesCompositeFieldMapping.description: Represents a composite-type field mapping used exclusively for the Participants field in the Events module via the add_meeting action. The value carries a structured object that encodes participant data and is not applicable to any other field or automation action type.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Serves as the polymorphic discriminator that identifies this field mapping as a composite mapping; the value must be set to "composite" to select this schema variant.

value.description: Holds the structured composite object that encodes participant data for the Events module Participants field; the shape of this object varies according to the participant type configuration defined for the automation rule.

KiosksStatesExecutionTimeFieldMapping.description: Represents an execution_time-type field mapping that computes a date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime by applying a signed offset to a trigger field or the current time. The value carries an ExecutionTimeValue object specifying the period, unit, trigger_field, and optional time or notify_type properties. A plus sign places the result after the trigger; a minus sign places it before. ALARM fields always require minus. Workflow task actions support only days and business_days as period values.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping variant as an execution-time offset. The value is always "execution_time" for this schema and acts as the polymorphic discriminator across the AutomationFieldMappings union.

value.description: Execution-time object specifying how to compute the date/datetime offset from a reference field.

KiosksStatesExecutionTimeValue.description: Represents the offset configuration used by an execution_time mapping to compute a final date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime. Contains period (the time unit granularity), unit (the numeric magnitude expressed as a string integer), and trigger_field (a merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}). Date fields use period, unit, and trigger_field with an implied positive direction. Datetime fields additionally accept sign to control direction. ALARM fields additionally accept time and notify_type, and always require a minus sign. Workflow task actions restrict period to days or business_days.

period.description: The calendar or time unit applied to the offset. Possible values: **days** — counts all calendar days including weekends and holidays; supported by every action type. **business_days** — excludes weekends and requires the organisation's business-day setting to be enabled; supported by all action types. **hours** — available only for create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call. **minutes** — available only for create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call. workflow_tasks accept only **days** or **business_days**.

unit.description: The number of period units to offset from the trigger date, supplied as a non-negative integer string (for example, "1", "30"). Passing "0" produces a same-day result, such as scheduling a Remind_At on the same day as the due date.

sign.description: The direction of the offset relative to the trigger date. Possible values: **plus** — places the computed value after the trigger (for example, a due date two days after record creation). **minus** — places the computed value before the trigger (for example, a reminder one day before the due date). For datetime fields (data_type=datetime) a value is expected; omitting it returns a DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error. For date-only fields (data_type=date) the value defaults to **plus** when absent. When targeting Remind_At (data_type=ALARM), **minus** is the only applicable direction.

trigger_field.description: The reference date or datetime field from which the offset is measured. Accepts a merge-field token that resolves to a Date or DateTime field on the parent module (for example, "${!Leads.Modified_Time}", "${!Tasks.Due_Date}"), or the reserved constant "${CURRENTTIME}" to use the automation execution timestamp. When computing a Remind_At (ALARM) value, "${!Tasks.Due_Date}" is the typical anchor.

time.description: The time-of-day component of the computed value, expressed in 24-hour HH:mm format (for example, "13:00", "01:30"). Applies when the target field carries data type datetime or ALARM (as reported by GET /settings/fields). Supplying this property for a date-only field (data_type=date) produces a validation error.

notify_type.description: The notification channel used to deliver the reminder. Applies exclusively when the target field carries data type ALARM (i.e., Remind_At); date and datetime fields do not use this property. Possible values: **popup** — triggers an in-app notification. **email** — sends a message to the task owner. **emailandpopup** — delivers both simultaneously.

KiosksStatesGETModule.description: Represents a CRM module reference returned in a GET response, including the module's API name and unique identifier.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the CRM module.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the CRM module.

KiosksStatesMergeFieldMapping.description: Represents a merge_field-type mapping whose value is resolved at execution time by substituting token references with live field data. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Applies to text-based fields such as Subject, Description, and custom text fields. Targeting owner or lookup fields with this type produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error; those fields require a static mapping using an object with a numeric identifier and an optional name. Multiple tokens may be chained with surrounding text for multi-line fields, while single-value fields such as email or URL accept exactly one token.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping strategy for this field assignment. The value must be `merge_field`, which instructs the automation engine to resolve the field value dynamically from a merge field token at execution time rather than from a static literal.

value.description: A string containing one or more ${!...} merge-field tokens resolved at runtime.

allow_agent_user.description: Controls whether agent users are eligible for record assignment. Possible values: **true** — agent users are included in the assignment pool alongside standard users. **false** — agent users are excluded from assignment. Applies to mapping types role, group, profile, merge_field, and criteria. Does not apply to user or assignment_rule types.

KiosksStatesMergeFieldStringValue.description: Represents the string value carried by a merge_field mapping, containing one or more runtime-resolved token references. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), lookup traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Tokens may be combined with surrounding text for multi-line field targets. Fields that hold a single typed value such as email or URL accept exactly one token.

KiosksStatesStaticArrayValue.description: Represents an array of string values used as the static value for multiselectpicklist fields, where each element corresponds to an available picklist option. Valid option labels are retrievable from the GET /settings/fields endpoint filtered by data_type=multiselectpicklist.

items.description: A single picklist option string to include in the multi-select field value. Each entry corresponds to one selectable option as defined for the target field in Zoho CRM.

KiosksStatesStaticFieldMapping.description: Represents a static-type mapping that assigns a literal value directly to the target field at execution time. The value shape varies by field data type: a plain string for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields (numeric values expressed as strings); an array of strings for multiselectpicklist fields; and an object containing ID and name for ownerlookup fields. Date, datetime, and ALARM fields do not support this type — use execution_time instead, as static on those fields produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. Fields marked unique in the module settings also require merge_field rather than static for create_record actions.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping strategy for this field assignment. The value must be `static`, which instructs the automation engine to assign a fixed, literal value to the target field at execution time rather than resolving it dynamically.

value.description: The literal value assigned to the target field at automation execution time. The expected shape is determined by the target field data_type, discoverable via GET /settings/fields?module={module}. For most field types, supply a string (for example, "High", "Not Started", "1234"). For multi-select picklist fields (data_type: multiselectpicklist), supply an array of option strings. For fields that reference an entity such as an owner or layout (data_type: ownerlookup), supply an object with at minimum the entity ID.

KiosksStatesStaticObjectValue.description: Represents an object value used as the static value for ownerlookup and layout fields, containing an ID that identifies the target user or layout and an optional name that the server resolves from the ID when not supplied. Typically used to assign record ownership by providing the user ID.

id.description: The system identifier of the referenced entity, such as a user or layout record. This value drives entity resolution by the automation engine and must be provided when the target field references an entity.

name.description: The display name of the referenced entity, such as a user full name or a layout label. When omitted from a request payload, the server resolves and populates this property from the supplied ID. The property is present in all GET responses.

KiosksStatesStaticStringValue.description: Represents a plain string value used as the static value for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields. Numeric values are expressed as strings rather than numeric literals. Picklist values must exactly match one of the options defined for the field.

LayoutActionsAllowed.description: Represents the set of Boolean permission flags indicating which operations are permitted on a layout, such as editing, renaming, cloning, deactivating, and deleting.

edit.description: Indicates whether the layout's field arrangement, sections, and configuration can be modified. Possible values: `true` — editing the layout is permitted; `false` — the layout is locked against edits.

rename.description: Indicates whether the layout's display name can be changed. Possible values: `true` — renaming the layout is permitted; `false` — the layout name is locked.

clone.description: Indicates whether the layout can be duplicated to create a new layout with the same field and section configuration. Possible values: `true` — cloning the layout is permitted; `false` — the layout cannot be cloned.

downgrade.description: Indicates whether the layout can be downgraded to a lower-tier configuration or reverted to a previous edition-level feature set. Possible values: `true` — downgrading the layout is permitted; `false` — the layout cannot be downgraded.

delete.description: Indicates whether the layout can be permanently removed from the module configuration. Possible values: `true` — deleting the layout is permitted; `false` — the layout cannot be deleted.

deactivate.description: Indicates whether the layout can be deactivated, preventing it from being assigned to new records while preserving existing associations. Possible values: `true` — deactivating the layout is permitted; `false` — the layout cannot be deactivated.

set_layout_permissions.description: Indicates whether profile-level permission assignments for the layout can be configured. Possible values: `true` — managing layout permissions is permitted; `false` — permission settings cannot be modified for this layout.

name.description: Field: name

id.description: Field: id

name.description: Field: name

id.description: Field: id

LayoutDetails.description: Represents the layout associated with a Scoring Rule, including its display label, API name, and unique ID.

display_label.description: Represents the display label of the layout associated with the Scoring Rule.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the layout associated with the Scoring Rule.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the layout associated with the Scoring Rule.

LayoutFieldsResponseSchema.description: Represents the response returned when the `fields` query parameter trims each layout to the requested keys. Only `id` is guaranteed - it is returned even when it is not requested - every other key appears only when it was asked for, and keys with no value for a layout are returned as null.

layouts.description: Represents the array of layout objects trimmed to the keys requested through the `fields` parameter, ordered by layout name.

items.description: Represents an individual layout carrying only the keys requested through the `fields` parameter, plus the always-present `id`.

id.description: Unique identifier of the layout.

name.description: Represents the internal API name of the layout.

api_name.description: API name of the layout.

display_label.description: Represents the display label of the layout shown in the CRM interface.

oneOf.description: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset indicating when the layout was created.
ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset indicating when the layout was last modified.
User who created the layout.
User who last modified the layout.

status.description: Represents the current status of the layout.

visible.description: Indicates whether the layout is visible to users in the CRM interface.

show_business_card.description: Indicates whether the business card view is enabled for this layout.

generated_type.description: Indicates whether the layout was generated by the system or created by a user.

source.description: Represents the source from which this layout was created.

id.description: Unique identifier of the layout.

LayoutResponseSchema.description: Represents the response schema for layout retrieval operations, containing an array of layout objects each with complete configuration details including sections, profiles, and portal user type associations.

layouts.description: Contains the array of layout objects returned for the specified module, each representing a complete layout configuration including sections, fields, profiles, and portal user type associations.

items.description: Represents the complete configuration of a single layout in the module, including its sections, field assignments, profile associations, and display metadata.

has_more_profiles.description: Indicates whether additional profile associations exist for this layout beyond those included in the current response. Possible values: `true` — more profile associations are available; `false` — all profile associations are represented.

oneOf.description: Represents the ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset recording when this layout was first created in the CRM.

visible.description: Indicates whether this layout is currently visible and accessible to users in the CRM interface. Possible values: `true` — the layout is visible and selectable; `false` — the layout is hidden.

oneOf.description: Represents the integration or system context that prompted the creation of this layout, identifying the source platform or feature responsible for provisioning it.

portal_user_types.description: Contains the list of portal user type associations for this layout, each specifying which portal user category the layout is associated with and the default view configuration for that user type.

items.description: Represents the portal user type configuration entry for this layout, specifying the user type, default view settings, and whether this is the default layout for that user type.

default.description: Indicates whether this layout is the default for the associated portal user type. Possible values: `true` — this is the default layout for this portal user type; `false` — it is not the default.

name.description: Represents the name of the portal user type associated with this layout entry.

id.description: Unique identifier of the portal user type

_default_view.description: Represents the default view assigned to this portal user type for the layout, defining which view is presented to portal users of this type by default.

name.description: Represents the API name of the default view assigned to this portal user type.

id.description: Unique identifier of the default view

type.description: Indicates the category of the default view assigned to this portal user type, such as a layout view or a wizard-based view.

oneOf.description: Represents the list of CRM profiles associated with this layout. Contains an empty array when no profiles are assigned.

source.description: Represents the origin channel of this layout. Possible values: `crm` — the layout is built into the standard module definition. `platform_plugin` — the layout comes from a Zoho platform plugin. `marketplace_plugin` — the layout comes from a Marketplace extension. `campaign_integration` — the layout comes from a Campaigns integration.

oneOf.description: User who created the layout

sections.description: Contains the ordered list of sections within this layout, each grouping a set of fields and defining display properties such as column count and tab traversal order.

items.description: Represents a single section within the layout, encapsulating the section's field collection, display label, column configuration, and any subform or parent-section relationships.

isSubformSection.description: Indicates whether this section renders as an embedded subform that displays related module records inline within the parent record's layout. Possible values: `true` — the section is a subform; `false` — the section is a standard field group.

parent_section.description: Represents a reference to the parent section when this section is nested as a subform or dependent section within the layout hierarchy.

oneOf.description: Represents the parent section reference for a nested section, identifying the containing parent section by name when a hierarchical section relationship exists.

id.description: Unique identifier of the parent section.

name.description: Represents the name of the parent section under which this nested section is organized within the layout.

type.description: Represents the usage status type of this section within the layout. Possible values: `used` — the section contains fields assigned to it. `unused` — the section exists in the layout but contains no assigned fields.

display_label.description: Represents the name of the section as displayed in the CRM interface, used as the section heading on record create and detail pages.

mode.description: Represents the layout mode for which this section applies, controlling in which view contexts the section and its fields render. Possible values: `all` — applies across all layout modes. `business_card` — applies to the business card view. `quick_create` — applies to the quick-create form. `default_create` — applies to the default record creation form. `create_edit` — applies to both create and edit forms. `view` — applies to the record detail view. `quick_view` — applies to the quick view panel. `subform_default_create` — applies to the default create form within a subform context.

sequence_number.description: Represents the ordinal position of this section within the layout, controlling the order in which sections are rendered on record forms.

actions_allowed.description: Permissions for section operations. System sections (Score, Visit Summary) will have restricted permissions.

tab_traversal.description: Indicates the direction of keyboard tab navigation within this section, determining the order in which focus moves between fields when users press Tab. Possible values: `left_to_right` — focus moves horizontally across columns first. `top_to_bottom` — focus moves vertically down each column first.

api_name.description: API identifier for the section

column_count.description: Indicates the number of columns in which fields are arranged within this section, controlling the side-by-side or single-column display of fields on record forms.

is_parent_section.description: Indicates whether this section acts as the parent container for a dependent subform section, establishing a hierarchical section relationship within the layout. Possible values: `true` — this is a parent section; `false` — this section is not a parent container.

name.description: Represents the internal name of the section used to reference it in layout configurations and API operations.

generated_type.description: Indicates whether this section originates from automatic system generation or from an administrator's manual configuration. Possible values: `default` — automatically generated by the CRM platform. `custom` — defined manually by an administrator.

fields.description: Contains the ordered list of fields assigned to this section. Fields are presented in ascending sequence_number order.

display_label.description: Represents the label of the layout as displayed in the CRM interface, shown in layout selection dropdowns and record settings.

show_business_card.description: Indicates whether the business card view is enabled for this layout, allowing a compact summary of key fields to be shown in preview and lookup contexts. Possible values: `true` — business card view is active; `false` — business card view is not enabled.

actions_allowed.description: Permissions indicating which operations are allowed on this layout

oneOf.description: Represents the ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset recording when this layout's configuration was most recently changed.

api_name.description: API name of the layout

name.description: Represents the internal API name of the layout, used as a programmatic identifier in API operations and automation configurations.

oneOf.description: User who last modified the layout

generated_type.description: Indicates whether this layout originates from automatic system generation or from an administrator's manual configuration. Possible values: `system` — automatically generated by Zoho CRM. `custom` — created manually by an administrator.

total_profiles.description: Indicates the total number of CRM profiles associated with this layout, which may exceed the number of profiles included in the current response when has_more_profiles is true.

status.description: Indicates the current operational status of the layout. Possible values: `active` — the layout is in use and can be assigned to profiles; `inactive` — the layout has been deactivated and is not available for new assignments.

LayoutUpdateObject.description: Represents the layout configuration object supplied in an update request, containing at least one of the updatable attributes: name, sections, profiles, or business card display setting.

name.description: Represents the new display name for the layout. Must be unique within the module's layout configurations.

show_business_card.description: Specifies whether the business card view is enabled or disabled for this layout as part of the update.

profiles.description: Contains the array of profile objects to be added to or removed from the layout's profile associations in this update operation.

sections.description: Contains the array of section objects to be created, modified, or deleted as part of this layout update, defining the field and configuration changes within each section.

LayoutUpdateSuccessResult.description: Represents the success result returned when a layout update operation completes without error, containing a confirmation code, message, and the identifying details of the updated layout.

code.description: Represents the success code returned when the layout update operation completes without error. Example: "SUCCESS".

details.description: Contains the identifying details of the layout that was successfully updated, such as its ID.

id.description: Unique identifier of the updated layout.

message.description: Contains a confirmation message indicating that the layout update operation completed successfully.

status.description: Indicates the outcome of the layout update operation. Possible values: `success` — the layout update completes successfully. Example: "success".

LayoutsApiName.description: Represents an API identifier string composed of alphanumeric characters and underscores, used as a programmatic reference for fields, modules, and other CRM entities.

LayoutsFieldSchema.description: Represents a comprehensive schema for a CRM field in a module layout, encapsulating all field-level configuration including data type, display settings, permissions, lookup relationships, formula definitions, and audit metadata.

associated_module.description: Contains the details of the CRM module linked to this field when the field represents a subform, identifying the related module and the layout governing how its records are embedded and displayed within the parent module's layout.

oneOf.description: Represents the associated module details when this field is a subform field, including the module API name and the layout used to render the embedded records.

module.description: API name of the associated module

id.description: Unique identifier of the associated module

layout.description: Represents the name of the layout applied to the associated module's records when displayed within the subform field, determining which set of fields and sections are rendered in the embedded view.

name.description: Represents the name of the layout applied to the associated module's records when displayed within the subform field, determining which set of fields and sections are rendered in the embedded view.

id.description: Unique identifier of the layout

webhook.description: Indicates whether webhook notifications are triggered when this field's value changes on a record. Possible values: `true` — changes to this field trigger configured webhook endpoints; `false` — field changes do not initiate webhook notifications.

operation_type.description: Represents the set of operations permitted on this field, specifying independently whether values can be supplied or modified through API-based create/update calls and through the CRM web interface create/update forms.

web_update.description: Indicates whether this field accepts a new value when a record is saved through the CRM web interface during an update. Possible values: `true` — the field is editable in the web edit form; `false` — the field is read-only or hidden in the web update form.

api_create.description: Indicates whether this field accepts a value when a record is saved through the API during creation. Possible values: `true` — the field value can be set via API during record creation; `false` — the field value cannot be set via API at record creation time.

web_create.description: Indicates whether this field appears and accepts a value when a record is saved through the CRM web interface during creation. Possible values: `true` — the field is editable in the web create form; `false` — the field does not appear or is locked in the web create form.

api_update.description: Indicates whether this field accepts a new value when a record is saved through the API during an update. Possible values: `true` — the field can be modified via API during a record update; `false` — the field is read-only for API-based update operations.

colour_code_enabled_by_system.description: Indicates whether color-code functionality has been activated for this field by the system platform rather than by a user or administrator. Possible values: `true` — the system has enabled color coding for this field; `false` — color coding on this field is not system-activated.

field_label.description: Represents the label assigned to the field, displayed in forms, detail views, and list columns within the module layout.

tooltip.description: Represents the tooltip configuration attached to this field, defining contextual help text displayed to users when they hover over or focus on the field in a record form.

oneOf.description: Represents the active tooltip configuration for this field, specifying the help text and delivery mechanism shown to users when they interact with the field.

name.description: Indicates the delivery mechanism for the tooltip, such as whether it is rendered as a static label or as a modal help popup.

value.description: Contains the help text displayed in the tooltip when users interact with this field, providing contextual guidance on the field's purpose or expected input.

display_format_properties.description: Contains supplementary rendering configuration for field types that require additional display directives beyond a simple format string, such as phone number dial-code positioning or the orientation and layout style of radio button groups.

oneOf.description: Represents the active supplementary rendering configuration for this field type, such as phone split settings or radio button orientation.

split.description: Indicates the formatting pattern applied to split a phone number into its dial-code prefix and local number segments when rendering the field in the UI.

radio_display_type.description: Specifies the layout orientation used to render radio button options in the UI, such as arranging choices horizontally in a row or vertically in a stacked column.

type.description: Indicates the field's layout usage status, determining whether the field appears in layout sections. Possible values: `used` — the field is placed in at least one layout section. `unused` — the field exists in the module but has no assignment to any section. `all` — the field appears regardless of layout placement status.

field_read_only.description: Indicates whether the field is locked against user edits at the field level, independent of profile-based permissions. Possible values: `true` — the field value cannot be modified by users; `false` — the field is editable subject to applicable profile permissions.

customizable_properties.description: Contains the set of field attributes that administrators are permitted to modify through the CRM layout editor, such as label, required status, or visibility, reflecting which aspects of the field definition are not locked by the system.

oneOf.description: Represents the list of field attribute names that administrators can modify through the layout editor, with unique values only.

items.description: Represents the API name of a single field attribute that can be modified by an administrator, identifying a specific configurable aspect of the field such as its label, tooltip, or mandatory setting.

required.description: Indicates whether this field must contain a value before a record can be saved. Possible values: `true` — the field is mandatory and a value must be supplied; `false` — the field is optional.

subform_properties.description: Contains the display configuration settings for this field when it appears within a subform section, such as custom column width and column pinning behavior.

oneOf.description: Represents the active subform display configuration for this field, specifying column width and pinning behavior when the field appears in a subform section.

custom_width.description: Indicates the custom column width in pixels assigned to this field when it is displayed as a column in a subform, overriding the default column sizing.

oneOf.description: Represents the active custom column width in pixels for this field when displayed in a subform section.

pinned_column.description: Indicates whether this field's column is frozen in place when users scroll horizontally through a subform, keeping the field visible regardless of scroll position. Possible values: `true` — the column is pinned; `false` — the column scrolls with the subform.

display_label.description: Represents the name of the field displayed in the module layout, used as the visible title in forms, list views, and detail pages.

allowed_permissions_to_update.description: Represents the set of permission levels that can be actively assigned to this field across profiles, indicating which visibility and access states are eligible for modification. Returned only when the query parameter `include_inner_details=fields.allowed_permissions_to_update` is specified in the request.

read_write.description: Indicates whether the read-write permission level is eligible to be assigned to this field. Possible values: `true` — the field can be configured for full read and write access for specific profiles, permitting both viewing and editing; `false` — the read-write permission cannot be applied to this field.

hidden.description: Indicates whether the hidden permission level is eligible to be assigned to this field. Possible values: `true` — the field's visibility can be set to hidden for specific profiles, concealing it entirely from their layout view; `false` — the hidden permission cannot be applied to this field.

read_only.description: Indicates whether the read-only permission level is eligible to be assigned to this field. Possible values: `true` — the field can be configured as read-only for specific profiles, allowing users to view but not edit its value; `false` — the read-only permission cannot be applied to this field.

Indicates whether this field is locked against user edits through the CRM interface and API, preventing any modification of its value after it has been set. Possible values: `true` — the field cannot be modified; `false` — the field is editable subject to applicable permissions.

association_details.description: Contains the relationship metadata for fields connected to other records through lookup associations, describing the linked module, the nature of the relationship, and any constraints governing how related records appear or display.

oneOf.description: Represents the lookup association details when this field is connected to another module through a lookup relationship, including the lookup and related field metadata.

related_field.description: Represents the corresponding field on the related module that is linked through the association, containing identifying metadata such as the field's API name and display label.

api_name.description: API name of the related field

id.description: Unique identifier of the related field

lookup_field.description: Represents the lookup field on the source module that establishes the association, containing identifying metadata such as the field's API name and display label.

api_name.description: API name of the lookup field

id.description: Unique identifier of the lookup field

businesscard_supported.description: Indicates whether the field is eligible to appear on the business card view, which surfaces key record details in compact preview panels across Zoho CRM. Possible values: `true` — the field can be included in the business card layout; `false` — the field is excluded from business card display.

sharing_properties.description: Contains the sharing configuration for this field, defining how its value participates in record-level sharing rules and whether specific sharing preferences are active.

oneOf.description: Represents the active status of the sharing scheduler for this field, indicating the current state of sharing rule propagation.

share_permission.description: Represents the sharing access level assigned to this field, controlling whether users who receive shared record access can read, edit, or are restricted from this field's value.

share_preference_enabled.description: Indicates whether the sharing preference configuration is active for this field. Possible values: `true` — sharing preference settings are applied to this field; `false` — sharing preference is not enabled.

share_with_superiors.description: Indicates whether this field's value is shared with users in superior roles in the CRM role hierarchy when record sharing propagates upward. Possible values: `true` — the field is shared with superior role users; `false` — the field is not shared with superiors.

multi_module_lookup.description: Represents the multi-module lookup configuration for fields that can reference records from more than one CRM module within a single lookup relationship, including the participating modules and dynamic addition settings.

oneOf.description: Represents the active multi-module lookup configuration, specifying the participating modules, display label, and dynamic addition settings.

display_label.description: Represents the identifying label of the multi-module lookup field in the CRM interface, identifying the lookup relationship across its participating modules.

api_name.description: API name of the multi module lookup field

modules.description: Contains the collection of CRM modules that participate in this multi-module lookup relationship, each representing a valid source from which the user can select a referenced record.

items.description: Represents a single module entry included in the multi-module lookup configuration, encapsulating identifying and display attributes for that module.

api_name.description: API name of the module

module_name.description: Indicates the internal API name of the module participating in the multi-module lookup, used to identify the module programmatically across CRM operations.

id.description: Unique identifier of the module

dynamic_module_addition_allowed.description: Indicates whether additional CRM modules can be incorporated into this multi-module lookup relationship at runtime without requiring a layout reconfiguration. Possible values: `true` — new modules may be added dynamically; `false` — the participating modules are fixed at configuration time.

id.description: Unique identifier of the field

created_time.description: Represents the date and time at which the field definition was first created in the CRM, recorded for audit and chronological tracking purposes.

oneOf.description: Represents the ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset recording when this field definition was first created in the CRM.

filterable.description: Indicates whether the field can be used as a filter criterion in record search, list view filtering, and report conditions. Possible values: `true` — the field is available as a filter option; `false` — the field cannot be used for filtering.

visible.description: Indicates whether this field is currently displayed in the module layout. Possible values: `true` — the field is shown in the layout and visible to users with appropriate permissions; `false` — the field is hidden from the layout.

mask_details.description: Represents the field masking configuration that controls how the field's stored value is partially or fully hidden from users who do not have permission to view sensitive data, including rules for how many characters are revealed and which profiles can bypass masking.

oneOf.description: Represents the partial masking configuration where a specified number of characters at the beginning and end of the field value are revealed while the middle portion is masked.

show_first.description: Indicates the number of characters revealed at the start of the field value when partial masking is applied, allowing a prefix of the data to remain visible while the remainder is hidden.

complete_mask.description: Indicates whether the entire field value is hidden from unauthorized users rather than partially revealed. Possible values: `true` — the value is completely obscured; `false` — partial character reveal rules defined by show_first and show_last apply.

show_last.description: Indicates the number of characters revealed at the end of the field value when partial masking is applied, allowing a suffix of the data to remain visible while the preceding portion is hidden.

profiles.description: Contains the list of CRM profiles whose members are permitted to view the unmasked field value, exempting those users from the masking rules applied to all other profiles.

oneOf.description: Represents the complete masking configuration where the entire field value is hidden from users who do not have an exempted profile.

complete_mask.description: Indicates whether the entire field value is hidden in this alternate masking schema variant. Possible values: `true` — the value is completely obscured; `false` — partial reveal rules apply.

profiles.description: Contains the list of CRM profiles whose members can view the unmasked field value in this alternate masking schema variant, exempting those users from the masking rules applied to all other profiles.

refer_from_field.description: Represents the source field from which this mirror or derived field obtains its value, establishing a read-through relationship where the field reflects data from another field in a related module.

oneOf.description: Represents the active reference field configuration for a mirror field, identifying the source lookup field from which this field's value is derived.

api_name.description: API name of the reference field

id.description: Unique identifier of the reference field

portal_user_types.description: Contains the list of portal user type permission configurations for this field, specifying which portal user type categories can view or edit the field's value when accessing records through a customer or partner portal.

items.description: Represents the permission configuration for a single portal user type, defining the level of access that users of that type have to this field when interacting through the portal.

permission_type.description: Represents the access level granted to portal users of this type for the field. Possible values: `read_write` — full read and write access; portal users can view and edit the field. `read_only` — view access only; portal users can see but cannot modify the field value. `hidden` — the field is not visible to portal users of this type.

name.description: Represents the name of the portal user type, identifying the category of external users whose field permissions are described in this entry.

id.description: Unique identifier of the portal user type

profiles.description: Contains the list of profile-level permission entries for this field, each describing the access level a specific CRM profile has to view or edit the field's value.

items.description: Represents the permission assignment for a single CRM profile, specifying whether users of that profile can view, edit, or are restricted from accessing this field.

permission_type.description: Represents the level of access granted to users of this profile for the field. Possible values: `read_write` — full read and write access; users can view and edit the field. `read_only` — view access only; users can see but cannot modify the field value. `hidden` — the field is not visible to users of this profile.

name.description: Represents the name of the CRM profile for which this field permission entry applies.

id.description: Unique identifier of the profile

view_type.description: Represents the view-mode availability settings for this field, specifying in which CRM interaction contexts — such as record creation, editing, viewing, or quick-create — the field is shown or editable.

view.description: Indicates whether this field is visible when a record is viewed in detail mode. Possible values: `true` — the field is displayed on the record detail page; `false` — the field is hidden from the detail view.

edit.description: Indicates whether this field is presented and editable in the record edit form. Possible values: `true` — the field is shown in edit mode; `false` — the field is hidden or read-only during editing.

quick_create.description: Indicates whether this field is included in the abbreviated quick-create form. Possible values: `true` — the field appears in the quick-create panel; `false` — the field is excluded from quick-create.
