value.description: The tooltip text shown to the user. The maximum characters allowed for info_icon is 255 chars and for static_text is 32 chars.

ScreenTooltipUpdate.description: Represents the tooltip configuration for updating a screen field. Contains the tooltip type and the text displayed to the user.

name.description: Represents the type of tooltip presentation for the field. Possible values: info_icon - Displays an information icon next to the field. static_text - Displays informational text next to the field.

value.description: Represents the text displayed inside the tooltip for the field.

ScreenUpdateDetails.description: Represents the details configuration object for updating a kiosk screen state. Contains the screen_details object with the UI elements, buttons, and layout properties to be updated.

screen_details.description: Configuration object defining the UI screen that will be rendered to the kiosk user. This object contains all information required to dynamically construct the screen interface including: input elements, interactive components, layout configuration, action buttons, screen metadata The kiosk runtime uses this configuration to generate the UI dynamically without requiring frontend code changes. Elements key is mandatory for a screen_details JSON while creating screen state.

ScreenZiaInsight.description: Represents the Zia AI insight component configuration for a kiosk screen. Defines the API name, field label, component type, required flag, read-only flag, and the parent record used as input.

parent_record_field.description: Defines the record used as input for generating the AI insight. (Required)

read_only.description: Indicates whether the Zia insight component is read-only. Possible values: true - The component is displayed but cannot be edited. false - The user can interact with the component.

api_name.description: Represents the unique API name of the Zia insight component to be associated with the screen.

field_label.description: Represents the display label shown on the screen for the Zia insight component during execution and preview.

component_name.description: Represents the specific type of Zia AI insight component, such as prediction or recommendation.

required.description:
Indicates whether the Zia insight component is mandatory during kiosk execution.
Possible values:
true - A value must be provided.
false - The component may be skipped.

SectionProperties.description: Represents the additional configuration properties for subform sections, including row-level interaction settings, tooltip configuration, and conditional display preferences.

reorder_rows.description: Indicates whether users are permitted to reorder existing rows within the subform section by dragging them to a new position. Possible values: `true` — row reordering is allowed; `false` — rows cannot be reordered.

oneOf.description: Represents the active bulk addition configuration for a subform section, enabling users to add multiple rows simultaneously to the subform.

lookup_field.description: The lookup field used for bulk addition

name.description: Display name of the lookup field

oneOf.description: List of subform fields available for bulk addition

items.description: A subform field available for bulk addition

name.description: Display name of the subform field

oneOf.description: Empty object when bulk addition is not configured
Represents the active tooltip configuration for this section, specifying the help text and display mechanism shown to users when they hover over the section header.

name.description: Indicates the delivery mechanism for the section tooltip, such as whether it is rendered as a static label or as a modal help popup.

value.description: Contains the help text displayed in the section tooltip, providing contextual guidance about the purpose or use of the section.

maximum_rows.description: Indicates the maximum number of rows that can be added to the subform section, controlling how many related records can be embedded in a single parent record's layout.

preference.description: Contains the conditional display criteria for the section, defining the field conditions that must be satisfied for the section to be shown or for certain section behaviors to be applied.

items.description: Represents a single conditional display criterion for the section, specifying the field, comparison operator, value type, and comparison value used to evaluate whether the condition is met.

comparator.description: Represents the comparison operator applied when evaluating the section preference criterion, such as equals, contains, or is not null.

field.description: Identifies the field whose value is evaluated against the comparator and preference value to determine whether the section's conditional display condition is met.

api_name.description: API name of the field used in the criteria.

id.description: Unique identifier of the field used in the criteria.

type.description: Indicates whether the comparison value in the preference criterion is a static literal or a dynamic contextual reference resolved at runtime.

value.description: Represents the value compared against the selected field when evaluating the section preference criterion, which may be a string, number, or Boolean depending on the field type.

oneOf.description: Represents a string value used as the comparison operand in the section preference criterion.
Represents a numeric value used as the comparison operand in the section preference criterion.
Represents a Boolean value used as the comparison operand in the section preference criterion.

SectionUpdateObject.description: Represents a section operation object used in layout update requests to create, modify, or delete a section within the layout, including its label, field assignments, column count, and sequence.

id.description: Unique identifier of the section. Required for updating or deleting existing sections. Omit when creating a new section.

name.description: Represents the internal API name of the section. Required when creating a new section through a layout update.

display_label.description: Represents the heading label of the section as displayed in the CRM interface. Required when creating a new section.

sequence_number.description: Indicates the one-based ordinal position of the section within the layout, controlling the order in which sections are rendered.

tab_traversal.description: Specifies the tab key navigation direction within the section. Defines how focus moves between fields when users press Tab. Possible values: `left_to_right` — focus moves horizontally across columns first. `top_to_bottom` — focus moves vertically down each column first.

column_count.description: Indicates the number of columns in which fields are arranged within this section when the layout is rendered on record forms.

fields.description: Contains the array of field operations to perform within this section, including adding, updating, creating, or removing field entries.

_delete.description: Delete configuration for removing the section. When provided, the section identified by id will be deleted.

SelectionDetails.description: Selection rules for controlling record fetching and user selection during kiosk execution. Rules by result_type - 'multiple': range and selection_type are mandatory; range value must be strictly greater than limit. 'all': selection_type and limit are mandatory; range must NOT be provided. 'single': selection_type must not be provided (must be null); range and limit must both be sent as 1.

result_type.description: Determines how many records are fetched. 'multiple': range and selection_type are mandatory; range must be greater than limit. 'all': selection_type and limit are mandatory; range must NOT be sent. 'single': range and limit must both be 1; selection_type must not be sent (must be null).

selection_type.description: User selection behavior: 'mandate' (required), 'optional', or 'read_only'. Mandatory when result_type is 'multiple' or 'all'. Must be null (not provided) when result_type is 'single'.

range.description: Maximum number of records to fetch. Mandatory when result_type is 'multiple' (must be greater than limit). Must be 1 when result_type is 'single'. Must NOT be provided when result_type is 'all'.

limit.description: Maximum number of records the user can select. Must be less than range when result_type is 'multiple'. Mandatory when result_type is 'all'. Must be 1 when result_type is 'single'.

SelectionDetailsUpdate.description: Selection rules for update operations. All fields are optional.

result_type.description: Determines how many records are fetched.

range.description: Maximum number of records to fetch.

limit.description: Maximum number of records the user can select.

SendMailMergeNested.description: Represents the request payload for a send mail merge operation, including the template, recipient addresses, subject, message body, and optional attachment settings.

bcc_email.description: Represents the list of email addresses to include in the BCC field of the mail merge email.

mail_merge_template.description: Mailmerge Object to pass Template details (Required)

subject.description: Represents the subject line of the mail merge email.

cc_email.description: Represents the list of email addresses to include in the CC field of the mail merge email.

attachment_name.description: Represents the name of the attachment to include in the mail merge email.

to_address.description: Represents the list of email addresses to send the mail merge email to.

type.description: Represents the attachment type for the mail merge email. Possible values: **inline** - Includes the mail merge document as an inline image in the email. **attachment** - Attaches the mail merge document as a separate file in the email.

message.description: Represents the body or content of the email you want to send. It can include up to **100,000 characters**.

from_address.description: The email ID you want to use to send emails from. This email address must be the one of the org-verified email addresses or the current user's email ID.

message.description: Represents the message describing the result of the send mail merge operation.

status.description: Represents the status of the send mail merge operation. Possible values: **success** - The mail merge email was initiated successfully. **error** - The mail merge email failed to initiate.

data.description: Represents the list of mail-send results, one item per email request.

items.description: Represents the result status for a single email send attempt.

code.description: Represents the status code for the send operation. Possible values: **SUCCESS** - The email was sent successfully. Example: "SUCCESS".

status.description: Represents the status of the email send operation. Possible values: **success** - The email was sent successfully. Example: "success".

message.description: Represents the status message for the send operation.

details.description: Represents additional metadata returned for the send operation, including the message identifier.

message_id.description: Represents the unique message identifier assigned to the sent email.

ServiceNameNested.description: Represents the service for which the appointment is created, including the service ID and name.

ServicesDataNested.description: Represents a service object in the create request payload, including its name, duration, price, location, members, availability configuration, layout reference, and Zia owner assignment.

Job_Sheet_Required.description: Specify whether a job sheet is required for the service. **Possible values**: Yes, No.

Available_Timings.description: Specify the available time windows for the service on each available day or date. The total available time must be at least equal to the service Duration. If not mentioned, the configured business hours are used.

Description.description: Specify a description of the service.

Available_From.description: Specify the date from which the service is available, in YYYY-MM-DD format. The key is mandatory when Availability_Type is Specific Date Range.

Service_Name.description: Specify the name of the service. The key accepts alphanumeric characters.

Available_Till.description: Specify the date until which the service is available, in YYYY-MM-DD format. The key is mandatory when Availability_Type is Specific Date Range.

Available_Days.description: Specify the list of business days on which the service is available. This key is mandatory when Availability_Type is Specific Day(s).

items.description: Each string specifies a business day on which the service is available.

Duration.description: Specify the duration of the service, in minutes. Must be greater than 5 minutes and less than 24 hours.

Tax.description: Specify the taxes applied to the service cost. Each entry carries a tax ID and the tax value label.

Price.description: Specify the price charged for the service in the organization currency, with up to 16 digits and 2 decimal places.

zia_suggested_users.description: Specify the Zia-suggested users payload associated with the service record.

Availability_Type.description: Specify how the service availability is defined. **Possible values**: - Every Business Days - service is available on every business day. - Specific Date Range - service is available within an Available_From and Available_Till range. - Specific Date(s) - service is available on the dates listed in Available_Dates. - Specific Day(s) - service is available on the weekdays listed in Available_Days.

$zia_owner_assignment.description: Specify the Zia owner-assignment recommendation behavior for the service record.

Members.description: Specify the users who deliver the service. Refer to the [Get users](users.yaml#$.paths./users.get) resource for valid values.

Available_Dates.description: Specify the list of dates on which the service is available, in YYYY-MM-DD format. This key is mandatory when Availability_Type is Specific Date(s).

items.description: Each string specifies one date on which the service is available, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Location.description: Specify where the service is delivered. **Possible values**: Client Address, Business Address, Business Address and Client Address.

SetFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the set filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the set filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description: Represents the set membership comparison operator applied to the criterion. Possible values: in - Matches records where the field value is in the specified set of values. not_in - Matches records where the field value is not in the specified set of values.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

type.description: Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference. Possible values: value - The value is a direct literal. merge_field - The value is a merge field reference. pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder. field - The value references another field.

SetFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the in and not_in comparators. The value is an array of primitive values.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the set filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the set filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description: Represents the set membership comparison operator returned for the criterion. Possible values: in - Matches records where the field value is in the specified set of values. not_in - Matches records where the field value is not in the specified set of values.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values returned for the set comparison.

type.description: Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference. Possible values: value - The value is a direct literal. merge_field - The value is a merge field reference. pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder. field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the set filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

ShareLimitExceedErrorResponse.description: Represents the error response returned when the share entry exceeds the per-record sharing limit for the recipient type.

subordinates.description: Specify true if subordinates are included, false otherwise

SignMailMergeNested.description: Represents the request payload for a sign mail merge operation, including the template reference, file name, signing order, and the list of signers.

sign_in_order.description: Indicates whether recipients must act on the document in a specified sequence. Possible values: **true** - The document first goes for approval, then for signing in the defined order. **false** - Zoho Sign sends the document to all recipients simultaneously.

signers.description: The details of the users you want to sign the document. - recipient_name **string, mandatory** - the name of the user who has to sign or approve the document. - **action_type** string, mandatory - the type of action you want the user to perform. The possible values are sign to **sign** the document, and **approve** to approve the document. - **recipient** JSON object, mandatory - **value** string, mandatory - the email ID of the user who has to sign or approve the document. > **Note** > The values for the fields **recipient_name** and **recipient.value** will be taken from the mail merge template. If you want to override the values in the template, you must specify the values of these fields in the input body.

file_name.description: Represents the name of the file to send for signing or approval.

SignMailMergeNested1.description: Represents the response payload for a sign mail merge operation.

code.description: Represents the response code indicating the result of the sign mail merge operation.

message.description: Represents the message describing the result of the sign mail merge operation.

status.description: Represents the status of the sign mail merge operation. Possible values: **success** - The sign mail merge document was sent successfully. **error** - The sign mail merge document failed to send.

SignalInformation.description: Details about touch point signals used in scoring, including signal namespace and ID.

id.description: Signal id

SignersNested.description: Represents a signer entry for a sign mail merge operation, including the recipient details, the recipient name, and the required action type.

recipient_name.description: Represents the name of the recipient who must sign or approve the document.

action_type.description: Represents the action the recipient must perform on the mail merge document. Possible values: **sign** - The recipient must sign the document. **approve** - The recipient must approve the document.

SimpleAssociateActionSchema.description: Represents an associate action that references a pre-configured action entity by its unique ID, applicable to action types such as webhooks, functions, and notifications.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the pre-configured action entity. Required to associate an existing action with the workflow rule.

name.description: Represents the display name of the SimpleAssociate action. Returned in GET responses and derived from the referenced action configuration.

type.description: Represents the type of associate action. Possible values: webhooks - HTTP callback to an external URL. functions - Custom function execution. email_notifications - Automated email notification. tasks - Task creation action.

details.description: Represents the read-only details of the associated action entity. Returned in GET responses and not required in POST or PUT requests.

module.description: The module this action applies to.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

SimpleFieldError.description: Represents the error details for an invalid or missing field, including the API name and JSON path.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field that caused the error.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path pointing to the invalid field in the request.

SimpleFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

SimpleFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a simple field-based filter criterion, dispatching to the appropriate comparator-specific response schema.

SimpleFilterCriterionValueAgeDuePredefin.description: Represents a predefined age or due-in-days placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime. Follows the pattern ${AGEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field was exactly n days in the past, or ${DUEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field is exactly n days in the future. Supported comparators are equal, not_equal, less_than, greater_than, less_equal, and greater_equal.

SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean.description: Represents a Boolean filter criterion value. Applicable only when the field has a Boolean data type (checkbox field).

SimpleFilterCriterionValueDateTimePredef.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

SimpleFilterCriterionValueGeneralPredefi.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable to any field data_type with the equal comparator. Possible values: ${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value. ${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

SimpleFilterCriterionValueNDaysPredefine.description: Represents a predefined N-period range placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator. Follows the pattern ${NEXT_N_<PERIOD>:<n>} or ${LAST_N_<PERIOD>:<n>}, where PERIOD is DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, or YEARS and n is a positive integer. The current period is always excluded from the range.

SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber.description: Represents a numeric filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of integer, currency, or double.

SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefin.description: Represents a predefined placeholder object filter criterion value for lookup fields, applicable with equal or not_equal comparators when the field's data_type is ownerlookup or userlookup. Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. For specific real users or roles that are not predefined, use SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, which requires the ID property.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user, in which only the name property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property is included.

name.description: Represents the predefined placeholder for the currently logged-in user. Possible values: ${CURRENTUSER} - Represents the currently logged-in user. Example: "${CURRENTUSER}".

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user's role, in which the ID property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and the name property is an optional display label.

id.description: Represents the predefined placeholder for the logged-in user's role record ID. Possible values: ${CURRENTUSERROLE} - Represents the role of the currently logged-in user. Example: "${CURRENTUSERROLE}".

name.description: Represents an optional display label for the predefined role, such as Logged in User Role.

allOf.description: Represents the constraint that the ID property is required for the lookup object filter criterion value in request bodies.

SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for request bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. The ID property is required.

allOf.description: Represents the constraint that both the ID and name properties are required for the lookup object filter criterion value in response bodies.

SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for response bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. Both the ID and name properties are included.

SimpleFilterCriterionValueString.description: Represents a string filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime, as well as any data_type not explicitly covered by SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber, SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse, or the multiselect lookup value schemas.

TaskCreateOrUpdateInput.description: PURPOSE: Writable task fields for create or update. name.description: Display name for this task definition. Must be identical to the value provided in the Subject field_mapping entry. If they do not match, the API returns INVALID_DATA. For merge_field type Subject mappings, set name to the same token string (e.g., "${!Leads.Last_Name}").

notify.description: Whether notification should be sent to the task owner when this automation task executes.

feature_type.description: The automation feature this task definition belongs to. Defaults to "workflow" if omitted. A task can only be associated with the feature it was created for - a task with feature_type="workflow" can only be attached to workflow rules, not to blueprints or kiosks. Supported values are defined in the enum.

field_mappings.description: REQUIRED. Field mappings for task fields. Mandatory mappings: Subject (static or merge_field), Due_Date (execution_time), Status (static: Not Started, Deferred, In Progress, Completed, Waiting on someone else), Priority (static: Highest, High, Normal, Low, Lowest). Optional: Description, Owner, Remind_At (execution_time). Each entry requires field ({api_name, id}), type, and value. Types: static (literal values), merge_field (${!Module.Field} tokens), execution_time (for Date/DateTime/ALARM - requires period, unit, trigger_field, sign). Workflow tasks support period: days, business_days only. Max 20 entries.

id.description: The id of the item to update.

TextFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the text filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the text filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description: Represents the text comparison operator applied to the criterion. Possible values: like - Matches records where the field value contains the specified pattern. not_like - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified pattern. starts_with - Matches records where the field value begins with the specified string. ends_with - Matches records where the field value ends with the specified string. contains - Matches records where the field value contains the specified string. not_contains - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified string.

value.description: Represents the string filter value used in the text comparator. Accepts a scalar string or an array of string values.

oneOf.description: Contains an array of primitive string values for the text filter comparator.

type.description: Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference. Possible values: value - The value is a direct literal. merge_field - The value is a merge field reference. pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder. field - The value references another field.
